### Snippet #127: Shortcode test for Collection Query - 4
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-09-17 08:23:49`
- **Shortcodes:** `bigtree_collection_grid`, `bigtree_collection_products`
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** _None_
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain()`, `bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode()`, `bigtree_collection_products_shortcode()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Collection Shortcodes with Auto-Unpack & Adaptive Dynamic Filters
 * 
 * Auto-detects intermediate "folder" terms (e.g. DD. Premium & DD. Pulse)
 * and automatically merges their sub-collections onto one page.
 * 
 * [bigtree_collection_grid]     - shows unified child/grandchild cards with filter bar
 * [bigtree_collection_products] - shows product cards on leaf terms
 */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain' ) ) {
    function bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $term_id ) {
        static $chain_cache = [];
        if ( isset( $chain_cache[ $term_id ] ) ) {
            return $chain_cache[ $term_id ];
        }

        $term = get_term( $term_id, 'product_cat' );
        if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
            return [];
        }

        $lineage = [ $term ];
        $curr = $term;
        while ( $curr->parent != 0 ) {
            $parent = get_term( $curr->parent, 'product_cat' );
            if ( ! $parent || is_wp_error( $parent ) ) {
                break;
            }
            array_unshift( $lineage, $parent );
            $curr = $parent;
        }

        $chain = [];
        $level = 1;
        foreach ( $lineage as $item ) {
            $chain[ $level ] = $item;
            $level++;
        }

        $chain_cache[ $term_id ] = $chain;
        return $chain;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
    function bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
        $current_term = get_queried_object();

        if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
            return '';
        }

        if ( ! bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
            return '';
        }

        // 1. Get direct children
        $direct_children = get_terms([
            'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
            'parent'     => $current_term->term_id,
            'hide_empty' => false,
        ]);

        if ( empty( $direct_children ) || is_wp_error( $direct_children ) ) {
            return '';
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // STEP 1: AUTO-DETECT SPECIAL CASE (Merge Sub-Collections)
        // If there are <= 3 direct children and they have sub-collections (like DD. Premium / DD. Pulse),
        // we automatically bypass them and pull their sub-collections onto this page!
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        $has_subchildren_count = 0;
        foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
            if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
                $has_subchildren_count++;
            }
        }

        $display_terms = [];

        if ( count( $direct_children ) <= 3 && $has_subchildren_count > 0 ) {
            // UNPACK & MERGE SUB-COLLECTIONS
            foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
                if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
                    $subs = get_terms([
                        'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
                        'parent'     => $child->term_id,
                        'hide_empty' => false,
                    ]);
                    if ( ! empty( $subs ) && ! is_wp_error( $subs ) ) {
                        foreach ( $subs as $s ) {
                            $display_terms[] = $s;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    $display_terms[] = $child;
                }
            }
        } else {
            // STANDARD SELECTION (like DK Selection with 352 direct children)
            $display_terms = $direct_children;
        }

        if ( empty( $display_terms ) ) {
            return '';
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // STEP 2: GATHER CATEGORIES FOR EACH DISPLAYED CARD
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        $cards_raw          = [];
        $all_chains_by_card = [];

        foreach ( $display_terms as $card_term ) {
            $image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $card_term->term_id );
            $term_link = get_term_link( $card_term );
            if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
                $term_link = '#';
            }

            $descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $card_term->term_id, 'collection' );
            $product_ids = get_posts([
                'post_type'   => 'product',
                'numberposts' => 20,
                'fields'      => 'ids',
                'tax_query'   => [
                    [
                        'taxonomy' => 'collection',
                        'field'    => 'term_id',
                        'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
                    ],
                ],
            ]);

            $chains_for_this_card = [];
            foreach ( $product_ids as $pid ) {
                $prod_cats = get_the_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' );
                if ( $prod_cats && ! is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
                    foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
                        $chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
                        if ( ! empty( $chain ) ) {
                            $chains_for_this_card[] = $chain;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            $cards_raw[] = [
                'term'      => $card_term,
                'image_url' => $image_url,
                'term_link' => $term_link,
            ];
            $all_chains_by_card[ $card_term->term_id ] = $chains_for_this_card;
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // STEP 3: ADAPTIVE FILTER LEVEL DETECTION
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        $l1_terms = [];
        $l2_terms = [];
        $l3_terms = [];

        foreach ( $all_chains_by_card as $card_chains ) {
            foreach ( $card_chains as $chain ) {
                if ( isset( $chain[1] ) ) $l1_terms[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
                if ( isset( $chain[2] ) ) $l2_terms[ $chain[2]->term_id ] = $chain[2]->name;
                if ( isset( $chain[3] ) ) $l3_terms[ $chain[3]->term_id ] = $chain[3]->name;
            }
        }

        // Auto-select filter depth
        if ( count( $l1_terms ) >= 3 ) {
            $target_level = 1;
        } elseif ( count( $l2_terms ) > 1 ) {
            $target_level = 2;
        } elseif ( count( $l3_terms ) > 1 ) {
            $target_level = 3;
        } else {
            $target_level = ! empty( $l2_terms ) ? 2 : 1;
        }

        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        // STEP 4: ASSEMBLE CARDS & DYNAMIC FILTER BUTTONS
        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        $cards_data        = [];
        $available_filters = [];

        foreach ( $cards_raw as $card ) {
            $cid    = $card['term']->term_id;
            $chains = $all_chains_by_card[ $cid ];

            $card_cat_names = [];
            $card_cat_slugs = [];

            foreach ( $chains as $chain ) {
                $term_at_level = isset( $chain[ $target_level ] ) ? $chain[ $target_level ] : ( isset( $chain[1] ) ? $chain[1] : null );

                if ( $term_at_level ) {
                    $slug = sanitize_title( $term_at_level->slug );
                    $name = $term_at_level->name;

                    $card_cat_names[ $slug ]    = $name;
                    $card_cat_slugs[ $slug ]    = $slug;
                    $available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
                }
            }

            if ( empty( $card_cat_names ) ) {
                $fallback = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $cid );
                foreach ( $fallback as $fname ) {
                    $fslug = sanitize_title( $fname );
                    $card_cat_names[ $fslug ]    = $fname;
                    $card_cat_slugs[ $fslug ]    = $fslug;
                    $available_filters[ $fslug ] = $fname;
                }
            }

            $cards_data[] = [
                'term'           => $card['term'],
                'image_url'      => $card['image_url'],
                'term_link'      => $card['term_link'],
                'category_names' => array_values( $card_cat_names ),
                'category_slugs' => array_values( $card_cat_slugs ),
            ];
        }

        asort( $available_filters );

        ob_start();
        ?>
        <div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper">

            <!-- DYNAMIC FILTER BUTTONS -->
            <?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
                <div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
                    <button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
                    <?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
                        <button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
                            <?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
                        </button>
                    <?php endforeach; ?>
                </div>
            <?php endif; ?>

            <!-- UNIFIED COLLECTION GRID -->
            <div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
                <?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) : 
                    $card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
                    $data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
                ?>
                    <a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>" 
                       class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>" 
                       data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">
                        
                        <div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
                            <?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
                                <img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
                            <?php endif; ?>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>
                        
                        <?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
                            <div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
                        <?php endif; ?>
                    </a>
                <?php endforeach; ?>
            </div>
        </div>

        <style>
            .bigtree-filter-bar {
                display: flex;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                gap: 10px;
                margin-bottom: 35px;
            }
            .bigtree-filter-btn {
                background-color: #fff;
                color: #000;
                border: 1px solid #000;
                padding: 8px 18px;
                font-size: 13px;
                font-weight: 600;
                letter-spacing: 1px;

                transition: all 0.2s ease;

            }
            .bigtree-filter-btn:hover,
            .bigtree-filter-btn.active {
                background-color: #000;
                color: #fff;
            }
            .bigtree-collection-card.is-hidden {
                display: none !important;
            }
        </style>

        <script>

            const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-filter-btn');
            const cards      = document.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-card');

            filterBtns.forEach(btn => {

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' ) ) {
    function bigtree_collection_products_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
        $current_term = get_queried_object();

        if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {

        if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
            return '';
        }

        $products = wc_get_products([
            'status'    => 'publish',
            'limit'     => -1,
            'orderby'   => 'menu_order',
            'order'     => 'ASC',
            'tax_query' => [
                [
                    'taxonomy' => 'collection',
                    'field'    => 'term_id',
                    'terms'    => $current_term->term_id,
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        if ( empty( $products ) ) {
            return '';
        }

        ob_start();
        ?>
        <div class="bigtree-collection-product-grid">
            <?php foreach ( $products as $product ) :
                $product_id   = $product->get_id();
                $image_url    = get_the_post_thumbnail_url( $product_id, 'medium' );
                $product_link = get_permalink( $product_id );

                $cat_terms = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
                $cat_names = [];
                if ( $cat_terms && ! is_wp_error( $cat_terms ) ) {
                    foreach ( $cat_terms as $cat_term ) {
                        if ( $cat_term->parent !== 0 ) {
                            $cat_names[] = $cat_term->name;
                        }
                    }
                }
            ?>
                <a href="<?php echo esc_url( $product_link ); ?>" class="bigtree-collection-product-card">
                    <div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image">
                        <?php if ( $image_url ) : ?>
                            <img src="<?php echo esc_url( $image_url ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $product->get_name() ); ?>" loading="lazy">
                        <?php endif; ?>
                    </div>
                    <div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $product->get_name() ); ?></div>
                    <?php if ( ! empty( $cat_names ) ) : ?>
                        <div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $cat_names ) ); ?></div>
                    <?php endif; ?>
                </a>
            <?php endforeach; ?>
        </div>
        <?php
        return ob_get_clean();
    }
    add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_products', 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' );
}
```

### Snippet #128: Shortcode test for Collection Query - 5
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-09-30 08:50:18`
- **Shortcodes:** `bigtree_collection_grid`, `bigtree_collection_products`, `bigtree_all_selections_grid`
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `wp_footer`
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain()`, `bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode()`, `bigtree_collection_products_shortcode()`, `bigtree_get_collection_top_categories()`, `bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode()`, `initMultiSelectFilter()`, `updateUrl()`, `applyFilters()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Complete Collection & Product Shortcodes with Dynamic Filters
 *
 * 1. [bigtree_collection_grid] - Used on PARENT collection terms:
 *    - Auto-unpacks intermediate "folder" terms (e.g. DD. Premium / DD. Pulse).
 *    - Auto-zooms category depth (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3).
 *    - Adds dynamic collection filter bar.
 *    - Skips cards for collections with zero published products.
 *
 * 2. [bigtree_collection_products] - Used on LEAF collection terms:
 *    - Renders WooCommerce products.
 *    - If products belong to > 1 child category, automatically renders a dynamic filter bar!
 *
 * 3. [bigtree_all_selections_grid] - Used on the All Selections page:
 *    - Computed replacement for the manual Collections CPT.
 *    - Pulls all top-level (parent = 0) Selection terms directly from the taxonomy.
 *    - Cover image + Level-1 department tags are computed live, not hand-entered.
 *    - Skips Selections with zero published products anywhere in their tree.
 */

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Category Ancestor Chain
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $term_id ) {
		static $chain_cache = [];
		if ( isset( $chain_cache[ $term_id ] ) ) {
			return $chain_cache[ $term_id ];
		}

		$term = get_term( $term_id, 'product_cat' );
		if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$lineage = [ $term ];
		$curr = $term;
		while ( $curr->parent != 0 ) {
			$parent = get_term( $curr->parent, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $parent || is_wp_error( $parent ) ) {
				break;
			}
			array_unshift( $lineage, $parent );
			$curr = $parent;
		}

		$chain = [];
		$level = 1;
		foreach ( $lineage as $item ) {
			$chain[ $level ] = $item;
			$level++;
		}

		$chain_cache[ $term_id ] = $chain;
		return $chain;
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 1: [bigtree_collection_grid] (Parent Collections)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( ! bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$direct_children = get_terms([
			'taxonomy' => 'collection',
			'parent' => $current_term->term_id,
			'hide_empty' => false,
		]);

		if ( empty( $direct_children ) || is_wp_error( $direct_children ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Auto-detect intermediate folder terms (e.g. DD Selection with 2 children)
		$has_subchildren_count = 0;
		foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
			if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
				$has_subchildren_count++;
			}
		}

		$display_terms = [];
		if ( count( $direct_children ) <= 3 && $has_subchildren_count > 0 ) {
			foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
				if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
					$subs = get_terms([
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'parent' => $child->term_id,
						'hide_empty' => false,
					]);
					if ( ! empty( $subs ) && ! is_wp_error( $subs ) ) {
						foreach ( $subs as $s ) {
							$display_terms[] = $s;
						}
					}
				} else {
					$display_terms[] = $child;
				}
			}
		} else {
			$display_terms = $direct_children;
		}

		if ( empty( $display_terms ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Gather categories and chains
		$cards_raw = [];
		$all_chains_by_card = [];

		foreach ( $display_terms as $card_term ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $card_term->term_id, 'collection' );

			$product_ids = get_posts([
				'post_type' => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish', // FIX: only count live products
				'numberposts' => 20,
				'fields' => 'ids',
				'tax_query' => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field' => 'term_id',
						'terms' => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			// FIX: skip this card entirely if it has zero published products.
			// Keeps unpublished/private collections (e.g. Costa Rica, Kansas) out of the
			// grid while leaving them untouched in the database.
			if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $card_term->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $card_term );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$chains_for_this_card = [];
			foreach ( $product_ids as $pid ) {
				$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' );
				if ( $prod_cats && ! is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
					foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
						$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
						if ( ! empty( $chain ) ) {
							$chains_for_this_card[] = $chain;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			$cards_raw[] = [
				'term' => $card_term,
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'term_link' => $term_link,
			];
			$all_chains_by_card[ $card_term->term_id ] = $chains_for_this_card;
		}

		// FIX: if everything got filtered out, bail cleanly instead of rendering an empty wrapper.
		if ( empty( $cards_raw ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Adaptive depth selection
		$l1_terms = [];
		$l2_terms = [];
		$l3_terms = [];

		foreach ( $all_chains_by_card as $card_chains ) {
			foreach ( $card_chains as $chain ) {
				if ( isset( $chain[1] ) ) $l1_terms[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[2] ) ) $l2_terms[ $chain[2]->term_id ] = $chain[2]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[3] ) ) $l3_terms[ $chain[3]->term_id ] = $chain[3]->name;
			}
		}

		if ( count( $l1_terms ) >= 3 ) {
			$target_level = 1;
		} elseif ( count( $l2_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 2;
		} elseif ( count( $l3_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 3;
		} else {
			$target_level = ! empty( $l2_terms ) ? 2 : 1;
		}

		$cards_data = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $cards_raw as $card ) {
			$cid = $card['term']->term_id;
			$chains = $all_chains_by_card[ $cid ];

			$card_cat_names = [];
			$card_cat_slugs = [];

			foreach ( $chains as $chain ) {
				$term_at_level = isset( $chain[ $target_level ] ) ? $chain[ $target_level ] : ( isset( $chain[1] ) ? $chain[1] : null );

				if ( $term_at_level ) {
					$slug = sanitize_title( $term_at_level->slug );
					$name = $term_at_level->name;

					$card_cat_names[ $slug ] = $name;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
					$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
				}
			}

			if ( empty( $card_cat_names ) ) {
				$fallback = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $cid );
				foreach ( $fallback as $fname ) {
					$fslug = sanitize_title( $fname );
					$card_cat_names[ $fslug ] = $fname;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $fslug ] = $fslug;
					$available_filters[ $fslug ] = $fname;
				}
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term' => $card['term'],
				'image_url' => $card['image_url'],
				'term_link' => $card['term_link'],
				'category_names' => array_values( $card_cat_names ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $card_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="grid">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_grid', 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 2: [bigtree_collection_products] (Leaf Pages With Dynamic Filter)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_products_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$products = wc_get_products([
			'status' => 'publish',
			'limit' => -1,
			'orderby' => 'menu_order',
			'order' => 'ASC',
			'tax_query' => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => 'collection',
					'field' => 'term_id',
					'terms' => $current_term->term_id,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $products ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Process products & gather child categories for the filter bar
		$products_data = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $products as $product ) {
			$product_id = $product->get_id();
			$image_url = bigtree_get_card_image_url( get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id ), 'medium_large' );
			$product_link = get_permalink( $product_id );

			$cat_terms = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			$child_cat_names = [];
			$child_cat_slugs = [];

			if ( $cat_terms && ! is_wp_error( $cat_terms ) ) {
				foreach ( $cat_terms as $cat_term ) {
					// Extract child categories (parent !== 0)
					if ( $cat_term->parent !== 0 ) {
						$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_term->slug );
						$name = $cat_term->name;

						$child_cat_names[ $slug ] = $name;
						$child_cat_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
						$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
					}
				}
			}

			$products_data[] = [
				'name' => $product->get_name(),
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'link' => $product_link,
				'cat_names' => array_values( $child_cat_names ),
				'cat_slugs' => array_keys( $child_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="products">

			<!-- DYNAMIC PRODUCT FILTER BAR (Only if > 1 child category) -->
			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<!-- PRODUCT CARDS GRID -->
			<div class="bigtree-collection-product-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $products_data as $p ) :
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $p['cat_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $p['link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-product-card"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image">
							<?php if ( $p['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $p['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['name'] ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $p['name'] ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $p['cat_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $p['cat_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_products', 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Top-Level (Department) Categories for a Collection Subtree
// Used only by [bigtree_all_selections_grid] below.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_collection_top_categories' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
		$all_term_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy );

		$product_ids = get_posts([
			'post_type'   => 'product',
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'numberposts' => -1,
			'fields'      => 'ids',
			'tax_query'   => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
					'field'    => 'term_id',
					'terms'    => $all_term_ids,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$top_categories = [];

		foreach ( $product_ids as $product_id ) {
			$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $prod_cats || is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
				$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
				if ( ! empty( $chain[1] ) ) {
					$top_categories[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				}
			}
		}

		asort( $top_categories );
		return $top_categories; // [ term_id => name ]
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 3: [bigtree_all_selections_grid] (Top-Level Selections, computed)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$selections = get_terms([
			'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
			'parent'     => 0,
			'hide_empty' => false,
			'orderby'    => 'name',
			'order'      => 'ASC',
		]);

		if ( empty( $selections ) || is_wp_error( $selections ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$cards_data         = [];
		$available_filters  = [];

		foreach ( $selections as $selection ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $selection->term_id, 'collection' );

			// Skip entirely if the Selection has zero published products anywhere in its tree.
			$has_products = get_posts([
				'post_type'   => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish',
				'numberposts' => 1,
				'fields'      => 'ids',
				'tax_query'   => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field'    => 'term_id',
						'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			if ( empty( $has_products ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $selection->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $selection );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$top_categories  = bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $selection->term_id );
			$category_slugs  = [];
			foreach ( $top_categories as $cat_id => $cat_name ) {
				$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_name );
				$category_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
				$available_filters[ $slug ] = $cat_name;
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term'           => $selection,
				'image_url'      => $image_url,
				'term_link'      => $term_link,
				'category_names' => array_values( $top_categories ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $category_slugs ),
			];
		}

		if ( empty( $cards_data ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="all-selections">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid', 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// GLOBAL STYLES & UNIFIED JAVASCRIPT FILTER SCRIPT
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_action( 'wp_footer', function() {
	?>
	<style>
	.bigtree-filter-bar {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 10px;
		margin-bottom: 35px;
	}
	.bigtree-filter-btn {
		background-color: #fff;
		color: #000;
		border: 1px solid #000;
		padding: 8px 18px;
		font-size: 13px;
		font-weight: 600;
		letter-spacing: 1px;
		cursor: pointer;
		transition: all 0.2s ease;
		border-radius: 2px;
		text-transform: uppercase;
		-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
	}
	/* DEFAULT for every non-selected state (rest, focus, focus-visible, pressed, touch-hover).
	   The theme paints button:focus / button:hover pink, so the background must be set explicitly here. */
	.bigtree-filter-btn,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:hover,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:focus,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:focus-visible,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:active {
		background-color: #fff;
		border-color: #000;
		color: #000;
		outline: none;
		box-shadow: none;
		text-decoration: none;
	}
	/* HOVER: purple fill, white text. Real-hover devices only, so taps on touch screens never leave a sticky purple button. */
	@media (hover: hover) {
		.bigtree-filter-btn:hover {
			background-color: #532A44;
			border-color: #532A44;
			color: #fff;
		}
	}
	/* ACTIVE (selected): black fill, white text. Declared last so it beats hover and focus. */
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:hover,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:focus,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:focus-visible,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:active {
		background-color: #000;
		border-color: #000;
		color: #fff;
	}
	.bigtree-collection-card.is-hidden,
	.bigtree-collection-product-card.is-hidden {
		display: none !important;
	}
	.bigtree-no-match-message {
		padding: 60px 0;
		text-align: center;
		color: #666;
		font-size: 14px;
	}
	</style>

	<script>
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
		// Scoped filtering: handles collection grid, product grid, and all-selections grid
		const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-wrapper');

		// Messages shown when a filter combination matches nothing.
		// Only "all-selections" runs multi-select for now (Option B); the others
		// are ready for when multi-select rolls out everywhere (Option A) -
		// at that point, remove the `scope === 'all-selections'` check below.
		const noMatchMessages = {
			'all-selections': 'No Selections match these filters.',
			'grid': 'No Collections match these filters.',
			'products': 'No products match these filters.'
		};

		wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
			const scope = wrapper.getAttribute('data-filter-scope');
			const filterBtns = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-filter-btn');
			const items = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-card, .bigtree-collection-product-card');

			if (!filterBtns.length || !items.length) return;

			// ---- MULTI-SELECT (AND) : All Selections page only, for now ----
			if (scope === 'all-selections') {
				initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchMessages[scope]);
				return;
			}

			// ---- SINGLE-SELECT (unchanged, existing behavior) ----
			filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
					filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
					this.classList.add('active');

					const selectedFilter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');

					items.forEach(item => {
						if (selectedFilter === 'all') {
							item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
						} else {
							const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
							if (itemCats.includes(selectedFilter)) {
								item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
							} else {
								item.classList.add('is-hidden');
							}
						}
					});
				});
			});
		});

		function initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchText) {
			// Active filter set, e.g. {'furniture', 'floor-coverings'}
			let active = new Set();

			// No-results message, created once, hidden by default.
			const noMatchEl = document.createElement('div');
			noMatchEl.className = 'bigtree-no-match-message';
			noMatchEl.textContent = noMatchText;
			noMatchEl.style.display = 'none';
			wrapper.appendChild(noMatchEl);

			// Pre-apply ?filters=a,b,c from the URL on load, so shared links work.
			const initialParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
			const urlFilters = initialParams.get('filters');
			if (urlFilters) {
				urlFilters.split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(f => active.add(f));
			}

			function updateUrl() {
				const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
				if (active.size) {
					params.set('filters', Array.from(active).join(','));
				} else {
					params.delete('filters');
				}
				const query = params.toString();
				const newUrl = window.location.pathname + (query ? '?' + query : '') + window.location.hash;
				history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
			}

			function applyFilters() {
				// ALL shows as active exactly when nothing else is selected.
				filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
					const f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
					if (f === 'all') {
						btn.classList.toggle('active', active.size === 0);
					} else {
						btn.classList.toggle('active', active.has(f));
					}
				});

				let visibleCount = 0;
				items.forEach(item => {
					const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
					const matches = active.size === 0 || Array.from(active).every(f => itemCats.includes(f));
					item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !matches);
					if (matches) visibleCount++;
				});

				noMatchEl.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
			}

			filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
					const f = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
					if (f === 'all') {
						active.clear();
					} else if (active.has(f)) {
						active.delete(f);
					} else {
						active.add(f);
					}
					applyFilters();
					updateUrl();
				});
			});

			// Apply whatever came from the URL (or "all") on first load.
			applyFilters();
		}
	});
	</script>
	<?php
} );
```

- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `wp_footer`

- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain()`, `bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode()`, `bigtree_collection_products_shortcode()`, `bigtree_get_collection_top_categories()`, `bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode()`, `initMultiSelectFilter()`, `updateUrl()`, `applyFilters()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Complete Collection & Product Shortcodes with Dynamic Filters
 *
 * 1. [bigtree_collection_grid] - Used on PARENT collection terms:
 *    - Auto-unpacks intermediate "folder" terms (e.g. DD. Premium / DD. Pulse).
 *    - Auto-zooms category depth (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3).
 *    - Adds dynamic collection filter bar.
 *    - Skips cards for collections with zero published products.
 *
 * 2. [bigtree_collection_products] - Used on LEAF collection terms:
 *    - Renders WooCommerce products.
 *    - If products belong to > 1 child category, automatically renders a dynamic filter bar!
 *
 * 3. [bigtree_all_selections_grid] - Used on the All Selections page:
 *    - Computed replacement for the manual Collections CPT.
 *    - Pulls all top-level (parent = 0) Selection terms directly from the taxonomy.
 *    - Cover image + Level-1 department tags are computed live, not hand-entered.
 *    - Skips Selections with zero published products anywhere in their tree.
 */

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Category Ancestor Chain
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $term_id ) {
		static $chain_cache = [];
		if ( isset( $chain_cache[ $term_id ] ) ) {
			return $chain_cache[ $term_id ];
		}

		$term = get_term( $term_id, 'product_cat' );
		if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$lineage = [ $term ];
		$curr = $term;
		while ( $curr->parent != 0 ) {
			$parent = get_term( $curr->parent, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $parent || is_wp_error( $parent ) ) {
				break;
			}
			array_unshift( $lineage, $parent );
			$curr = $parent;
		}

		$chain = [];
		$level = 1;
		foreach ( $lineage as $item ) {
			$chain[ $level ] = $item;
			$level++;
		}

		$chain_cache[ $term_id ] = $chain;
		return $chain;
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 1: [bigtree_collection_grid] (Parent Collections)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( ! bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$direct_children = get_terms([
			'taxonomy' => 'collection',
			'parent' => $current_term->term_id,
			'hide_empty' => false,
		]);

		if ( empty( $direct_children ) || is_wp_error( $direct_children ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Auto-detect intermediate folder terms (e.g. DD Selection with 2 children)
		$has_subchildren_count = 0;
		foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
			if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
				$has_subchildren_count++;
			}
		}

		$display_terms = [];
		if ( count( $direct_children ) <= 3 && $has_subchildren_count > 0 ) {
			foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
				if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
					$subs = get_terms([
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'parent' => $child->term_id,
						'hide_empty' => false,
					]);
					if ( ! empty( $subs ) && ! is_wp_error( $subs ) ) {
						foreach ( $subs as $s ) {
							$display_terms[] = $s;
						}
					}
				} else {
					$display_terms[] = $child;
				}
			}
		} else {
			$display_terms = $direct_children;
		}

		if ( empty( $display_terms ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Gather categories and chains
		$cards_raw = [];
		$all_chains_by_card = [];

		foreach ( $display_terms as $card_term ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $card_term->term_id, 'collection' );

			$product_ids = get_posts([
				'post_type' => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish', // FIX: only count live products
				'numberposts' => 20,
				'fields' => 'ids',
				'tax_query' => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field' => 'term_id',
						'terms' => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			// FIX: skip this card entirely if it has zero published products.
			// Keeps unpublished/private collections (e.g. Costa Rica, Kansas) out of the
			// grid while leaving them untouched in the database.
			if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $card_term->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $card_term );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$chains_for_this_card = [];
			foreach ( $product_ids as $pid ) {
				$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' );
				if ( $prod_cats && ! is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
					foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
						$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
						if ( ! empty( $chain ) ) {
							$chains_for_this_card[] = $chain;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			$cards_raw[] = [
				'term' => $card_term,
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'term_link' => $term_link,
			];
			$all_chains_by_card[ $card_term->term_id ] = $chains_for_this_card;
		}

		// FIX: if everything got filtered out, bail cleanly instead of rendering an empty wrapper.
		if ( empty( $cards_raw ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Adaptive depth selection
		$l1_terms = [];
		$l2_terms = [];
		$l3_terms = [];

		foreach ( $all_chains_by_card as $card_chains ) {
			foreach ( $card_chains as $chain ) {
				if ( isset( $chain[1] ) ) $l1_terms[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[2] ) ) $l2_terms[ $chain[2]->term_id ] = $chain[2]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[3] ) ) $l3_terms[ $chain[3]->term_id ] = $chain[3]->name;
			}
		}

		if ( count( $l1_terms ) >= 3 ) {
			$target_level = 1;
		} elseif ( count( $l2_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 2;
		} elseif ( count( $l3_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 3;
		} else {
			$target_level = ! empty( $l2_terms ) ? 2 : 1;
		}

		$cards_data = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $cards_raw as $card ) {
			$cid = $card['term']->term_id;
			$chains = $all_chains_by_card[ $cid ];

			$card_cat_names = [];
			$card_cat_slugs = [];

			foreach ( $chains as $chain ) {
				$term_at_level = isset( $chain[ $target_level ] ) ? $chain[ $target_level ] : ( isset( $chain[1] ) ? $chain[1] : null );

				if ( $term_at_level ) {
					$slug = sanitize_title( $term_at_level->slug );
					$name = $term_at_level->name;

					$card_cat_names[ $slug ] = $name;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
					$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
				}
			}

			if ( empty( $card_cat_names ) ) {
				$fallback = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $cid );
				foreach ( $fallback as $fname ) {
					$fslug = sanitize_title( $fname );
					$card_cat_names[ $fslug ] = $fname;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $fslug ] = $fslug;
					$available_filters[ $fslug ] = $fname;
				}
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term' => $card['term'],
				'image_url' => $card['image_url'],
				'term_link' => $card['term_link'],
				'category_names' => array_values( $card_cat_names ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $card_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="grid">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_grid', 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 2: [bigtree_collection_products] (Leaf Pages With Dynamic Filter)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_products_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$products = wc_get_products([
			'status' => 'publish',
			'limit' => -1,
			'orderby' => 'menu_order',
			'order' => 'ASC',
			'tax_query' => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => 'collection',
					'field' => 'term_id',
					'terms' => $current_term->term_id,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $products ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Process products & gather child categories for the filter bar
		$products_data = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $products as $product ) {
			$product_id = $product->get_id();
			// Products grid uses the full-size original for maximum quality (grid/cards elsewhere stay on medium_large).
			$thumb_id  = get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id );
			$image_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'full' ) : '';
			if ( ! $image_url ) {
				$image_url = bigtree_get_card_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' );
			}
			$product_link = get_permalink( $product_id );

			$cat_terms = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			$child_cat_names = [];
			$child_cat_slugs = [];

			if ( $cat_terms && ! is_wp_error( $cat_terms ) ) {
				foreach ( $cat_terms as $cat_term ) {
					// Extract child categories (parent !== 0)
					if ( $cat_term->parent !== 0 ) {
						$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_term->slug );
						$name = $cat_term->name;

						$child_cat_names[ $slug ] = $name;
						$child_cat_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
						$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
					}
				}
			}

			$products_data[] = [
				'name' => $product->get_name(),
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'link' => $product_link,
				'cat_names' => array_values( $child_cat_names ),
				'cat_slugs' => array_keys( $child_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="products">

			<!-- DYNAMIC PRODUCT FILTER BAR (Only if > 1 child category) -->
			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<!-- PRODUCT CARDS GRID -->
			<div class="bigtree-collection-product-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $products_data as $p ) :
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $p['cat_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $p['link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-product-card"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image">
							<?php if ( $p['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $p['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['name'] ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $p['name'] ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $p['cat_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $p['cat_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_products', 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Top-Level (Department) Categories for a Collection Subtree
// Used only by [bigtree_all_selections_grid] below.
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_collection_top_categories' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
		$all_term_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy );

		$product_ids = get_posts([
			'post_type'   => 'product',
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'numberposts' => -1,
			'fields'      => 'ids',
			'tax_query'   => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
					'field'    => 'term_id',
					'terms'    => $all_term_ids,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$top_categories = [];

		foreach ( $product_ids as $product_id ) {
			$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $prod_cats || is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
				$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
				if ( ! empty( $chain[1] ) ) {
					$top_categories[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				}
			}
		}

		asort( $top_categories );
		return $top_categories; // [ term_id => name ]
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 3: [bigtree_all_selections_grid] (Top-Level Selections, computed)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$selections = get_terms([
			'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
			'parent'     => 0,
			'hide_empty' => false,
			'orderby'    => 'name',
			'order'      => 'ASC',
		]);

		if ( empty( $selections ) || is_wp_error( $selections ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$cards_data         = [];
		$available_filters  = [];

		foreach ( $selections as $selection ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $selection->term_id, 'collection' );

			// Skip entirely if the Selection has zero published products anywhere in its tree.
			$has_products = get_posts([
				'post_type'   => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish',
				'numberposts' => 1,
				'fields'      => 'ids',
				'tax_query'   => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field'    => 'term_id',
						'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			if ( empty( $has_products ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $selection->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $selection );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$top_categories  = bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $selection->term_id );
			$category_slugs  = [];
			foreach ( $top_categories as $cat_id => $cat_name ) {
				$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_name );
				$category_slugs[ $slug ] = $slug;
				$available_filters[ $slug ] = $cat_name;
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term'           => $selection,
				'image_url'      => $image_url,
				'term_link'      => $term_link,
				'category_names' => array_values( $top_categories ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $category_slugs ),
			];
		}

		if ( empty( $cards_data ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="all-selections">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid', 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' );
}

// GLOBAL STYLES & UNIFIED JAVASCRIPT FILTER SCRIPT

add_action( 'wp_footer', function() {
	?>
	<style>
	.bigtree-filter-bar {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		gap: 10px;
		margin-bottom: 35px;
	}
	.bigtree-filter-btn {
		background-color: #fff;
		color: #000;
		border: 1px solid #000;
		padding: 8px 18px;
		font-size: 13px;
		font-weight: 600;
		letter-spacing: 1px;
		cursor: pointer;
		transition: all 0.2s ease;
		border-radius: 2px;
		text-transform: uppercase;
		-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
	}
	/* DEFAULT for every non-selected state (rest, focus, focus-visible, pressed, touch-hover).
	   The theme paints button:focus / button:hover pink, so the background must be set explicitly here. */
	.bigtree-filter-btn,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:hover,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:focus,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:focus-visible,
	.bigtree-filter-btn:active {
		background-color: #fff;
		border-color: #000;
		color: #000;
		outline: none;
		box-shadow: none;
		text-decoration: none;
	}
	/* HOVER: purple fill, white text. Real-hover devices only, so taps on touch screens never leave a sticky purple button. */
	@media (hover: hover) {
		.bigtree-filter-btn:hover {
			background-color: #532A44;
			border-color: #532A44;
			color: #fff;
		}
	}
	/* ACTIVE (selected): black fill, white text. Declared last so it beats hover and focus. */
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:hover,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:focus,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:focus-visible,
	.bigtree-filter-btn.active:active {
		background-color: #000;
		border-color: #000;
		color: #fff;
	}
	.bigtree-collection-card.is-hidden,
	.bigtree-collection-product-card.is-hidden {
		display: none !important;
	}
	.bigtree-no-match-message {
		padding: 60px 0;
		text-align: center;
		color: #666;
		font-size: 14px;
	}
	</style>

	<script>
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
		// Scoped filtering: handles collection grid, product grid, and all-selections grid
		const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-wrapper');

		// Messages shown when a filter combination matches nothing.
		// Only "all-selections" runs multi-select for now (Option B); the others
		// are ready for when multi-select rolls out everywhere (Option A) -
		// at that point, remove the `scope === 'all-selections'` check below.
		const noMatchMessages = {
			'all-selections': 'No Selections match these filters.',
			'grid': 'No Collections match these filters.',
			'products': 'No products match these filters.'
		};

		wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
			const scope = wrapper.getAttribute('data-filter-scope');
			const filterBtns = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-filter-btn');
			const items = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-card, .bigtree-collection-product-card');

			if (!filterBtns.length || !items.length) return;

			// ---- MULTI-SELECT (AND) : All Selections page only, for now ----
			if (scope === 'all-selections') {
				initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchMessages[scope]);
				return;
			}

			// ---- SINGLE-SELECT (unchanged, existing behavior) ----
			filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
					filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
					this.classList.add('active');

					const selectedFilter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');

					items.forEach(item => {
						if (selectedFilter === 'all') {
							item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
						} else {
							const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
							if (itemCats.includes(selectedFilter)) {
								item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
							} else {
								item.classList.add('is-hidden');
							}
						}
					});
				});
			});
		});

		function initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchText) {
			// Active filter set, e.g. {'furniture', 'floor-coverings'}
			let active = new Set();

			// No-results message, created once, hidden by default.
			const noMatchEl = document.createElement('div');
			noMatchEl.className = 'bigtree-no-match-message';
			noMatchEl.textContent = noMatchText;
			noMatchEl.style.display = 'none';
			wrapper.appendChild(noMatchEl);

			// Pre-apply ?filters=a,b,c from the URL on load, so shared links work.
			const initialParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
			const urlFilters = initialParams.get('filters');
			if (urlFilters) {
				urlFilters.split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(f => active.add(f));
			}

			function updateUrl() {
				const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
				if (active.size) {
					params.set('filters', Array.from(active).join(','));
				} else {
					params.delete('filters');
				}
				const query = params.toString();
				const newUrl = window.location.pathname + (query ? '?' + query : '') + window.location.hash;
				history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
			}

			function applyFilters() {
				// ALL shows as active exactly when nothing else is selected.
				filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
					const f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
					if (f === 'all') {
						btn.classList.toggle('active', active.size === 0);
					} else {
						btn.classList.toggle('active', active.has(f));
					}
				});

				let visibleCount = 0;
				items.forEach(item => {
					const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
					const matches = active.size === 0 || Array.from(active).every(f => itemCats.includes(f));
					item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !matches);
					if (matches) visibleCount++;
				});

				noMatchEl.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
			}

			filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
					const f = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
					if (f === 'all') {
						active.clear();
					} else if (active.has(f)) {
						active.delete(f);
					} else {
						active.add(f);
					}
					applyFilters();
					updateUrl();
				});
			});

			// Apply whatever came from the URL (or "all") on first load.
			applyFilters();
		}
	});
	</script>
	<?php
} );
```

```php
/**
 * BigTree Complete Collection & Product Shortcodes with Dynamic Filters & Card Actions
 *
 * 1. [bigtree_collection_grid] - Used on PARENT collection terms:
 *    - Auto-unpacks intermediate "folder" terms (e.g. DD. Premium / DD. Pulse).
 *    - Auto-zooms category depth (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3).
 *    - Adds dynamic collection filter bar.
 *    - Skips cards for collections with zero published products.
 *
 * 2. [bigtree_collection_products] - Used on LEAF collection terms:
 *    - Renders WooCommerce products with dynamic child category filter bar.
 *    - Adds "Add to List" (simple products) and "Download Image" action buttons.
 *
 * 3. [bigtree_all_selections_grid] - Used on the All Selections page:
 *    - Computed replacement for the manual Collections CPT.
 *    - Multi-select AND filtering.
 *    - Skips Selections with zero published products anywhere in their tree.
 */

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Category Ancestor Chain
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $term_id ) {
		static $chain_cache = [];
		if ( isset( $chain_cache[ $term_id ] ) ) {
			return $chain_cache[ $term_id ];
		}

		$term = get_term( $term_id, 'product_cat' );
		if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$lineage = [ $term ];
		$curr = $term;
		while ( $curr->parent != 0 ) {
			$parent = get_term( $curr->parent, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $parent || is_wp_error( $parent ) ) {
				break;
			}
			array_unshift( $lineage, $parent );
			$curr = $parent;
		}

		$chain = [];
		$level = 1;
		foreach ( $lineage as $item ) {
			$chain[ $level ] = $item;
			$level++;
		}

		$chain_cache[ $term_id ] = $chain;
		return $chain;
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 1: [bigtree_collection_grid] (Parent Collections)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( ! bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$direct_children = get_terms([
			'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
			'parent'     => $current_term->term_id,
			'hide_empty' => false,
		]);

		if ( empty( $direct_children ) || is_wp_error( $direct_children ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Auto-detect intermediate folder terms (e.g. DD Selection with 2 children)
		$has_subchildren_count = 0;
		foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
			if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
				$has_subchildren_count++;
			}
		}

		$display_terms = [];
		if ( count( $direct_children) <= 3 && $has_subchildren_count > 0 ) {
			foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
				if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
					$subs = get_terms([
						'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
						'parent'     => $child->term_id,
						'hide_empty' => false,
					]);
					if ( ! empty( $subs ) && ! is_wp_error( $subs ) ) {
						foreach ( $subs as $s ) {
							$display_terms[] = $s;
						}
					}
				} else {
					$display_terms[] = $child;
				}
			}
		} else {
			$display_terms = $direct_children;
		}

		if ( empty( $display_terms ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Gather categories and chains
		$cards_raw          = [];
		$all_chains_by_card = [];

		foreach ( $display_terms as $card_term ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $card_term->term_id, 'collection' );

			$product_ids = get_posts([
				'post_type'   => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish', // Only count live products
				'numberposts' => 20,
				'fields'      => 'ids',
				'tax_query'   => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field'    => 'term_id',
						'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			// Skip this card entirely if it has zero published products
			if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $card_term->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $card_term );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$chains_for_this_card = [];
			foreach ( $product_ids as $pid ) {
				$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' );
				if ( $prod_cats && ! is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
					foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
						$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
						if ( ! empty( $chain ) ) {
							$chains_for_this_card[] = $chain;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			$cards_raw[] = [
				'term'      => $card_term,
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'term_link' => $term_link,
			];
			$all_chains_by_card[ $card_term->term_id ] = $chains_for_this_card;
		}

		if ( empty( $cards_raw ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Adaptive depth selection
		$l1_terms = [];
		$l2_terms = [];
		$l3_terms = [];

		foreach ( $all_chains_by_card as $card_chains ) {
			foreach ( $card_chains as $chain ) {
				if ( isset( $chain[1] ) ) $l1_terms[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[2] ) ) $l2_terms[ $chain[2]->term_id ] = $chain[2]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[3] ) ) $l3_terms[ $chain[3]->term_id ] = $chain[3]->name;
			}
		}

		if ( count( $l1_terms ) >= 3 ) {
			$target_level = 1;
		} elseif ( count( $l2_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 2;
		} elseif ( count( $l3_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 3;
		} else {
			$target_level = ! empty( $l2_terms ) ? 2 : 1;
		}

		$cards_data        = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $cards_raw as $card ) {
			$cid    = $card['term']->term_id;
			$chains = $all_chains_by_card[ $cid ];

			$card_cat_names = [];
			$card_cat_slugs = [];

			foreach ( $chains as $chain ) {
				$term_at_level = isset( $chain[ $target_level ] ) ? $chain[ $target_level ] : ( isset( $chain[1] ) ? $chain[1] : null );

				if ( $term_at_level ) {
					$slug = sanitize_title( $term_at_level->slug );
					$name = $term_at_level->name;

					$card_cat_names[ $slug ]    = $name;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $slug ]    = $slug;
					$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
				}
			}

			if ( empty( $card_cat_names ) ) {
				$fallback = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $cid );
				foreach ( $fallback as $fname ) {
					$fslug = sanitize_title( $fname );
					$card_cat_names[ $fslug ]    = $fname;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $fslug ]    = $fslug;
					$available_filters[ $fslug ] = $fname;
				}
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term'           => $card['term'],
				'image_url'      => $card['image_url'],
				'term_link'      => $card['term_link'],
				'category_names' => array_values( $card_cat_names ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $card_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="grid">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $card['term']->name ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_grid', 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 2: [bigtree_collection_products] (Leaf Pages With Actions & Filter)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_products_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$products = wc_get_products([
			'status'    => 'publish',
			'limit'     => -1,
			'orderby'   => 'menu_order',
			'order'     => 'ASC',
			'tax_query' => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => 'collection',
					'field'    => 'term_id',
					'terms'    => $current_term->term_id,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $products ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		// Flag so footer prints the Card Actions JS and CSS
		$GLOBALS['bigtree_card_actions_needed'] = true;

		$products_data     = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $products as $product ) {
			$product_id   = $product->get_id();
			$thumb_id     = get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id );
			
			// Display image (Full fallback to medium_large)
			$image_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'full' ) : '';
			if ( ! $image_url ) {
				$image_url = function_exists( 'bigtree_get_card_image_url' )
					? bigtree_get_card_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' )
					: wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' );
			}

			// Download image (Always original full attachment)
			$download_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'full' ) : '';

			// Only simple, purchasable, in-stock products can be quick-added to the list
			$can_quick_add = $product->is_type( 'simple' )
				&& $product->is_purchasable()
				&& $product->is_in_stock();

			$product_link = get_permalink( $product_id );

			$cat_terms       = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			$child_cat_names = [];
			$child_cat_slugs = [];

			if ( $cat_terms && ! is_wp_error( $cat_terms ) ) {
				foreach ( $cat_terms as $cat_term ) {
					if ( $cat_term->parent !== 0 ) {
						$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_term->slug );
						$name = $cat_term->name;

						$child_cat_names[ $slug ]   = $name;
						$child_cat_slugs[ $slug ]   = $slug;
						$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
					}
				}
			}

			$products_data[] = [
				'id'            => $product_id,
				'name'          => $product->get_name(),
				'image_url'     => $image_url,
				'download_url'  => $download_url,
				'can_quick_add' => $can_quick_add,
				'link'          => $product_link,
				'cat_names'     => array_values( $child_cat_names ),
				'cat_slugs'     => array_keys( $child_cat_slugs ),
			];
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="products">

			<!-- DYNAMIC PRODUCT FILTER BAR (Only if > 1 child category) -->
			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : ?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( strtoupper( $name ) ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
				</div>
			<?php endif; ?>

			<!-- PRODUCT CARDS GRID -->
			<div class="bigtree-collection-product-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $products_data as $p ) :
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $p['cat_slugs'] );
				?>
					<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card"
					     data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>"
					     data-product-id="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['id'] ); ?>">

						<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $p['link'] ); ?>" class="bigtree-collection-product-card-link">
							<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image">
								<?php if ( $p['image_url'] ) : ?>
									<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $p['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['name'] ); ?>" loading="lazy">
								<?php endif; ?>
							</div>

							<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $p['name'] ); ?></div>

							<?php if ( ! empty( $p['cat_names'] ) ) : ?>
								<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $p['cat_names'] ) ); ?></div>
							<?php endif; ?>
						</a>

						<?php do_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions', $p ); ?>
					</div>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_products', 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' );
}

add_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions', function( $p ) {

	?>
	<div class="bigtree-card-actions">

			        class="bigtree-card-btn bigtree-card-add"

			        aria-label="<?php echo esc_attr( sprintf( 'Add %s to list', $p['name'] ) ); ?>">
```
