        $js   = <<<'JS'
(function(){
var roots=document.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg');
if(!roots.length){return;}
var Q={o:'f_out',fr:'f_flame',y:'f_type',m:'f_mat',c:'f_col',p:'f_proj',s:'f_sel'};
var MULTI=['y','m','c','p','s'];
function read(search){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(search),st={o:0,fr:0,y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};
  if(sp.get(Q.o)){st.o=1;}
  if(sp.get(Q.fr)){st.fr=1;}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){var v=sp.get(Q[k]);if(v){st[k]=v.split(',').filter(Boolean);}});
  return st;
}
function qs(st){
  var a=[];
  if(st.o){a.push(Q.o+'=1');}
  if(st.fr){a.push(Q.fr+'=1');}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){if(st[k].length){a.push(Q[k]+'='+st[k].map(encodeURIComponent).join(','));}});
  return a.join('&');
}
function pageUrl(q){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  Object.keys(Q).forEach(function(k){sp.delete(Q[k]);});
  var all=[sp.toString(),q].filter(Boolean).join('&');
  return location.pathname+(all?'?'+all:'');
}
roots.forEach(function(root){
  if(root.getAttribute('data-init')){return;}
  root.setAttribute('data-init','1');
  var bar=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-bar'),grid=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-grid'),count=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-count');
  var cat=root.getAttribute('data-category'),rest=root.getAttribute('data-rest');
  var st=read(location.search),ctl=null;
  var view='small';
  try{view=localStorage.getItem('btLgView')==='big'?'big':'small';}catch(e){}
  function setView(v){
    view=v;
    root.classList.toggle('bt-lg-view-big',v==='big');
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-viewbtn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('is-on',b.getAttribute('data-view')===v);});
    try{localStorage.setItem('btLgView',v);}catch(e){}
  }
  setView(view);
  function load(push){
    var q=qs(st);
    if(ctl){ctl.abort();}
    ctl=('AbortController' in window)?new AbortController():null;
    root.classList.add('is-loading');
    fetch(rest+'?category='+encodeURIComponent(cat)+(q?'&'+q:''),{credentials:'same-origin',signal:ctl?ctl.signal:undefined})
      .then(function(r){if(!r.ok){throw new Error('bad');}return r.json();})
      .then(function(d){
        var sp=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel'),sTop=sp?sp.scrollTop:0;
        bar.innerHTML=d.bar;grid.innerHTML=d.grid;
        applyOpen();
        var sp2=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel');if(sp2){sp2.scrollTop=sTop;}
        count.textContent=d.count+(d.count===1?' product':' products');
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        if(push){history.pushState({bt:1},'',pageUrl(q));}
      })
      .catch(function(e){
        if(e&&e.name==='AbortError'){return;}
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        location.href=pageUrl(q);
      });
  }
  function toggle(f,v){
    if(f==='o'||f==='fr'){st[f]=st[f]?0:1;return;}
    var i=st[f].indexOf(v);
    if(i>-1){st[f].splice(i,1);}else{st[f].push(v);}
  }
  var openF=null;
  function applyOpen(){
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-dd').forEach(function(g){
      var on=(g.getAttribute('data-facet')===openF);
      g.classList.remove('is-right');
      g.classList.toggle('is-open',on);
      var b=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
      if(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');}
      if(on){
        var p=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-panel');
        if(p&&p.getBoundingClientRect().right>window.innerWidth-8){g.classList.add('is-right');}
      }
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(openF&&!e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd')){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'&&openF){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  root.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var d=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
    if(d&&root.contains(d)){
      var fk=d.parentNode.getAttribute('data-facet');
      openF=(openF===fk)?null:fk;
      applyOpen();
      return;
    }
    var t=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-pill,.bt-lg-chip,.bt-lg-clear,.bt-lg-viewbtn');
    if(!t||!root.contains(t)){return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-viewbtn')){setView(t.getAttribute('data-view'));return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-clear')){st={o:0,fr:0,y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};}
    else{toggle(t.getAttribute('data-facet'),t.getAttribute('data-value'));}
    load(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){st=read(location.search);load(false);});
});
})();
JS;
        return '<style id="bt-lg-css">' . $css . '</style><script id="bt-lg-js" data-cfasync="false">' . $js . '</script>';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_notice' ) ) {
    /** Setup problems are shown to administrators only. Visitors see nothing. */
    function bigtree_lg_notice( $msg ) {
        return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ? '<p class="bt-lg-notice">[bigtree_category_products] ' . esc_html( $msg ) . '</p>' : '';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' ) ) {
    function bigtree_category_products_shortcode( $atts ) {
        if ( ! bigtree_lg_ready() ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The Data Layer and Tile Index snippets must be active.' );
        }
        $atts = shortcode_atts( array( 'category' => '' ), $atts, 'bigtree_category_products' );
        $term = null;
        if ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) {
            $term = bigtree_lg_term( $atts['category'] );
        } elseif ( is_tax( 'product_cat' ) ) {
            $term = get_queried_object();
        }
        if ( ! $term ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'No category found. Use category="slug" or place it on a product category page.' );
        }
        if ( 'products' !== bigtree_cat_page_mode( $term ) ) {
            return ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) ? bigtree_lg_notice( 'This category shows category tiles, not products. Use [bigtree_category_tiles] here.' ) : '';
        }
        $index = bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ) );
        if ( ! $index ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The index for this branch is not built yet.' );
        }
        $flt = bigtree_lg_parse( $_GET ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
        $pay = bigtree_lg_payload( $index, (int) $term->term_id, $flt );

        $html  = '<div class="bt-cat-wrapper bt-lg" data-category="' . esc_attr( $term->slug ) . '" data-rest="' . esc_url( rest_url( 'bigtree/v1/category-grid' ) ) . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-sticky"><div class="bt-lg-top"><span class="bt-lg-count" aria-live="polite">' . (int) $pay['count'] . ( 1 === (int) $pay['count'] ? ' product' : ' products' ) . '</span>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-view"><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn is-on" data-view="small" aria-label="Small grid view" title="Small grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-small" aria-hidden="true"></span></button><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn" data-view="big" aria-label="Large grid view" title="Large grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-big" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-bar">' . $pay['bar'] . '</div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-grid">' . $pay['grid'] . '</div></div>';
        return $html . bigtree_lg_assets();
    }
}
add_shortcode( 'bigtree_category_products', 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' );

- **Status:** `INACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-11-25 13:13:54`

- **Defined Functions:** _Closures / Inline_

```php
/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Wallcoverings (onboarding)
 *
 * Adds the Wallcoverings top-level category (slug "wallcoverings") to the two lists the
 * category-page engine reads, through its existing filters:
 *  1. bigtree_cat_index_tops - gets a cached index (Step 2).
 *  2. bigtree_tc_tops        - the Elementor condition "BigTree: Category pages (indexed only)"
 *                              applies to it, so the new template draws Wallcoverings pages (Step 4).
 *
 * Needs: Data Layer, Tile Index and Template Condition snippets.
 * Rollback of the live switch only: delete the bigtree_tc_tops block below (or comment it out).
 * Full rollback: deactivate this snippet.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_index_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'wallcoverings', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'wallcoverings';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_tc_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'wallcoverings', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'wallcoverings';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);
```

- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** `slug`, `id`, `bt_cat_debug`
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_cat_norm()`, `bigtree_cat_kw_regex()`, `bigtree_cat_features_map()`, `bigtree_cat_features_role()`, `bigtree_cat_features_label()`, `bigtree_cat_material_rules()`, `bigtree_cat_material_strip()`, `bigtree_cat_material_ignore()`, `bigtree_cat_material_families()`, `bigtree_cat_material_exact_map()`, `bigtree_cat_material_families_for_top()`, `bigtree_cat_color_rules()`, `bigtree_cat_color_ignore()`, `bigtree_cat_color_is_ignored()`, `bigtree_cat_color_exact_map()`, `bigtree_cat_color_family()`, `bigtree_cat_collapse_rules()`, `bigtree_cat_get_term()`, `bigtree_cat_is_collapsed()`, `bigtree_cat_branch_has_products()`, `bigtree_cat_hidden_branches()`, `bigtree_cat_published_ids()`, `bigtree_cat_children()`, `bigtree_cat_page_mode()`, `bigtree_cat_top_slug()`, `bigtree_cat_sort_compare()`, `bigtree_cat_facet_registry()`, `bigtree_cat_facets_for()`, `bigtree_cat_terms()`, `bigtree_cat_product_collection()`, `bigtree_cat_product_facets()`, `bigtree_cat_selftest()`, `bigtree_cat_debug_report()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Data Layer (Step 1 of 5)
 *
 * Definitions and helpers only. Nothing is rendered on public pages.
 * The only output is an admin-only report: while logged in as an administrator,
 * add ?bt_cat_debug=help to any front-end URL.
 *
 * Rules of this layer:
 * - Terms are read by taxonomy and by name, never by CSV column position.
 * - Every mapping lives in one function below, so it can be edited in one place.
 * - Existing snippets (PHP Product Archive Engine, Sort Products by Collection) are not touched.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

if ( ! defined( 'BIGTREE_CAT_DATA_LAYER' ) ) {
	define( 'BIGTREE_CAT_DATA_LAYER', '1.1.0' );
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 1. NORMALISATION AND KEYWORD MATCHING
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_norm' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Lowercase, decode entities, tidy spaces around "&" and brackets.
	 * "Marine(interior)" and "Marine (interior)" both become "marine (interior)".
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_norm( $s ) {
		$s = html_entity_decode( (string) $s, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
		$s = function_exists( 'mb_strtolower' ) ? mb_strtolower( $s, 'UTF-8' ) : strtolower( $s );
		$s = str_replace( "\xC2\xA0", ' ', $s );
		$s = preg_replace( '/\s*&\s*/u', ' & ', $s );
		$s = preg_replace( '/\s*\(\s*/u', ' (', $s );
		$s = preg_replace( '/\s*\)\s*/u', ') ', $s );
		$s = preg_replace( '/\s+/u', ' ', $s );
		return trim( $s );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_kw_regex' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Whole-word regex for a keyword list. Longest keywords first so phrases win.
	 * Optional plural suffix. "ash" matches "Ash Veneer" but not "Cashmere".
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_kw_regex( $keywords, $plural = true ) {
		$norm = array();
		foreach ( $keywords as $kw ) {
			$norm[] = bigtree_cat_norm( $kw );
		}
		usort(
			$norm,
			function ( $a, $b ) {
				return strlen( $b ) - strlen( $a );
			}
		);
		$parts = array();
		foreach ( $norm as $kw ) {
			$parts[] = preg_quote( $kw, '/' );
		}
		return '/(?<![\p{L}])(?:' . implode( '|', $parts ) . ')' . ( $plural ? '(?:e?s)?' : '' ) . '(?![\p{L}])/u';
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 2. FEATURES ATTRIBUTE: TERM TO ROLE MAP
 * One global attribute (pa_features) holds several different ideas.
 * Roles: outdoor, indoor, project, flame, performance, ignore.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_features_map' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_features_map() {
		$map = array(
			// Outdoor switch. Off = whole catalogue. On = products carrying this term.
			'outdoor'     => array( 'outdoor' ),
			// Kept so the report is complete. No filter uses it.
			'indoor'      => array( 'indoor' ),
			// "Project Type" multi-select.
			'project'     => array(
				'contract',
				'hospitality',
				'residential',
				'healthcare',
				'workplace',
				'workspace',
				'aviation',
				'marine',
				'marine (interior)',
				'mobility',
				'crèche/fitness',
				'creche/fitness',
			),
			// Flame Retardant switch.
			'flame'       => array( 'flame retardant' ),
			// Parked until the Fabrics category is built.
			'performance' => array(
				'antibacterial',
				'color fastness',
				'color pilling',
				'color resistance',
				'durability',
				'pilling',
				'seam slippage',
				'shrinkage wet',
				'thermal resistance',
				'weather resistance',
			),
			// Not shown anywhere.
			'ignore'      => array( 'furniture', 'upholstery', 'n/a' ),
		);
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_features_map', $map );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_features_role' ) ) {
	/** Returns outdoor|indoor|project|flame|performance|ignore|unmapped */
	function bigtree_cat_features_role( $term_name ) {
		static $flip = null;
		if ( null === $flip ) {
			$flip = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_features_map() as $role => $names ) {
				foreach ( $names as $name ) {
					$flip[ bigtree_cat_norm( $name ) ] = $role;
				}
			}
		}
		$key = bigtree_cat_norm( $term_name );
		return isset( $flip[ $key ] ) ? $flip[ $key ] : 'unmapped';
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_features_label' ) ) {
	/** Display label. Merges the two Marine (interior) spellings. */
	function bigtree_cat_features_label( $term_name ) {
		$decoded = html_entity_decode( (string) $term_name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
		if ( 'marine (interior)' === bigtree_cat_norm( $decoded ) ) {
			return 'Marine (interior)';
		}
		return trim( $decoded );
	}
}

 * Anything unmatched falls to "Other". Components such as Foam, Chipboard,
 * Fiberboard and Furniture Board are deliberately unmatched, so they land in Other.
 * ===================================================================== */

			),

			),

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_strip' ) ) {
	/** Phrases removed before matching, to avoid false positives. */
	function bigtree_cat_material_strip() {
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_material_strip', array( 'chrome tanned', 'brass-free', 'brass free' ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_ignore' ) ) {
	/** Values that carry no material information. They produce no family at all. */
	function bigtree_cat_material_ignore() {
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_material_ignore', array( 'n/a', 'none', '0', '-' ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_families' ) ) {
	/** Returns a list of family keys. Always at least ['other']. */
	function bigtree_cat_material_families( $term_name ) {
		static $cache = array(), $re = null;
		$n = bigtree_cat_norm( $term_name );
		if ( isset( $cache[ $n ] ) ) {
			return $cache[ $n ];
		}
		if ( in_array( $n, array_map( 'bigtree_cat_norm', bigtree_cat_material_ignore() ), true ) ) {
			$cache[ $n ] = array();
			return array();
		}
		if ( null === $re ) {
			$re = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_material_rules() as $key => $rule ) {
				if ( ! empty( $rule['kw'] ) ) {
					$re[ $key ] = bigtree_cat_kw_regex( $rule['kw'], true );
				}
			}
		}
		$scan = $n;
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_material_strip() as $phrase ) {
			$scan = str_replace( bigtree_cat_norm( $phrase ), ' ', $scan );
		}
		$found = array();
		foreach ( $re as $key => $regex ) {
			if ( preg_match( $regex, $scan ) ) {
				$found[] = $key;
			}
		}
		if ( empty( $found ) ) {
			$found = array( 'other' );
		}
		$cache[ $n ] = $found;
		return $found;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_exact_map' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Exact term to family map, per top-level category, for where keyword rules are too coarse (rugs).
	 * A top-level category listed here uses ONLY this map for its products; every other category keeps the keyword rules.
	 * Family keys double as the filter labels (hyphens become spaces, words are capitalised).
	 * Terms not listed fall into 'other', so a new term is visible and never silently lost.
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_material_exact_map() {
		return apply_filters(
			'bigtree_cat_material_exact_map',
			array(
				'floor-coverings' => array(
					'Wool'               => 'wool',
					'Premium Wool'       => 'wool',
					'Decolan'            => 'decolan',
					'Premium Decolan'    => 'decolan',
					'Polyester'          => 'polyester',
					'PES'                => 'polyester',
					'Premium PES'        => 'polyester',
					'Polyester (rPET)'   => 'recycled-polyester',
					'Olyna®'             => 'olyna',
					'Viscose'            => 'viscose',
					'Rayon'              => 'viscose',
					'Bamboo Silk'        => 'bamboo-silk',
					'Artificial Silk'    => 'artificial-silk',
					'Jute'               => 'jute',
					'Hemp Indo-Nepalese' => 'hemp',
					'Cotton Chenille'    => 'cotton-chenille',
					'Recyclable Plastic' => 'recyclable-plastic',
				),
			)
		);
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_families_for_top' ) ) {
	/** Material family keys for one composition term, using the top-level category's exact map when it has one. */
	function bigtree_cat_material_families_for_top( $term_name, $top_slug ) {
		static $maps = null;
		if ( null === $maps ) {
			$maps = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_material_exact_map() as $top => $map ) {
				foreach ( $map as $term => $family ) {
					$maps[ $top ][ bigtree_cat_norm( $term ) ] = $family;
				}
			}
		}
		if ( $top_slug && isset( $maps[ $top_slug ] ) ) {
			$n = bigtree_cat_norm( $term_name );
			if ( in_array( $n, array_map( 'bigtree_cat_norm', bigtree_cat_material_ignore() ), true ) ) {
				return array();
			}
			return array( isset( $maps[ $top_slug ][ $n ] ) ? $maps[ $top_slug ][ $n ] : 'other' );
		}
		return bigtree_cat_material_families( $term_name );
	}
}

/* Label-only family entries (no keywords, so they never match by keyword). They give tile pages a bit position for each exact-map family. */
add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_material_rules',
	function ( $rules ) {
		$extra = array( 'wool', 'decolan', 'polyester', 'recycled-polyester', 'olyna', 'viscose', 'bamboo-silk', 'artificial-silk', 'jute', 'hemp', 'cotton-chenille', 'recyclable-plastic' );
		foreach ( $extra as $k ) {
			if ( ! isset( $rules[ $k ] ) ) {
				$rules[ $k ] = array(
					'label' => ucwords( str_replace( '-', ' ', $k ) ),
					'kw'    => array(),
				);
			}
		}
		return $rules;
	}
);

/* ========================================================================
 * 4. COLOR FAMILIES (from pa_color)
 * Basic families chosen by BigTree, plus Metallic, Mixed and Other.
 * Method: scan for family keywords. One family found = that family.
 * Several found with a separator ("Black & White") = Mixed.
 * Several found without a separator ("Almond Green") = the LAST one wins,
 * because the colour noun usually comes last in English.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_color_ignore' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Values stored in Color that are not colors: placeholders, instructions, design names.
	 * They produce no color family at all (not even Other).
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_color_ignore() {
		$ignore = array(
			'exact' => array( 'n/a', '0', '-', 'none', 'refer to images for color finishes', 'varies on design', 'massai', 'newlin', 'boheme', 'mouchete', 'tribal', 'patio' ),
			'regex' => array( '/^category \d/u', '/fabric collection \d/u', '/^refer to images/u' ),
		);
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_color_ignore', $ignore );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_color_is_ignored' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_color_is_ignored( $norm ) {
		$ig = bigtree_cat_color_ignore();
		if ( '' === $norm || in_array( $norm, array_map( 'bigtree_cat_norm', $ig['exact'] ), true ) ) {
			return true;
		}
		foreach ( $ig['regex'] as $re ) {
			if ( preg_match( $re, $norm ) ) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}

				'beige'    => array( 'mushroom', 'sesame', 'greige', 'putty', 'dust', 'vanilla', 'marzipan', 'nata', 'calico', 'stucco', 'pergamena', 'cashmere', 'canvas', 'dune', 'sahara', 'desert', 'tofu', 'coconut', 'pudding', 'naturel', 'raffia', 'jute', 'seagrass', 'bamboo', 'straw', 'rattan', 'sponge', 'string', 'castor', 'antique', 'driftwood', 'earth tone light' ),
				'brown'    => array( 'brownie', 'cacao', 'cappuccino', 'moka', 'nut', 'nougat', 'russet', 'auburn', 'redwood', 'rosewood', 'cuoio', 'avana', 'teak', 'praline', 'toast', 'pinecone', 'mud', 'earth', 'earth tone dark', 'wood', 'brandy', 'tiramisu', 'palissandro' ),
				'red'      => array( 'brick', 'strawberry', 'marsala', 'sangria', 'passion', 'fire', 'watermelon' ),
				'blue'     => array( 'cadet', 'peacock', 'lagoon', 'hydro', 'water', 'safira', 'malibu', 'duckegg' ),
				'green'    => array( 'celery', 'kiwi', 'lima', 'lichen', 'linden', 'oasis', 'avocat', 'basil', 'grass', 'leaf', 'garden', 'cactus', 'palm', 'cypress', 'seafoam', 'apple', 'hunter', 'iguana' ),
				'yellow'   => array( 'honey', 'sunshine', 'corn', 'banana', 'sun', 'forsithia', 'primrose', 'butterscotch', 'butternut' ),
				'orange'   => array( 'autumn', 'spice', 'ginger', 'sunset', 'harvest', 'mango', 'terra', 'corten' ),
				'pink'     => array( 'rosewater', 'peony', 'blossom', 'petal', 'honeysuckle', 'sorbet', 'raspberry', 'cameo', 'dahlia' ),
				'purple'   => array( 'iris', 'crocus', 'wisteria', 'heather', 'hyacinth', 'lavanda' ),
				'metallic' => array( 'iron', 'alloy', 'zinc' ),
				'black'    => array( 'pepper' ),
			);
			$groups = apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_color_exact_map', $groups );
			$flip   = array();
			foreach ( $groups as $family => $names ) {
				foreach ( $names as $name ) {
					$flip[ bigtree_cat_norm( $name ) ] = $family;
				}
			}
		}
		return $flip;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_color_family' ) ) {
	/** Returns a single color family key. */
	function bigtree_cat_color_family( $term_name ) {
		static $cache = array(), $re = null, $map = null;
		$n = bigtree_cat_norm( $term_name );
		if ( isset( $cache[ $n ] ) ) {
			return $cache[ $n ];
		}
		if ( bigtree_cat_color_is_ignored( $n ) ) {
			$cache[ $n ] = 'ignore';
			return 'ignore';
		}
		$exact = bigtree_cat_color_exact_map();
		if ( isset( $exact[ $n ] ) ) {
			$cache[ $n ] = $exact[ $n ];
			return $exact[ $n ];
		}
		if ( preg_match( '/^[\d\s.\-\/#]*$/u', $n ) ) {
			$cache[ $n ] = 'other';
			return 'other';
		}
		if ( null === $re ) {
			$map = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_color_rules() as $key => $rule ) {
				foreach ( $rule['kw'] as $kw ) {
					$map[ bigtree_cat_norm( $kw ) ] = $key;
				}
			}
			$re = bigtree_cat_kw_regex( array_keys( $map ), false );
		}
		$hits = array();
		if ( preg_match_all( $re, $n, $m, PREG_SET_ORDER | PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE ) ) {
			foreach ( $m as $set ) {
				$text = $set[0][0];
				$pos  = $set[0][1];
				if ( isset( $map[ $text ] ) ) {
					$hits[] = array( $map[ $text ], $pos );
				}
			}
		}
		if ( empty( $hits ) ) {
			$family = 'other';
		} else {
			$families = array();
			$last     = '';
			$last_pos = -1;
			foreach ( $hits as $h ) {
				$families[ $h[0] ] = true;
				if ( $h[1] >= $last_pos ) {
					$last_pos = $h[1];
					$last     = $h[0];
				}
			}
			if ( isset( $families['mixed'] ) ) {
				$family = 'mixed';
			} elseif ( count( $families ) > 1 && preg_match( '/[\/&+,|]| and /u', $n ) ) {
				$family = 'mixed';
			} else {
				$family = $last;
			}
		}
		$cache[ $n ] = $family;
		return $family;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 5. COLLAPSE RULES (the Sofas fix)
 * A matched category behaves as a leaf. Its child categories become the Type filter.
 * Matching is by NAME under a parent slug, so duplicate slugs such as
 * "linear" and "linear-sofas" are both covered. Edit this list when the CSVs are fixed.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_collapse_rules' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_collapse_rules() {
		$rules = array(
			array(
				'parent_slug' => 'sofas',
				'under_slug'  => 'furniture',
				'names'       => array( 'linear', 'linear sofas', 'modular & sectionals', 'modular and sectionals', 'modular sectionals', 'modular & sectional' ),
			),
		);
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_collapse_rules', $rules );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_get_term' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_get_term( $term, $taxonomy = 'product_cat' ) {
		if ( is_object( $term ) ) {
			return $term;
		}
		$t = get_term( (int) $term, $taxonomy );
		return ( $t && ! is_wp_error( $t ) ) ? $t : null;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_is_collapsed' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( $term ) {
		$term = bigtree_cat_get_term( $term );
		if ( ! $term || empty( $term->parent ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		$parent = bigtree_cat_get_term( (int) $term->parent );
		if ( ! $parent ) {
			return false;
		}
		$name = bigtree_cat_norm( $term->name );
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_collapse_rules() as $rule ) {
			if ( $parent->slug !== $rule['parent_slug'] ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( ! empty( $rule['under_slug'] ) ) {
				$ok = false;
				foreach ( get_ancestors( $parent->term_id, 'product_cat', 'taxonomy' ) as $aid ) {
					$a = bigtree_cat_get_term( $aid );
					if ( $a && $a->slug === $rule['under_slug'] ) {
						$ok = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if ( ! $ok ) {
					continue;
				}
			}
			$names = array_map( 'bigtree_cat_norm', $rule['names'] );
			if ( in_array( $name, $names, true ) ) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 6. CATEGORY TREE HELPERS
 * A page is either TILES (has non-empty child categories) or PRODUCTS (leaf or collapsed).
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_branch_has_products' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_branch_has_products( $term ) {
		$term = bigtree_cat_get_term( $term );
		if ( ! $term ) {
			return false;
		}
		if ( (int) $term->count > 0 ) {
			return true;
		}
		// Raw database counts can disagree with WooCommerce's adjusted counts,
		// so every descendant is checked against the adjusted count.
		$desc = get_terms(
			array(
				'taxonomy'   => 'product_cat',
				'child_of'   => (int) $term->term_id,
				'hide_empty' => false,
			)
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $desc ) || empty( $desc ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		foreach ( $desc as $d ) {
			if ( (int) $d->count > 0 ) {
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_hidden_branches' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Category slugs that never appear as tiles (and never count as children).
	 * Empty by default. Example: array( 'outdoor-furniture' ).
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_hidden_branches() {
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_hidden_branches', array() );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_published_ids' ) ) {
	/** Keeps only published product IDs from a list. */
	function bigtree_cat_published_ids( $ids ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$ids = array_values( array_filter( array_map( 'intval', (array) $ids ) ) );
		$out = array();
		foreach ( array_chunk( $ids, 1000 ) as $chunk ) {
			$in   = implode( ',', $chunk );
			$rows = $wpdb->get_col( "SELECT ID FROM {$wpdb->posts} WHERE post_type = 'product' AND post_status = 'publish' AND ID IN ({$in})" ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.DB.PreparedSQL.InterpolatedNotPrepared
			$out  = array_merge( $out, array_map( 'intval', (array) $rows ) );
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_children' ) ) {
	/** Direct child categories that contain at least one product somewhere below. */
	function bigtree_cat_children( $term_id ) {
		$kids = get_terms(
			array(
				'taxonomy'   => 'product_cat',
				'parent'     => (int) $term_id,
				'hide_empty' => false,
				'orderby'    => 'name',
			)
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $kids ) || empty( $kids ) ) {
			return array();
		}
		$out    = array();
		$hidden = bigtree_cat_hidden_branches();
		foreach ( $kids as $k ) {
			if ( in_array( $k->slug, $hidden, true ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			if ( bigtree_cat_branch_has_products( $k ) ) {
				$out[] = $k;
			}
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_page_mode' ) ) {
	/** Returns 'tiles' or 'products'. */
	function bigtree_cat_page_mode( $term ) {
		$term = bigtree_cat_get_term( $term );
		if ( ! $term ) {
			return 'products';
		}
		if ( bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( $term ) ) {
			return 'products';
		}
		return bigtree_cat_children( $term->term_id ) ? 'tiles' : 'products';
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_top_slug' ) ) {
	/** Slug of the top-level ancestor, used to choose a facet layout. */
	function bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ) {
		$term = bigtree_cat_get_term( $term );
		if ( ! $term ) {
			return '';
		}
		$anc = get_ancestors( $term->term_id, 'product_cat', 'taxonomy' );
		if ( empty( $anc ) ) {
			return $term->slug;
		}
		$top = bigtree_cat_get_term( end( $anc ) );
		return $top ? $top->slug : $term->slug;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 7. SORT: COLLECTION NAME A to Z, SYMBOLS AND NUMBERS LAST
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_sort_compare' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_sort_compare( $a, $b ) {
		$a = trim( html_entity_decode( (string) $a, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
		$b = trim( html_entity_decode( (string) $b, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
		$ga = ( '' === $a ) ? 2 : ( preg_match( '/^\p{L}/u', $a ) ? 0 : 1 );
		$gb = ( '' === $b ) ? 2 : ( preg_match( '/^\p{L}/u', $b ) ? 0 : 1 );
		if ( $ga !== $gb ) {
			return $ga - $gb;
		}
		return strnatcasecmp( $a, $b );
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 8. FACET REGISTRY
 * One list of facets, and one layout per page mode. Category-specific layouts
 * (for example Fabrics) are added to $layouts later without a new template.
 * A facet auto-hides when the current scope has fewer than 'min_values' values.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_facet_registry' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_facet_registry() {
		$facets = array(
			'outdoor'   => array( 'label' => 'Outdoor', 'control' => 'switch', 'source' => 'features_role', 'role' => 'outdoor' ),
			'type'      => array( 'label' => 'Type', 'control' => 'multi', 'source' => 'taxonomy', 'taxonomy' => 'pa_types' ),
			'material'  => array( 'label' => 'Material', 'control' => 'multi', 'source' => 'family', 'family' => 'material' ),
			'color'     => array( 'label' => 'Color', 'control' => 'swatch', 'source' => 'family', 'family' => 'color' ),
			'project'   => array( 'label' => 'Project Type', 'control' => 'multi', 'source' => 'features_role', 'role' => 'project' ),
			'flame'     => array( 'label' => 'Flame Retardant', 'control' => 'switch', 'source' => 'features_role', 'role' => 'flame' ),
			'selection' => array( 'label' => 'Selection', 'control' => 'multi', 'source' => 'taxonomy', 'taxonomy' => 'collection', 'level' => 'top' ),
		);
		$layouts = array(
			'default' => array(
				'tiles'    => array( 'outdoor', 'material', 'selection' ),
				'products' => array( 'outdoor', 'type', 'material', 'color', 'project', 'flame', 'selection' ),
			),
		);
		return apply_filters(
			'bigtree_cat_facet_registry',
			array(
				'facets'     => $facets,
				'layouts'    => $layouts,
				'min_values' => 2,
			)
		);
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_facets_for' ) ) {
	/** Facet keys for a top-level category slug and a page mode ('tiles' or 'products'). */
	function bigtree_cat_facets_for( $top_slug, $mode ) {
		$reg    = bigtree_cat_facet_registry();
		$layout = isset( $reg['layouts'][ $top_slug ] ) ? $reg['layouts'][ $top_slug ] : $reg['layouts']['default'];
		return isset( $layout[ $mode ] ) ? $layout[ $mode ] : array();
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 9. PRODUCT FACET VALUES
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_terms' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, $taxonomy ) {
		$t = get_the_terms( (int) $product_id, $taxonomy );
		return ( is_array( $t ) ) ? $t : array();
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_product_collection' ) ) {
	/** Deepest assigned collection term (the leaf) and its top-level Selection. */
	function bigtree_cat_product_collection( $product_id ) {
		$terms = bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'collection' );
		if ( empty( $terms ) ) {
			return array( 'leaf' => null, 'selection' => null );
		}
		$best       = null;
		$best_depth = -1;
		foreach ( $terms as $t ) {
			$depth = count( get_ancestors( $t->term_id, 'collection', 'taxonomy' ) );
			if ( $depth > $best_depth || ( $depth === $best_depth && $best && $t->term_id < $best->term_id ) ) {
				$best       = $t;
				$best_depth = $depth;
			}
		}
		$anc = get_ancestors( $best->term_id, 'collection', 'taxonomy' );
		$top = $best;
		if ( ! empty( $anc ) ) {
			$p = get_term( end( $anc ), 'collection' );
			if ( $p && ! is_wp_error( $p ) ) {
				$top = $p;
			}
		}
		return array( 'leaf' => $best, 'selection' => $top );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_product_facets' ) ) {
	/** Every filterable value for one product, already mapped. */
	function bigtree_cat_product_facets( $product_id ) {
		$out = array(
			'outdoor'     => false,
			'flame'       => false,
			'project'     => array(),
			'performance' => array(),
			'unmapped'    => array(),
			'material'    => array(),
			'color'       => array(),
			'type'        => array(),
			'style'       => array(),
			'collection'  => '',
			'selection'   => array( 'id' => 0, 'name' => '', 'slug' => '' ),
		);
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'pa_features' ) as $t ) {
			$role = bigtree_cat_features_role( $t->name );
			if ( 'outdoor' === $role ) {
				$out['outdoor'] = true;
			} elseif ( 'flame' === $role ) {
				$out['flame'] = true;
			} elseif ( 'project' === $role ) {
				$out['project'][ bigtree_cat_norm( bigtree_cat_features_label( $t->name ) ) ] = bigtree_cat_features_label( $t->name );
			} elseif ( 'performance' === $role ) {
				$out['performance'][] = bigtree_cat_features_label( $t->name );
			} elseif ( 'unmapped' === $role ) {
				$out['unmapped'][] = $t->name;
			}
		}
		$out['project'] = array_values( $out['project'] );
		$mat_cats = bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
		$mat_top  = $mat_cats ? bigtree_cat_top_slug( reset( $mat_cats ) ) : '';
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'pa_composition' ) as $t ) {
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_material_families_for_top( $t->name, $mat_top ) as $f ) {
				$out['material'][ $f ] = true;
			}
		}
		$out['material'] = array_keys( $out['material'] );
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'pa_color' ) as $t ) {
			$fam = bigtree_cat_color_family( $t->name );
			if ( 'ignore' !== $fam ) {
				$out['color'][ $fam ] = true;
			}
		}
		$out['color'] = array_keys( $out['color'] );
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'pa_types' ) as $t ) {
			$out['type'][] = array( 'slug' => $t->slug, 'name' => html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
		}
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $product_id, 'pa_style' ) as $t ) {
			$out['style'][] = array( 'slug' => $t->slug, 'name' => html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
		}
		$c = bigtree_cat_product_collection( $product_id );
		if ( $c['leaf'] ) {
			$out['collection'] = html_entity_decode( $c['leaf']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
			$out['selection']  = array(
				'id'   => (int) $c['selection']->term_id,
				'name' => html_entity_decode( $c['selection']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'slug' => $c['selection']->slug,
			);
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 10. SELF TEST (pure functions, no database)
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_selftest' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_selftest() {
		$cases = array();
		$feat  = array(
			'Indoor' => 'indoor', 'Outdoor' => 'outdoor', 'Flame Retardant' => 'flame', 'Contract' => 'project',
			'Marine(interior)' => 'project', 'Marine (interior)' => 'project', 'Crèche/Fitness' => 'project',
			'Weather Resistance' => 'performance', 'n/a' => 'ignore', 'Upholstery' => 'ignore', 'Something New' => 'unmapped',
		);
		foreach ( $feat as $in => $exp ) {
			$cases[] = array( 'features', $in, $exp, bigtree_cat_features_role( $in ) );
		}
		$mat = array(
			'Beech Wood' => 'wood', 'Aluminium and Teak' => 'metal,wood', '100% Polyester' => 'fabric', '14.Cotton' => 'fabric',
			'Calacatta Marble' => 'stone', 'Ceramic Stoneware' => 'ceramic', 'Chrome Tanned Raw Hides' => 'leather',
			'Foam' => 'other', 'Chipboard' => 'other', 'Furniture Board' => 'other', 'Fiberboard Frame' => 'other',
			'Alabaster & Glass' => 'glass,stone', 'Black Powdercoated Metal' => 'metal', 'American Walnut Veneered Board' => 'wood',
			'Bull Leather' => 'leather', 'Cement' => 'concrete', 'Bamboo' => 'natural', '5.Vi' => 'fabric',
			'Base Cloth: Brushed PES' => 'fabric', 'Cashmere' => 'fabric', 'Ash Veneer' => 'wood', 'Stainless Steel 304' => 'metal',
			'n/a' => '', 'PL FR (Trevira CS)' => 'fabric', 'WO' => 'fabric', 'Polyvinyl Chloride' => 'plastic', 'Legs: Wooden' => 'wood',
			'Linenghtly Buffed Natural Grain' => 'leather', 'Terracota' => 'ceramic', 'Metalic Mineral' => 'metal', 'Noce Travertin' => 'stone', '8.Lin' => 'fabric',
		);
		foreach ( $mat as $in => $exp ) {
			$got = bigtree_cat_material_families( $in );
			sort( $got );
			$cases[] = array( 'material', $in, $exp, implode( ',', $got ) );
		}
		$col = array(
			'Brown' => 'brown', 'Green' => 'green', 'Beige' => 'beige', 'Cream' => 'beige', 'Ochre' => 'yellow', 'Rose' => 'pink',
			'Taupe' => 'beige', 'PHI' => 'other', 'Mixed' => 'mixed', 'Metallic' => 'metallic', '01' => 'other', 'Aegean Blue' => 'blue',
			'Adobe Rose' => 'pink', 'Acid Green' => 'green', 'Almond Buff' => 'beige', 'Almond Green' => 'green', 'Agate Grey' => 'grey',
			'Alluminium' => 'metallic', 'Black & White' => 'mixed', 'Silver Grey' => 'grey', 'Rose Gold' => 'metallic', 'Off White' => 'beige',
			'Aloe Wash' => 'green', 'Abyss' => 'blue', 'Alabaster' => 'white', 'Aigue Marine' => 'blue', 'Akoya Pearl' => 'white',
			'Toffee' => 'brown', 'Mostaza' => 'yellow', 'Vino' => 'red', 'Océan' => 'blue', 'Ice' => 'white', 'Mushroom' => 'beige', 'n/a' => 'ignore',
			'Category 3' => 'ignore', 'Refer to images for color finishes: 01 | 05' => 'ignore', 'Massai' => 'ignore', 'Sienna' => 'brown', 'Eggplant' => 'purple',
			'Brick' => 'red', 'Lavender Mist' => 'purple', 'Mist' => 'grey', 'White | Bronze Emboss | Champagne Emboss' => 'mixed', 'Earthy Orange' => 'orange',
		);
		foreach ( $col as $in => $exp ) {
			$cases[] = array( 'color', $in, $exp, bigtree_cat_color_family( $in ) );
		}
		$names = array( '1965', 'Zeta', '#', 'Albi', '3D Printed Outdoor Furniture', 'ABERDEEN', '', 'Alicante Set' );
		usort( $names, 'bigtree_cat_sort_compare' );
		$cases[] = array( 'sort', 'mixed list', 'ABERDEEN|Albi|Alicante Set|Zeta|#|3D Printed Outdoor Furniture|1965|(empty)', implode( '|', array_map( function ( $n ) { return '' === $n ? '(empty)' : $n; }, $names ) ) );

		$out    = array();
		$failed = 0;
		foreach ( $cases as $c ) {
			$ok = ( $c[2] === $c[3] );
			if ( ! $ok ) {
				$failed++;
			}
			$out[] = array( 'area' => $c[0], 'input' => $c[1], 'expected' => $c[2], 'actual' => $c[3], 'ok' => $ok );
		}
		return array( 'total' => count( $cases ), 'failed' => $failed, 'cases' => $out );
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 11. ADMIN-ONLY DEBUG REPORT
 * Works only for logged-in administrators. Read-only. Plain text JSON.
 * To switch it off completely, add to wp-config.php: define( 'BIGTREE_CAT_DEBUG_OFF', true );
 * Sections: help, selftest, features, material, color, types, registry, collapse, tree&slug=furniture, product&id=123
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_debug_report' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_debug_report( $section ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$limit = 250;

		if ( 'selftest' === $section ) {
			return bigtree_cat_selftest();
		}

		if ( 'registry' === $section ) {
			return array(
				'registry'    => bigtree_cat_facet_registry(),
				'layouts_for' => array(
					'furniture_tiles'    => bigtree_cat_facets_for( 'furniture', 'tiles' ),
					'furniture_products' => bigtree_cat_facets_for( 'furniture', 'products' ),
				),
			);
		}

		if ( 'features' === $section ) {
			$terms = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'pa_features', 'hide_empty' => false ) );
			if ( is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
				return array( 'error' => $terms->get_error_message() );
			}
			$rows = array();
			$by   = array();
			foreach ( $terms as $t ) {
				$role = bigtree_cat_features_role( $t->name );
				$rows[] = array( 'name' => html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ), 'slug' => $t->slug, 'products' => (int) $t->count, 'role' => $role );
				$by[ $role ] = isset( $by[ $role ] ) ? $by[ $role ] + 1 : 1;
			}
			return array( 'terms_total' => count( $rows ), 'terms_per_role' => $by, 'terms' => $rows );
		}

		if ( 'material' === $section || 'color' === $section ) {
			$tax   = ( 'material' === $section ) ? 'pa_composition' : 'pa_color';
			$terms = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => $tax, 'hide_empty' => false ) );
			if ( is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
				return array( 'error' => $terms->get_error_message() );
			}
			$dist   = array();
			$sample = array();
			$other  = array();
			foreach ( $terms as $t ) {
				$name = html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
				$fams = ( 'material' === $section ) ? bigtree_cat_material_families( $name ) : array( bigtree_cat_color_family( $name ) );
				if ( empty( $fams ) ) {
					$fams = array( 'ignore' );
				}
				foreach ( $fams as $f ) {
					if ( ! isset( $dist[ $f ] ) ) {
						$dist[ $f ] = array( 'terms' => 0, 'product_links' => 0 );
					}
					$dist[ $f ]['terms']++;
					$dist[ $f ]['product_links'] += (int) $t->count;
					if ( 'other' === $f ) {
						$other[] = array( $name, (int) $t->count );
					} else {
						$sample[ $f ][] = array( $name, (int) $t->count );
					}
				}
			}
			usort( $other, function ( $a, $b ) { return $b[1] - $a[1]; } );
			$samples = array();
			foreach ( $sample as $f => $list ) {
				usort( $list, function ( $a, $b ) { return $b[1] - $a[1]; } );
				$samples[ $f ] = array_map( function ( $r ) { return $r[0] . ' (' . $r[1] . ')'; }, array_slice( $list, 0, 12 ) );
			}
			return array(
				'taxonomy'             => $tax,
				'terms_total'          => count( $terms ),
				'distribution'         => $dist,
				'other_total'          => count( $other ),
				'other_top_by_products' => array_map( function ( $r ) { return $r[0] . ' (' . $r[1] . ')'; }, array_slice( $other, 0, $limit ) ),
				'sample_per_family'    => $samples,
			);
		}

		if ( 'types' === $section ) {
			$terms = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'pa_types', 'hide_empty' => false ) );
			if ( is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
				return array( 'error' => $terms->get_error_message() );
			}
			$rows = array();
			foreach ( $terms as $t ) {
				if ( (int) $t->count > 0 ) {
					$rows[] = array( html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ), (int) $t->count );
				}
			}
			usort( $rows, function ( $a, $b ) { return $b[1] - $a[1]; } );
			return array(
				'terms_total'    => count( $terms ),
				'terms_in_use'   => count( $rows ),
				'top_by_products' => array_map( function ( $r ) { return $r[0] . ' (' . $r[1] . ')'; }, array_slice( $rows, 0, 120 ) ),
			);
		}

		if ( 'collapse' === $section ) {
			$found = array();
			$all   = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'product_cat', 'hide_empty' => false ) );
			if ( ! is_wp_error( $all ) ) {
				foreach ( $all as $t ) {
					if ( bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( $t ) ) {
						$kids    = bigtree_cat_children( $t->term_id );
						$found[] = array(
							'id'              => (int) $t->term_id,
							'slug'            => $t->slug,
							'name'            => html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
							'products'        => (int) $t->count,
							'children_in_use' => array_map( function ( $k ) { return $k->slug . ' (' . (int) $k->count . ')'; }, $kids ),
							'page_mode'       => bigtree_cat_page_mode( $t ),
						);
					}
				}
			}
			return array( 'rules' => bigtree_cat_collapse_rules(), 'matched_terms' => $found );
		}

		if ( 'tree' === $section ) {
			$slug = isset( $_GET['slug'] ) ? sanitize_title( wp_unslash( $_GET['slug'] ) ) : 'furniture';
			$root = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $root ) {
				return array( 'error' => 'No product_cat with slug ' . $slug );
			}
			$lines = array();
			$walk  = function ( $term, $depth ) use ( &$walk, &$lines ) {
				if ( count( $lines ) >= 400 ) {
					return;
				}
				$kids      = get_terms( array( 'taxonomy' => 'product_cat', 'parent' => (int) $term->term_id, 'hide_empty' => false, 'orderby' => 'name' ) );
				$kids      = is_wp_error( $kids ) ? array() : $kids;
				$live_kids = array();
				foreach ( $kids as $k ) {
					if ( bigtree_cat_branch_has_products( $k ) ) {
						$live_kids[] = $k;
					}
				}
				$orphans = null;
				if ( ! empty( $live_kids ) ) {
					$mine  = get_objects_in_term( (int) $term->term_id, 'product_cat' );
					$desc  = get_term_children( (int) $term->term_id, 'product_cat' );
					$below = ! empty( $desc ) ? get_objects_in_term( $desc, 'product_cat' ) : array();
					if ( is_wp_error( $mine ) || count( $mine ) > 5000 ) {
						$orphans = null;
					} else {
						$mine_pub  = bigtree_cat_published_ids( $mine );
						$below_pub = bigtree_cat_published_ids( is_wp_error( $below ) ? array() : $below );
						$orphans   = count( array_diff( $mine_pub, $below_pub ) );
					}
				}
				$flags = array();
				if ( bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( $term ) ) {
					$flags[] = 'COLLAPSED';
				}
				if ( ! empty( $live_kids ) && $orphans ) {
					$flags[] = 'HAS_' . $orphans . '_DIRECT_ONLY_PRODUCTS';
				}
				$lines[] = str_repeat( '  ', $depth ) . $term->slug . ' | "' . html_entity_decode( $term->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) . '" | id ' . $term->term_id . ' | count ' . (int) $term->count . ' | live_children ' . count( $live_kids ) . ( $flags ? ' | ' . implode( ',', $flags ) : '' );
				$seen = array();
				foreach ( $live_kids as $k ) {
					$n = bigtree_cat_norm( $k->name );
					$seen[ $n ][] = $k->slug;
				}
				foreach ( $seen as $n => $slugs ) {
					if ( count( $slugs ) > 1 ) {
						$lines[] = str_repeat( '  ', $depth + 1 ) . '!! SAME NAME "' . $n . '" under one parent: ' . implode( ', ', $slugs );
					}
				}
				foreach ( $live_kids as $k ) {
					$walk( $k, $depth + 1 );
				}
			};
			$walk( $root, 0 );
			return array( 'root' => $slug, 'note' => 'Only branches with products are listed. DIRECT_ONLY = products assigned to this category and to none of its sub-categories (published products only).', 'lines' => $lines, 'truncated' => count( $lines ) >= 400 );
		}

		if ( 'product' === $section ) {
			$id = isset( $_GET['id'] ) ? absint( $_GET['id'] ) : 0;
			if ( ! $id || 'product' !== get_post_type( $id ) ) {
				return array( 'error' => 'Pass a product ID, for example ?bt_cat_debug=product&id=123' );
			}
			return array( 'id' => $id, 'title' => get_the_title( $id ), 'facets' => bigtree_cat_product_facets( $id ) );
		}

		return array(
			'data_layer' => BIGTREE_CAT_DATA_LAYER,
			'usage'      => 'Add ?bt_cat_debug=SECTION to any front-end URL while logged in as an administrator.',
			'sections'   => array( 'selftest', 'registry', 'features', 'material', 'color', 'types', 'collapse', 'tree&slug=furniture', 'product&id=123' ),
		);
	}
}

add_action(
	'template_redirect',
	function () {
		if ( defined( 'BIGTREE_CAT_DEBUG_OFF' ) && BIGTREE_CAT_DEBUG_OFF ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! isset( $_GET['bt_cat_debug'] ) ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! is_user_logged_in() || ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
			return;
		}
		$section = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['bt_cat_debug'] ) );
		nocache_headers();
		header( 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow' );
		header( 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' );
		echo wp_json_encode( bigtree_cat_debug_report( $section ), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.OutputNotEscaped
		exit;
	},
	1
);
```
