```php
        $js   = <<<'JS'
(function(){
var roots=document.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg');
if(!roots.length){return;}
var Q={o:'f_out',fr:'f_flame',st:'f_style',y:'f_type',m:'f_mat',c:'f_col',p:'f_proj',s:'f_sel'};
var MULTI=['st','y','m','c','p','s'];
function read(search){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(search),st={o:0,fr:0,y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};
  if(sp.get(Q.o)){st.o=1;}
  if(sp.get(Q.fr)){st.fr=1;}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){var v=sp.get(Q[k]);if(v){st[k]=v.split(',').filter(Boolean);}});
  return st;
}
function qs(st){
  var a=[];
  if(st.o){a.push(Q.o+'=1');}
  if(st.fr){a.push(Q.fr+'=1');}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){if(st[k].length){a.push(Q[k]+'='+st[k].map(encodeURIComponent).join(','));}});
  return a.join('&');
}
function pageUrl(q){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  Object.keys(Q).forEach(function(k){sp.delete(Q[k]);});
  var all=[sp.toString(),q].filter(Boolean).join('&');
  return location.pathname+(all?'?'+all:'');
}
roots.forEach(function(root){
  if(root.getAttribute('data-init')){return;}
  root.setAttribute('data-init','1');
  var bar=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-bar'),grid=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-grid'),count=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-count');
  var cat=root.getAttribute('data-category'),rest=root.getAttribute('data-rest');
  var st=read(location.search),ctl=null;
  var view='small';
  try{view=localStorage.getItem('btLgView')==='big'?'big':'small';}catch(e){}
  function setView(v){
    view=v;
    root.classList.toggle('bt-lg-view-big',v==='big');
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-viewbtn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('is-on',b.getAttribute('data-view')===v);});
    try{localStorage.setItem('btLgView',v);}catch(e){}
  }
  setView(view);
  function load(push){
    var q=qs(st);
    if(ctl){ctl.abort();}
    ctl=('AbortController' in window)?new AbortController():null;
    root.classList.add('is-loading');
    fetch(rest+'?category='+encodeURIComponent(cat)+(q?'&'+q:''),{credentials:'same-origin',signal:ctl?ctl.signal:undefined})
      .then(function(r){if(!r.ok){throw new Error('bad');}return r.json();})
      .then(function(d){
        var sp=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel'),sTop=sp?sp.scrollTop:0;
        bar.innerHTML=d.bar;grid.innerHTML=d.grid;
        applyOpen();
        var sp2=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel');if(sp2){sp2.scrollTop=sTop;}
        count.textContent=d.count+(d.count===1?' product':' products');
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        if(push){history.pushState({bt:1},'',pageUrl(q));}
      })
      .catch(function(e){
        if(e&&e.name==='AbortError'){return;}
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        location.href=pageUrl(q);
      });
  }
  function toggle(f,v){
    if(f==='o'||f==='fr'){st[f]=st[f]?0:1;return;}
    var i=st[f].indexOf(v);
    if(i>-1){st[f].splice(i,1);}else{st[f].push(v);}
  }
  var openF=null;
  function applyOpen(){
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-dd').forEach(function(g){
      var on=(g.getAttribute('data-facet')===openF);
      g.classList.remove('is-right');
      g.classList.toggle('is-open',on);
      var b=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
      if(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');}
      if(on){
        var p=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-panel');
        if(p&&p.getBoundingClientRect().right>window.innerWidth-8){g.classList.add('is-right');}
      }
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(openF&&!e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd')){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'&&openF){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  root.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var d=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
    if(d&&root.contains(d)){
      var fk=d.parentNode.getAttribute('data-facet');
      openF=(openF===fk)?null:fk;
      applyOpen();
      return;
    }
    var t=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-pill,.bt-lg-chip,.bt-lg-clear,.bt-lg-viewbtn');
    if(!t||!root.contains(t)){return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-viewbtn')){setView(t.getAttribute('data-view'));return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-clear')){st={o:0,fr:0,y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};}
    else{toggle(t.getAttribute('data-facet'),t.getAttribute('data-value'));}
    load(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){st=read(location.search);load(false);});
});
})();
JS;
        return '<style id="bt-lg-css">' . $css . '</style><script id="bt-lg-js" data-cfasync="false">' . $js . '</script>';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_notice' ) ) {
    /** Setup problems are shown to administrators only. Visitors see nothing. */
    function bigtree_lg_notice( $msg ) {
        return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ? '<p class="bt-lg-notice">[bigtree_category_products] ' . esc_html( $msg ) . '</p>' : '';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' ) ) {
    function bigtree_category_products_shortcode( $atts ) {
        if ( ! bigtree_lg_ready() ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The Data Layer and Tile Index snippets must be active.' );
        }
        $atts = shortcode_atts( array( 'category' => '' ), $atts, 'bigtree_category_products' );
        $term = null;
        if ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) {
            $term = bigtree_lg_term( $atts['category'] );
        } elseif ( is_tax( 'product_cat' ) ) {
            $term = get_queried_object();
        }
        if ( ! $term ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'No category found. Use category="slug" or place it on a product category page.' );
        }
        if ( 'products' !== bigtree_cat_page_mode( $term ) ) {
            return ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) ? bigtree_lg_notice( 'This category shows category tiles, not products. Use [bigtree_category_tiles] here.' ) : '';
        }
        $index = bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ) );
        if ( ! $index ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The index for this branch is not built yet.' );
        }
        $flt = bigtree_lg_parse( $_GET ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
        $pay = bigtree_lg_payload( $index, (int) $term->term_id, $flt );

        $html  = '<div class="bt-cat-wrapper bt-lg" data-category="' . esc_attr( $term->slug ) . '" data-rest="' . esc_url( rest_url( 'bigtree/v1/category-grid' ) ) . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-sticky"><div class="bt-lg-top"><span class="bt-lg-count" aria-live="polite">' . (int) $pay['count'] . ( 1 === (int) $pay['count'] ? ' product' : ' products' ) . '</span>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-view"><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn is-on" data-view="small" aria-label="Small grid view" title="Small grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-small" aria-hidden="true"></span></button><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn" data-view="big" aria-label="Large grid view" title="Large grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-big" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-bar">' . $pay['bar'] . '</div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-grid">' . $pay['grid'] . '</div></div>';
        return $html . bigtree_lg_assets();
    }
}
add_shortcode( 'bigtree_category_products', 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' );
```

### Snippet #159: BigTree Category Pages: Leaf Grid and Filters v3
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-10-23 14:04:16`
- **Shortcodes:** `bigtree_category_products`
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `rest_api_init`
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_lg_ready()`, `bigtree_lg_query_keys()`, `bigtree_lg_parse()`, `bigtree_lg_term()`, `bigtree_lg_scope_ids()`, `bigtree_lg_label()`, `bigtree_lg_candidates()`, `bigtree_lg_order_options()`, `bigtree_lg_facets()`, `bigtree_lg_render_bar()`, `bigtree_lg_is_outdoor()`, `bigtree_lg_card_buttons()`, `bigtree_lg_card()`, `bigtree_lg_render_grid()`, `bigtree_lg_payload()`, `bigtree_lg_rest()`, `bigtree_lg_assets()`, `read()`, `qs()`, `pageUrl()`, `setView()`, `load()`, `toggle()`, `applyOpen()`, `bigtree_lg_notice()`, `bigtree_category_products_shortcode()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Leaf Grid and Filters (Step 3 of 5)
 *
 * Needs the snippets "BigTree Category Pages: Data Layer" and "BigTree Category Pages: Tile Index" to be active.
 *
 * What it does:
 * 1. Shortcode [bigtree_category_products category="slug"] draws the product grid and the filter bar
 *    for a leaf category (or a collapsed one, such as Sofas > Linear). With no category attribute it
 *    uses the product category archive being viewed.
 * 2. Everything comes from the cached index (no live product queries for counts or matching).
 *    Cards are the visible products plus, under a Color filter, each matching color version.
 * 3. Filters: Outdoor and Flame Retardant (switches), Type, Material, Color, Project Type, Selection.
 *    Option counts are the number of cards the visitor would see. Options with no result are hidden.
 * 4. Filter state lives in the URL (f_out, f_flame, f_type, f_mat, f_col, f_proj, f_sel), so links and
 *    the Back button restore it. Changes load through a public REST route, without a page reload.
 * 5. Small and big card view toggle (the choice is remembered in the browser).
 * 6. Developers can add buttons to each card with the filter bigtree_cat_card_actions.
 *
 * Existing snippets (PHP Product Archive Engine, Sort Products by Collection, Archive Scaling and
 * Redis Count Cache, the Collection shortcodes) are not touched. Class names start with bt-lg-
 * on purpose, so the collection filter script does not attach to this bar.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
    exit;
}

if ( ! defined( 'BIGTREE_CAT_LEAF_GRID' ) ) {
    define( 'BIGTREE_CAT_LEAF_GRID', '1.0.0' );
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 1. READINESS AND URL PARAMETERS
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_ready' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_ready() {
        foreach ( array( 'bigtree_cat_index_ready', 'bigtree_cat_index_get', 'bigtree_cat_index_cards', 'bigtree_cat_get_term', 'bigtree_cat_page_mode', 'bigtree_cat_top_slug', 'bigtree_cat_sort_compare' ) as $fn ) {
            if ( ! function_exists( $fn ) ) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_query_keys' ) ) {
    /** Filter key used inside the index => query parameter in the URL. */
    function bigtree_lg_query_keys() {
        return array(
            'o'  => 'f_out',
            'fr' => 'f_flame',
            'st' => 'f_style',
            'y'  => 'f_type',
            'm'  => 'f_mat',
            'c'  => 'f_col',
            'p'  => 'f_proj',
            's'  => 'f_sel',
        );
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_parse' ) ) {
    /** Turns request parameters into the filter array that bigtree_cat_index_match() understands. */
    function bigtree_lg_parse( $src ) {
        $flt = array();
        $q   = bigtree_lg_query_keys();
        foreach ( array( 'o', 'fr' ) as $k ) {
            if ( ! empty( $src[ $q[ $k ] ] ) ) {
                $flt[ $k ] = 1;
            }
        }
        foreach ( array( 'st', 'y', 'm', 'c', 'p' ) as $k ) {
            if ( isset( $src[ $q[ $k ] ] ) && is_string( $src[ $q[ $k ] ] ) && '' !== $src[ $q[ $k ] ] ) {
                $vals = array();
                foreach ( explode( ',', wp_unslash( $src[ $q[ $k ] ] ) ) as $v ) {
                    $v = trim( sanitize_text_field( $v ) );
                    if ( '' !== $v ) {
                        $vals[] = $v;
                    }
                }
                if ( $vals ) {
                    $flt[ $k ] = array_values( array_unique( $vals ) );
                }
            }
        }
        if ( isset( $src[ $q['s'] ] ) && is_string( $src[ $q['s'] ] ) && '' !== $src[ $q['s'] ] ) {
            $ids = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'absint', explode( ',', $src[ $q['s'] ] ) ) ) ) );
            if ( $ids ) {
                $flt['s'] = $ids;
            }
        }
        return $flt;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_term' ) ) {
    /** Category from a slug, a term id or a term object. (bigtree_cat_get_term only takes ids and objects.) */
    function bigtree_lg_term( $input ) {
        if ( is_object( $input ) ) {
            return $input;
        }
        $input = trim( (string) $input );
        if ( '' === $input ) {
            return null;
        }
        $term = ctype_digit( $input ) ? get_term( (int) $input, 'product_cat' ) : get_term_by( 'slug', sanitize_title( $input ), 'product_cat' );
        return ( $term && ! is_wp_error( $term ) ) ? $term : null;
    }
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 2. SCOPE, SORT, FACETS
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_scope_ids' ) ) {
    /** Visible product ids inside one category, sorted by Collection A to Z (symbols and numbers last). */
    function bigtree_lg_scope_ids( $index, $term_id ) {
        $ids = array();
        foreach ( (array) $index['products'] as $pid => $p ) {
            if ( in_array( $term_id, (array) $p['a'] ) ) {
                $ids[] = (int) $pid;
            }
        }
        usort(
            $ids,
            function ( $x, $y ) use ( $index ) {
                return bigtree_cat_sort_compare( $index['products'][ $x ]['l'], $index['products'][ $y ]['l'] );
            }
        );
        return $ids;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_label' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_label( $value ) {
        $value = html_entity_decode( (string) $value, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
        $value = str_replace( array( '-', '_' ), ' ', $value );
        return ucwords( trim( $value ) );
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_candidates' ) ) {
    /** Every value that exists in this scope, per facet (values from color versions included for Color). */
    function bigtree_lg_candidates( $index, $ids ) {
        $c = array(
            'm' => array(),
            'c' => array(),
            'p' => array(),
            'st' => array(),
            'y' => array(),
            's' => array(),
        );
        foreach ( $ids as $pid ) {
            $p = $index['products'][ $pid ];
            foreach ( array( 'm', 'c', 'p' ) as $k ) {
                foreach ( (array) $p[ $k ] as $v ) {
                    $c[ $k ][ (string) $v ] = bigtree_lg_label( $v );
                }
            }
            foreach ( (array) ( $p['st'] ?? array() ) as $slug => $name ) {
                $c['st'][ (string) $slug ] = html_entity_decode( (string) $name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
            }
            foreach ( (array) $p['y'] as $slug => $name ) {
                $c['y'][ (string) $slug ] = html_entity_decode( (string) $name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
            }
            if ( ! empty( $p['s'] ) ) {
                $sid                     = (int) $p['s'];
                $c['s'][ (string) $sid ] = isset( $index['sel'][ $sid ] ) ? html_entity_decode( (string) $index['sel'][ $sid ], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : (string) $sid;
            }
            if ( ! empty( $p['f'] ) ) {
                foreach ( $p['f'] as $fid ) {
                    if ( isset( $index['fin'][ $fid ] ) ) {
                        foreach ( (array) $index['fin'][ $fid ]['c'] as $v ) {
                            $c['c'][ (string) $v ] = bigtree_lg_label( $v );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return $c;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_order_options' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_order_options( $key, $opts ) {
        $color_order = array( 'black', 'white', 'grey', 'gray', 'red', 'yellow', 'blue', 'green', 'brown', 'pink', 'orange', 'beige', 'purple', 'metallic', 'mixed', 'other' );
        usort(
            $opts,
            function ( $a, $b ) use ( $key, $color_order ) {
                $la = strtolower( $a['label'] );
                $lb = strtolower( $b['label'] );
                if ( 'c' === $key ) {
                    $pa = array_search( $la, $color_order, true );
                    $pb = array_search( $lb, $color_order, true );
                    $pa = false === $pa ? 99 : $pa;
                    $pb = false === $pb ? 99 : $pb;
                    if ( $pa !== $pb ) {
                        return $pa - $pb;
                    }
                }
                if ( 'other' === $la && 'other' !== $lb ) {
                    return 1;
                }
                if ( 'other' === $lb && 'other' !== $la ) {
                    return -1;
                }
                return strnatcasecmp( $a['label'], $b['label'] );
            }
        );
        return $opts;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_facets' ) ) {
    /**
     * The filter bar content for the current scope and active filters.
     * Option count = cards the visitor would see after choosing only that option (other filters stay on).
     * Options with no result are hidden, unless they are active. A facet with fewer than two usable options hides.
     */
    function bigtree_lg_facets( $index, $ids, $flt ) {
        $cand   = bigtree_lg_candidates( $index, $ids );
        $out    = array();
        $titles = array(
            'st' => 'Style',
            'y' => 'Type',
            'm' => 'Material',
            'c' => 'Color',
            'p' => 'Project Type',
            's' => 'Selection',
        );

        // Switches.
        $switches = array(
            'o'  => 'Outdoor',
            'fr' => 'Flame Retardant',
        );
        foreach ( $switches as $k => $label ) {
            $off = $flt;
            unset( $off[ $k ] );
            $on       = $flt;
            $on[ $k ] = 1;
            $n_on     = count( bigtree_cat_index_cards( $index, $ids, $on ) );
            $n_off    = count( bigtree_cat_index_cards( $index, $ids, $off ) );
            $active   = ! empty( $flt[ $k ] );
            if ( $active || ( $n_on > 0 && $n_on < $n_off ) ) {
                $out[ $k ] = array(
                    'label' => $label,
                    'type'  => 'switch',
                    'on'    => $active,
                    'n'     => $n_on,
                );
            }
        }

        // Multi-select facets, in the order of the spec.
        foreach ( array( 'st', 'y', 'm', 'c', 'p', 's' ) as $k ) {
            $active_vals = isset( $flt[ $k ] ) ? array_map( 'strval', $flt[ $k ] ) : array();
            $opts        = array();
            foreach ( $cand[ $k ] as $val => $label ) {
                $test       = $flt;
                $test[ $k ] = ( 's' === $k ) ? array( (int) $val ) : array( (string) $val );
                $n          = count( bigtree_cat_index_cards( $index, $ids, $test ) );
                $is_on      = in_array( (string) $val, $active_vals, true );
                if ( $n > 0 || $is_on ) {
                    $opts[] = array(
                        'v'     => (string) $val,
                        'label' => $label,
                        'n'     => $n,
                        'on'    => $is_on,
                    );
                }
            }
            if ( count( $opts ) < 2 && ! $active_vals ) {
                continue;
            }
            $out[ $k ] = array(
                'label'   => $titles[ $k ],
                'type'    => ( 'c' === $k ) ? 'swatch' : 'multi',
                'options' => bigtree_lg_order_options( $k, $opts ),
            );
        }
        return $out;
    }
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 3. HTML
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_render_bar' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_render_bar( $facets, $flt ) {
        $html  = '<div class="bt-lg-facets">';
        $chips = array();
        foreach ( $facets as $k => $f ) {
            if ( 'p' === $k ) {
                continue; /* Project Type hidden for now: delete these 3 lines to bring it back */
            }
            if ( 'switch' === $f['type'] ) {
                $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-group bt-lg-group-switch"><button type="button" class="bt-lg-pill bt-lg-switch' . ( $f['on'] ? ' is-on' : '' ) . '" data-facet="' . esc_attr( $k ) . '" data-value="1" aria-pressed="' . ( $f['on'] ? 'true' : 'false' ) . '"><span class="bt-lg-switch-knob" aria-hidden="true"></span>' . esc_html( $f['label'] ) . '<span class="bt-lg-n">' . (int) $f['n'] . '</span></button></div>';
                if ( $f['on'] ) {
                    $chips[] = array( $k, '1', $f['label'] );
                }
                continue;
            }
            $on_n = 0;
            foreach ( $f['options'] as $o_cnt ) {
                if ( ! empty( $o_cnt['on'] ) ) {
                    $on_n++;
                }
            }
            $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-group bt-lg-dd' . ( $on_n ? ' has-on' : '' ) . '" data-facet="' . esc_attr( $k ) . '"><button type="button" class="bt-lg-dd-btn" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false"><span class="bt-lg-dd-label">' . esc_html( $f['label'] ) . '</span>' . ( $on_n ? '<span class="bt-lg-dd-on">' . (int) $on_n . '</span>' : '' ) . '<span class="bt-lg-dd-caret" aria-hidden="true"></span></button><div class="bt-lg-pills bt-lg-dd-panel">';
            foreach ( $f['options'] as $o ) {
                $dot = '';
                if ( 'swatch' === $f['type'] ) {
                    $dot = '<span class="bt-lg-dot bt-lg-dot-' . esc_attr( sanitize_title( $o['label'] ) ) . '" aria-hidden="true"></span>';
                }
                $html .= '<button type="button" class="bt-lg-pill' . ( $o['on'] ? ' is-on' : '' ) . '" data-facet="' . esc_attr( $k ) . '" data-value="' . esc_attr( $o['v'] ) . '" aria-pressed="' . ( $o['on'] ? 'true' : 'false' ) . '">' . $dot . esc_html( $o['label'] ) . '<span class="bt-lg-n">' . (int) $o['n'] . '</span></button>';
                if ( $o['on'] ) {
                    $chips[] = array( $k, $o['v'], $f['label'] . ': ' . $o['label'] );
                }
            }
            $html .= '</div></div>';
        }
        $html .= '</div>';
        if ( $chips ) {
            $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-chips">';
            foreach ( $chips as $c ) {
                $html .= '<button type="button" class="bt-lg-chip" data-facet="' . esc_attr( $c[0] ) . '" data-value="' . esc_attr( $c[1] ) . '" aria-label="Remove filter ' . esc_attr( $c[2] ) . '">' . esc_html( $c[2] ) . ' <span aria-hidden="true">&times;</span></button>';
            }
            $html .= '<button type="button" class="bt-lg-clear">Clear all</button></div>';
        }
        return $html;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_is_outdoor' ) ) {
    /** True when the card, or the visible product it belongs to, is flagged Outdoor in the index. */
    function bigtree_lg_is_outdoor( $pid, $of, $index ) {
        foreach ( array( (int) $pid, (int) $of ) as $id ) {
            if ( ! empty( $index['products'][ $id ]['o'] ) ) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_card_buttons' ) ) {
    /**
     * Add to list (+) and Download image buttons, drawn by the hook the collection cards use
     * (bigtree_collection_product_card_actions, from the Collection Query snippet).
     * On a round category page the + button picks the round variation whose photo the card shows.
     */
    function bigtree_lg_card_buttons( $pid, $thumb, $title, $shape_thumb = 0 ) {
        if ( ! function_exists( 'wc_get_product' ) || ! function_exists( 'bigtree_card_actions_icons' ) || ! has_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions' ) ) {
            return '';
        }
        $can  = false;
        $vid  = 0;
        $vatt = array();
        $prod = wc_get_product( $pid );
        if ( $prod ) {
            if ( $prod->is_type( 'simple' ) ) {
                $can = $prod->is_purchasable() && $prod->is_in_stock();
            } elseif ( $prod->is_type( 'variable' ) ) {
                $pick = null;
                foreach ( $prod->get_children() as $cid ) {
                    $v = wc_get_product( $cid );
                    if ( ! $v || ! $v->is_purchasable() || ! $v->is_in_stock() ) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if ( ! $pick ) {
                        $pick = $v;
                    }
                    if ( ! $shape_thumb ) {
                        break;
                    }
                    if ( (int) $v->get_image_id() === (int) $shape_thumb ) {
                        $pick = $v;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if ( $pick ) {
                    $can  = true;
                    $vid  = $pick->get_id();
                    $vatt = $pick->get_variation_attributes();
                }
            }
        }
        $p = array(
            'id'                   => (int) $pid,
            'name'                 => html_entity_decode( (string) $title, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
            'download_url'         => $thumb ? (string) wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb, 'full' ) : '',
            'can_quick_add'        => $can,
            'variation_id'         => $vid,
            'variation_attributes' => $vatt,
        );
        ob_start();
        do_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions', $p );
        return ob_get_clean();
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_card' ) ) {
    /** One product card, using the collection card class names so the existing card styling applies. */
    function bigtree_lg_card( $pid, $of, $index ) {
        $title = wp_strip_all_tags( get_the_title( $pid ) );
        $link  = get_permalink( $pid );
        $thumb = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $pid );
        if ( ! $thumb && $of !== $pid ) {
            $thumb = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $of );
        }
        $shape_thumb = 0;
        // Shape-aware photo: on a round category page, show the product's round variation photo.
        if ( $pid === $of && ! empty( $index['_shape'] ) && ! empty( $index['products'][ $pid ]['vi'][ $index['_shape'] ] ) ) {
            $thumb = (int) $index['products'][ $pid ]['vi'][ $index['_shape'] ];
            $shape_thumb = $thumb;
        }
        if ( $thumb ) {
            $img = wp_get_attachment_image(
                $thumb,
                'large',
                false,
                array(
                    'class'    => 'bigtree-collection-product-card-image',
                    'loading'  => 'lazy',
                    'decoding' => 'async',
                    'alt'      => $title,
                )
            );
        } else {
            $src = function_exists( 'wc_placeholder_img_src' ) ? wc_placeholder_img_src() : '';
            $img = $src ? '<img class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image" src="' . esc_url( $src ) . '" alt="' . esc_attr( $title ) . '" loading="lazy">' : '';
        }
        $coll    = isset( $index['products'][ $of ]['l'] ) ? html_entity_decode( (string) $index['products'][ $of ]['l'], ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : '';
        $actions = apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_card_actions', '', $pid, $of );
        $actions .= bigtree_lg_card_buttons( $pid, $thumb, $title, $shape_thumb );
        $is_out   = bigtree_lg_is_outdoor( $pid, $of, $index );

        $html  = '<article class="bigtree-collection-product-card bt-lg-card" data-id="' . (int) $pid . '"' . ( $is_out ? ' data-outdoor="1"' : '' ) . '>';
        $html .= '<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-media">' . ( $is_out ? '<span class="bigtree-outdoor-tag">Outdoor</span>' : '' ) . '<a class="bigtree-collection-product-card-media-link" href="' . esc_url( $link ) . '" aria-label="' . esc_attr( $title ) . '">' . $img . '</a>' . $actions . '</div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-info"><h3 class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><a href="' . esc_url( $link ) . '">' . esc_html( $title ) . '</a></h3>';
        if ( '' !== $coll ) {
            $html .= '<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories">' . esc_html( $coll ) . '</div>';
        }
        $html .= '</div></article>';
        return $html;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_render_grid' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_render_grid( $cards, $index ) {
        if ( ! $cards ) {
            return '<p class="bt-lg-empty">No products match these filters.</p>';
        }
        $all = array();
        foreach ( $cards as $c ) {
            $all[ $c['id'] ] = true;
            $all[ $c['of'] ] = true;
        }
        $all = array_keys( $all );
        if ( function_exists( '_prime_post_caches' ) ) {
            _prime_post_caches( $all, false, true );
            $thumbs = array();
            foreach ( $all as $id ) {
                $t = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $id );
                if ( $t ) {
                    $thumbs[] = $t;
                }
            }
            if ( $thumbs ) {
                _prime_post_caches( array_unique( $thumbs ), false, true );
            }
        }
        $html = '';
        foreach ( $cards as $c ) {
            $html .= bigtree_lg_card( (int) $c['id'], (int) $c['of'], $index );
        }
        return $html;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_payload' ) ) {
    /** Everything the page and the REST route need for one category and one filter state. */
    function bigtree_lg_payload( $index, $term_id, $flt ) {
        $smap = function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_shape_categories' ) ? bigtree_cat_shape_categories() : array();
        $sterm = get_term( (int) $term_id, 'product_cat' );
        $index['_shape'] = ( $sterm && ! is_wp_error( $sterm ) && isset( $smap[ $sterm->slug ] ) ) ? $smap[ $sterm->slug ] : '';
        $ids   = bigtree_lg_scope_ids( $index, $term_id );
        $cards = bigtree_cat_index_cards( $index, $ids, $flt );
        return array(
            'count' => count( $cards ),
            'bar'   => bigtree_lg_render_bar( bigtree_lg_facets( $index, $ids, $flt ), $flt ),
            'grid'  => bigtree_lg_render_grid( $cards, $index ),
        );
    }
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 4. REST ROUTE (public, read-only)
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_lg_rest' ) ) {
    function bigtree_lg_rest( $request ) {
        if ( ! bigtree_lg_ready() ) {
            return new WP_Error( 'bt_lg_not_ready', 'Not ready', array( 'status' => 503 ) );
        }
        $term = bigtree_lg_term( (string) $request->get_param( 'category' ) );
        if ( ! $term || 'products' !== bigtree_cat_page_mode( $term ) ) {
            return new WP_Error( 'bt_lg_bad_category', 'Unknown category', array( 'status' => 404 ) );
        }
        $index = bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ) );
        if ( ! $index ) {
            return new WP_Error( 'bt_lg_no_index', 'Index not built', array( 'status' => 503 ) );
        }
        $flt = bigtree_lg_parse( $request->get_query_params() );
        $res = new WP_REST_Response( bigtree_lg_payload( $index, (int) $term->term_id, $flt ) );
        $res->header( 'Cache-Control', 'no-store' );
        return $res;
    }
}

            '/category-grid',
            array(
                'methods'             => 'GET',
                'callback'            => 'bigtree_lg_rest',
                'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
            )
        );
    }
);

        $js   = <<<'JS'
(function(){
var roots=document.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg');
if(!roots.length){return;}
var Q={o:'f_out',fr:'f_flame',st:'f_style',y:'f_type',m:'f_mat',c:'f_col',p:'f_proj',s:'f_sel'};
var MULTI=['st','y','m','c','p','s'];
function read(search){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(search),st={o:0,fr:0,st:[],y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};
  if(sp.get(Q.o)){st.o=1;}
  if(sp.get(Q.fr)){st.fr=1;}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){var v=sp.get(Q[k]);if(v){st[k]=v.split(',').filter(Boolean);}});
  return st;
}
function qs(st){
  var a=[];
  if(st.o){a.push(Q.o+'=1');}
  if(st.fr){a.push(Q.fr+'=1');}
  MULTI.forEach(function(k){if(st[k].length){a.push(Q[k]+'='+st[k].map(encodeURIComponent).join(','));}});
  return a.join('&');
}
function pageUrl(q){
  var sp=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  Object.keys(Q).forEach(function(k){sp.delete(Q[k]);});
  var all=[sp.toString(),q].filter(Boolean).join('&');
  return location.pathname+(all?'?'+all:'');
}
roots.forEach(function(root){
  if(root.getAttribute('data-init')){return;}
  root.setAttribute('data-init','1');
  var bar=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-bar'),grid=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-grid'),count=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-count');
  var cat=root.getAttribute('data-category'),rest=root.getAttribute('data-rest');
  var st=read(location.search),ctl=null;
  var view='small';
  try{view=localStorage.getItem('btLgView')==='big'?'big':'small';}catch(e){}
  function setView(v){
    view=v;
    root.classList.toggle('bt-lg-view-big',v==='big');
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-viewbtn').forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('is-on',b.getAttribute('data-view')===v);});
    try{localStorage.setItem('btLgView',v);}catch(e){}
  }
  setView(view);
  function load(push){
    var q=qs(st);
    if(ctl){ctl.abort();}
    ctl=('AbortController' in window)?new AbortController():null;
    root.classList.add('is-loading');
    fetch(rest+'?category='+encodeURIComponent(cat)+(q?'&'+q:''),{credentials:'same-origin',signal:ctl?ctl.signal:undefined})
      .then(function(r){if(!r.ok){throw new Error('bad');}return r.json();})
      .then(function(d){
        var sp=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel'),sTop=sp?sp.scrollTop:0;
        bar.innerHTML=d.bar;grid.innerHTML=d.grid;
        applyOpen();
        var sp2=root.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd.is-open .bt-lg-dd-panel');if(sp2){sp2.scrollTop=sTop;}
        count.textContent=d.count+(d.count===1?' product':' products');
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        if(push){history.pushState({bt:1},'',pageUrl(q));}
      })
      .catch(function(e){
        if(e&&e.name==='AbortError'){return;}
        root.classList.remove('is-loading');
        location.href=pageUrl(q);
      });
  }
  function toggle(f,v){
    if(f==='o'||f==='fr'){st[f]=st[f]?0:1;return;}
    var i=st[f].indexOf(v);
    if(i>-1){st[f].splice(i,1);}else{st[f].push(v);}
  }
  var openF=null;
  function applyOpen(){
    root.querySelectorAll('.bt-lg-dd').forEach(function(g){
      var on=(g.getAttribute('data-facet')===openF);
      g.classList.remove('is-right');
      g.classList.toggle('is-open',on);
      var b=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
      if(b){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on?'true':'false');}
      if(on){
        var p=g.querySelector('.bt-lg-dd-panel');
        if(p&&p.getBoundingClientRect().right>window.innerWidth-8){g.classList.add('is-right');}
      }
    });
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(openF&&!e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd')){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='Escape'&&openF){openF=null;applyOpen();}
  });
  root.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    var d=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-dd-btn');
    if(d&&root.contains(d)){
      var fk=d.parentNode.getAttribute('data-facet');
      openF=(openF===fk)?null:fk;
      applyOpen();
      return;
    }
    var t=e.target.closest('.bt-lg-pill,.bt-lg-chip,.bt-lg-clear,.bt-lg-viewbtn');
    if(!t||!root.contains(t)){return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-viewbtn')){setView(t.getAttribute('data-view'));return;}
    if(t.classList.contains('bt-lg-clear')){st={o:0,fr:0,st:[],y:[],m:[],c:[],p:[],s:[]};}
    else{toggle(t.getAttribute('data-facet'),t.getAttribute('data-value'));}
    load(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){st=read(location.search);load(false);});
});
})();
JS;
        return '<style id="bt-lg-css">' . $css . '</style><script id="bt-lg-js" data-cfasync="false">' . $js . '</script>';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' ) ) {
    function bigtree_category_products_shortcode( $atts ) {
        if ( ! bigtree_lg_ready() ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The Data Layer and Tile Index snippets must be active.' );
        }
        $atts = shortcode_atts( array( 'category' => '' ), $atts, 'bigtree_category_products' );
        $term = null;
        if ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) {
            $term = bigtree_lg_term( $atts['category'] );
        } elseif ( is_tax( 'product_cat' ) ) {
            $term = get_queried_object();
        }
        if ( ! $term ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'No category found. Use category="slug" or place it on a product category page.' );
        }
        if ( 'products' !== bigtree_cat_page_mode( $term ) ) {
            return ( '' !== $atts['category'] ) ? bigtree_lg_notice( 'This category shows category tiles, not products. Use [bigtree_category_tiles] here.' ) : '';
        }
        $index = bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ) );
        if ( ! $index ) {
            return bigtree_lg_notice( 'The index for this branch is not built yet.' );
        }
        $flt = bigtree_lg_parse( $_GET ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
        $pay = bigtree_lg_payload( $index, (int) $term->term_id, $flt );

        $html  = '<div class="bt-cat-wrapper bt-lg" data-category="' . esc_attr( $term->slug ) . '" data-rest="' . esc_url( rest_url( 'bigtree/v1/category-grid' ) ) . '">';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-sticky"><div class="bt-lg-top"><span class="bt-lg-count" aria-live="polite">' . (int) $pay['count'] . ( 1 === (int) $pay['count'] ? ' product' : ' products' ) . '</span>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-view"><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn is-on" data-view="small" aria-label="Small grid view" title="Small grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-small" aria-hidden="true"></span></button><button type="button" class="bt-lg-viewbtn" data-view="big" aria-label="Large grid view" title="Large grid view"><span class="bt-lg-vi bt-lg-vi-big" aria-hidden="true"></span></button></div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-bar">' . $pay['bar'] . '</div></div>';
        $html .= '<div class="bt-lg-grid">' . $pay['grid'] . '</div></div>';
        return $html . bigtree_lg_assets();
    }
}
add_shortcode( 'bigtree_category_products', 'bigtree_category_products_shortcode' );
```

```php
/**
 * BigTree Complete Collection & Product Shortcodes with Dynamic Filters & Card Actions
 *
 * 1. [bigtree_collection_grid] - Used on PARENT collection terms:
 *    - Auto-unpacks intermediate "folder" terms (e.g. DD. Premium / DD. Pulse).
 *    - Auto-zooms category depth (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3).
 *    - Adds dynamic collection filter bar.
 *    - Skips cards for collections with zero published products.
 *
 * 2. [bigtree_collection_products] - Used on LEAF collection terms:
 *    - Renders WooCommerce products with dynamic child category filter bar.
 *    - Handles SIMPLE and VARIABLE products (auto-adds first in-stock variation).
 *    - Matches Elementor card design: (+) at Top-Right, (↓ Download) at Bottom-Right on hover.
 *
 * 3. [bigtree_all_selections_grid] - Used on the All Selections page:
 *    - Computed replacement for the manual Collections CPT.
 *    - Multi-select AND filtering.
 *    - Skips Selections with zero published products anywhere in their tree.
 */

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Category Ancestor Chain
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $term_id ) {
		static $chain_cache = [];
		if ( isset( $chain_cache[ $term_id ] ) ) {
			return $chain_cache[ $term_id ];
		}

		$term = get_term( $term_id, 'product_cat' );
		if ( ! $term || is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$lineage = [ $term ];
		$curr = $term;
		while ( $curr->parent != 0 ) {
			$parent = get_term( $curr->parent, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $parent || is_wp_error( $parent ) ) {
				break;
			}
			array_unshift( $lineage, $parent );
			$curr = $parent;
		}

		$chain = [];
		$level = 1;
		foreach ( $lineage as $item ) {
			$chain[ $level ] = $item;
			$level++;
		}

		$chain_cache[ $term_id ] = $chain;
		return $chain;
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 1: [bigtree_collection_grid] (Parent Collections)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( ! bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$direct_children = get_terms([
			'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
			'parent'     => $current_term->term_id,
			'hide_empty' => false,
		]);

		if ( empty( $direct_children ) || is_wp_error( $direct_children ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$has_subchildren_count = 0;
		foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
			if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
				$has_subchildren_count++;
			}
		}

		$display_terms = [];
		if ( count( $direct_children ) <= 3 && $has_subchildren_count > 0 ) {
			foreach ( $direct_children as $child ) {
				if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $child->term_id ) ) {
					$subs = get_terms([
						'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
						'parent'     => $child->term_id,
						'hide_empty' => false,
					]);
					if ( ! empty( $subs ) && ! is_wp_error( $subs ) ) {
						foreach ( $subs as $s ) {
							$display_terms[] = $s;
						}
					}
				} else {
					$display_terms[] = $child;
				}
			}
		} else {
			$display_terms = $direct_children;
		}

		if ( empty( $display_terms ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$cards_raw          = [];
		$all_chains_by_card = [];

		foreach ( $display_terms as $card_term ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $card_term->term_id, 'collection' );

			$product_ids = get_posts([
				'post_type'   => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish',
				'numberposts' => 20,
				'fields'      => 'ids',
				'tax_query'   => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field'    => 'term_id',
						'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $card_term->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $card_term );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$chains_for_this_card = [];
			foreach ( $product_ids as $pid ) {
				$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' );
				if ( $prod_cats && ! is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
					foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
						$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
						if ( ! empty( $chain ) ) {
							$chains_for_this_card[] = $chain;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			$cards_raw[] = [
				'term'      => $card_term,
				'image_url' => $image_url,
				'term_link' => $term_link,
			];
			$all_chains_by_card[ $card_term->term_id ] = $chains_for_this_card;
		}

		if ( empty( $cards_raw ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$l1_terms = [];
		$l2_terms = [];
		$l3_terms = [];

		foreach ( $all_chains_by_card as $card_chains ) {
			foreach ( $card_chains as $chain ) {
				if ( isset( $chain[1] ) ) $l1_terms[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[2] ) ) $l2_terms[ $chain[2]->term_id ] = $chain[2]->name;
				if ( isset( $chain[3] ) ) $l3_terms[ $chain[3]->term_id ] = $chain[3]->name;
			}
		}

		if ( count( $l1_terms ) >= 3 ) {
			$target_level = 1;
		} elseif ( count( $l2_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 2;
		} elseif ( count( $l3_terms ) > 1 ) {
			$target_level = 3;
		} else {
			$target_level = ! empty( $l2_terms ) ? 2 : 1;
		}

		$cards_data        = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		// Outdoor comes from the product Environment term (Outdoor Map snippet), never from the Outdoor category.
		$outdoor_map = function_exists( 'bigtree_outdoor_map_get' ) ? bigtree_outdoor_map_get() : null;

		foreach ( $cards_raw as $card ) {
			$cid    = $card['term']->term_id;
			$chains = $all_chains_by_card[ $cid ];

			$card_cat_names = [];
			$card_cat_slugs = [];
			$skipped_outdoor = false; // true when this card's Outdoor category was skipped on purpose

			foreach ( $chains as $chain ) {
				$term_at_level = isset( $chain[ $target_level ] ) ? $chain[ $target_level ] : ( isset( $chain[1] ) ? $chain[1] : null );

				if ( $term_at_level ) {
					$slug = sanitize_title( $term_at_level->slug );
					if ( 'outdoor' === strtolower( trim( html_entity_decode( (string) $term_at_level->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ) ) || in_array( $slug, array( 'outdoor', 'outdoor-2' ), true ) ) {
						$skipped_outdoor = true;
						continue; // Outdoor is a product-based switch now, not a category pill.
					}
					$name = $term_at_level->name;

					$card_cat_names[ $slug ]    = $name;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $slug ]    = $slug;
					$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
				}
			}

			if ( empty( $card_cat_names ) && ! $skipped_outdoor ) {
				$fallback = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $cid );
				foreach ( $fallback as $fname ) {
					$fslug = sanitize_title( $fname );
					if ( 'outdoor' === strtolower( trim( html_entity_decode( (string) $fname, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ) ) || in_array( $fslug, array( 'outdoor', 'outdoor-2' ), true ) ) {
						continue;
					}
					$card_cat_names[ $fslug ]    = $fname;
					$card_cat_slugs[ $fslug ]    = $fslug;
					$available_filters[ $fslug ] = $fname;
				}
			}

			/* Finishes-only collections are hidden from this grid (they will get their own grid later). Pass show_finishes="yes" to bring them back. */
			if ( ! empty( $card_cat_slugs ) && count( array_unique( $card_cat_slugs ) ) === 1 && 'finishes' === reset( $card_cat_slugs ) && ( ! is_array( $atts ) || ! isset( $atts['show_finishes'] ) || 'yes' !== $atts['show_finishes'] ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			
			$cards_data[] = [
				'term'           => $card['term'],
				'image_url'      => $card['image_url'],
				'term_link'      => $card['term_link'],
				'category_names' => array_values( $card_cat_names ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $card_cat_slugs ),
				'outdoor'        => ( null !== $outdoor_map && ! empty( $outdoor_map['terms'][ (int) $cid ] ) ),
			];
		}

		// Deduplicate filter tabs by decoded, uppercase label
		$unique_filters = [];
		foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) {
			$label = mb_strtoupper( html_entity_decode( $name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
			if ( ! isset( $unique_filters[ $label ] ) ) {
				$unique_filters[ $label ] = [
					'label' => $label,
					'slugs' => [ $slug ],
				];
			} else {
				$unique_filters[ $label ]['slugs'][] = $slug;
			}
		}

		ksort( $unique_filters );

		$outdoor_n = 0;
		foreach ( $cards_data as $od_card ) {
			if ( ! empty( $od_card['outdoor'] ) ) {
				$outdoor_n++;
			}
		}
		// Show the switch on every page that lists collections, even when none (or all) of them have outdoor products.
		$show_outdoor = ( null !== $outdoor_map );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="grid">

			<?php if ( count( $unique_filters ) > 1 || $show_outdoor ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
     <?php if ( count( $unique_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $unique_filters as $label => $fdata ) : 
						$filter_val = implode( ',', $fdata['slugs'] );
					?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $filter_val ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( $fdata['label'] ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
     <?php endif; ?>
     <?php if ( $show_outdoor ) : ?>
      <button type="button" class="bigtree-out-switch" aria-pressed="false"><span class="bigtree-out-knob" aria-hidden="true"></span>Outdoor <span class="bigtree-out-n"><?php echo (int) $outdoor_n; ?></span></button>
     <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
   <?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>"
        data-outdoor="<?php echo ! empty( $card['outdoor'] ) ? '1' : '0'; ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( html_entity_decode( $card['term']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( html_entity_decode( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_grid', 'bigtree_collection_grid_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 2: [bigtree_collection_products] (Leaf Pages - Simple + Variable)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_collection_products_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$current_term = get_queried_object();

		if ( ! $current_term || ! isset( $current_term->term_id ) || $current_term->taxonomy !== 'collection' ) {
			return '';
		}

		if ( bigtree_term_has_children( $current_term->term_id ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$products = wc_get_products([
			'status'    => 'publish',
			'limit'     => -1,
			'orderby'   => 'menu_order',
			'order'     => 'ASC',
			'tax_query' => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => 'collection',
					'field'    => 'term_id',
					'terms'    => $current_term->term_id,
				],
			],
		]);

// Deterministic sort: menu_order first, then natural-case title (groups product families, stable across imports)
if ( is_array( $products ) ) {
	usort( $products, function( $a, $b ) {
		$mo = (int) $a->get_menu_order() <=> (int) $b->get_menu_order();
		if ( 0 !== $mo ) {
			return $mo;
		}
		$t = strnatcasecmp( $a->get_name(), $b->get_name() );
		return 0 !== $t ? $t : ( $a->get_id() <=> $b->get_id() );
	} );
}

		if ( empty( $products ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$GLOBALS['bigtree_card_actions_needed'] = true;

		$products_data     = [];

		// Outdoor is decided per product by its Features term (Data Layer role), same source as the Selection filters.
		// null = Data Layer unavailable, so the switch is hidden.
		$outdoor_tids = null;
		if ( function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_features_role' ) && function_exists( 'bigtree_outdoor_term_ids' ) ) {
			$outdoor_tids = array_keys( bigtree_outdoor_term_ids() );
			if ( $outdoor_tids ) {
				update_object_term_cache(
					array_map(
						function ( $pp ) {
							return $pp->get_id();
						},
						$products
					),
					'product'
				);
			}
		}
		$available_filters = [];

		foreach ( $products as $product ) {
			$product_id   = $product->get_id();
			$thumb_id     = get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id );
			
			$image_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' ) : '';
			if ( ! $image_url ) {
				$image_url = function_exists( 'bigtree_get_card_image_url' )
					? bigtree_get_card_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' )
					: wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'medium_large' );
			}

			$download_url = $thumb_id ? wp_get_attachment_image_url( $thumb_id, 'full' ) : '';

			// -----------------------------------------------------------------
			// QUICK ADD LOGIC (Handles Simple AND Variable Products)
			// -----------------------------------------------------------------
			$can_quick_add        = false;
			$variation_id         = 0;
			$variation_attributes = [];

			if ( $product->is_type( 'simple' ) ) {
				$can_quick_add = $product->is_purchasable() && $product->is_in_stock();
			} elseif ( $product->is_type( 'variable' ) ) {
				// Find first in-stock, purchasable variation
				$children = $product->get_children();
				if ( ! empty( $children ) ) {
					foreach ( $children as $child_id ) {
						$variation = wc_get_product( $child_id );
						if ( $variation && $variation->is_purchasable() && $variation->is_in_stock() ) {
							$variation_id         = $variation->get_id();
							$variation_attributes = $variation->get_variation_attributes();
							$can_quick_add        = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			$product_link = get_permalink( $product_id );
			$is_outdoor = ! empty( $outdoor_tids ) && has_term( $outdoor_tids, 'pa_features', $product_id );

			$cat_terms       = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			$child_cat_names = [];
			$child_cat_slugs = [];

			if ( $cat_terms && ! is_wp_error( $cat_terms ) ) {
				foreach ( $cat_terms as $cat_term ) {
					if ( $cat_term->parent !== 0 ) {
						$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_term->slug );
						$name = html_entity_decode( $cat_term->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );

						$child_cat_names[ $slug ]   = $name;
						$child_cat_slugs[ $slug ]   = $slug;
						$available_filters[ $slug ] = $name;
					}
				}
			}

			$products_data[] = [
				'id'                   => $product_id,
				'name'                 => html_entity_decode( $product->get_name(), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'image_url'            => $image_url,
				'download_url'         => $download_url,
				'can_quick_add'        => $can_quick_add,
				'variation_id'         => $variation_id,
				'variation_attributes' => $variation_attributes,
				'link'                 => $product_link,
				'cat_names'            => array_values( $child_cat_names ),
				'cat_slugs'            => array_keys( $child_cat_slugs ),
				'outdoor'      => $is_outdoor,
			];
		}

		// Deduplicate filter tabs by decoded, uppercase label
		$unique_filters = [];
		foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) {
			$label = mb_strtoupper( html_entity_decode( $name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
			if ( ! isset( $unique_filters[ $label ] ) ) {
				$unique_filters[ $label ] = [
					'label' => $label,
					'slugs' => [ $slug ],
				];
			} else {
				$unique_filters[ $label ]['slugs'][] = $slug;
			}
		}

		ksort( $unique_filters );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="products">

			<!-- DYNAMIC PRODUCT FILTER BAR (Only if > 1 distinct category label) -->
			<?php if ( count( $unique_filters ) > 1 ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $unique_filters as $label => $fdata ) : 
						$filter_val = implode( ',', $fdata['slugs'] );
					?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $filter_val ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( $fdata['label'] ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
     </div>
   <?php endif; ?>

			<!-- PRODUCT CARDS GRID -->
			<div class="bigtree-collection-product-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $products_data as $p ) :
					$data_cats = implode( ' ', $p['cat_slugs'] );
				?>
					<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card"
					     data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>" data-outdoor="<?php echo ! empty( $p['outdoor'] ) ? '1' : '0'; ?>" data-product-id="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['id'] ); ?>">

						<!-- IMAGE MEDIA CONTAINER -->
						<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-media">
        <?php if ( ! empty( $p['outdoor'] ) ) : ?>
         <span class="bigtree-outdoor-tag">Outdoor</span>
        <?php endif; ?>
							<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $p['link'] ); ?>" class="bigtree-collection-product-card-media-link" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
								<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-image">
									<?php if ( $p['image_url'] ) : ?>
										<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $p['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['name'] ); ?>" loading="lazy">
									<?php endif; ?>
								</div>
							</a>

							<?php do_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions', $p ); ?>
						</div>

						<!-- TEXT INFO CONTAINER -->
						<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $p['link'] ); ?>" class="bigtree-collection-product-card-info">
							<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $p['name'] ); ?></div>

							<?php if ( ! empty( $p['cat_names'] ) ) : ?>
								<div class="bigtree-collection-product-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $p['cat_names'] ) ); ?></div>
							<?php endif; ?>
						</a>

					</div>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_collection_products', 'bigtree_collection_products_shortcode' );
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// CARD ACTIONS RENDERER: (+) at Top-Right, (↓) at Bottom-Right (Hover only)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_action( 'bigtree_collection_product_card_actions', function( $p ) {
	$icons = bigtree_card_actions_icons();
	?>
	<?php if ( ! empty( $p['can_quick_add'] ) ) : ?>
		<button type="button"
		        class="bigtree-card-btn bigtree-card-add"
		        data-product-id="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['id'] ); ?>"
		        data-variation-id="<?php echo esc_attr( ! empty( $p['variation_id'] ) ? $p['variation_id'] : '' ); ?>"
		        data-variation-attributes="<?php echo esc_attr( ! empty( $p['variation_attributes'] ) ? wp_json_encode( $p['variation_attributes'] ) : '' ); ?>"
		        aria-label="<?php echo esc_attr( sprintf( 'Add %s to list', $p['name'] ) ); ?>">
			<span class="bigtree-card-icon"><?php echo $icons['add']; ?></span>
		</button>
	<?php endif; ?>

	<?php if ( ! empty( $p['download_url'] ) ) : ?>
		<button type="button"
		        class="bigtree-card-btn bigtree-card-download"
		        data-product-id="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['id'] ); ?>"
		        data-product-name="<?php echo esc_attr( $p['name'] ); ?>"
		        data-download-url="<?php echo esc_url( $p['download_url'] ); ?>"
		        aria-label="<?php echo esc_attr( sprintf( 'Download image of %s', $p['name'] ) ); ?>">
			<span class="bigtree-card-icon"><?php echo $icons['download']; ?></span>
		</button>
	<?php endif; ?>
	<?php
} );

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// HELPER: Top-Level (Department) Categories for a Collection Subtree
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_collection_top_categories' ) ) {
	function bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
		$all_term_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy );

		$product_ids = get_posts([
			'post_type'   => 'product',
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'numberposts' => -1,
			'fields'      => 'ids',
			'tax_query'   => [
				[
					'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
					'field'    => 'term_id',
					'terms'    => $all_term_ids,
				],
			],
		]);

		if ( empty( $product_ids ) ) {
			return [];
		}

		$top_categories = [];

		foreach ( $product_ids as $product_id ) {
			$prod_cats = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
			if ( ! $prod_cats || is_wp_error( $prod_cats ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			foreach ( $prod_cats as $pcat ) {
				$chain = bigtree_get_category_ancestor_chain( $pcat->term_id );
				if ( ! empty( $chain[1] ) ) {
					$top_categories[ $chain[1]->term_id ] = $chain[1]->name;
				}
			}
		}

		asort( $top_categories );
		return $top_categories;
	}
}

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SHORTCODE 3: [bigtree_all_selections_grid] (Top-Level Selections, computed)
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode( $atts = [] ) {
		$selections = get_terms([
			'taxonomy'   => 'collection',
			'parent'     => 0,
			'hide_empty' => false,
			'orderby'    => 'name',
			'order'      => 'ASC',
		]);

		if ( empty( $selections ) || is_wp_error( $selections ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		$cards_data        = [];
		$available_filters = [];

		// Outdoor comes from the product Environment term (Outdoor Map snippet), never from the Outdoor category.
		$outdoor_map = function_exists( 'bigtree_outdoor_map_get' ) ? bigtree_outdoor_map_get() : null;

		foreach ( $selections as $selection ) {
			$descendant_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $selection->term_id, 'collection' );

			$has_products = get_posts([
				'post_type'   => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish',
				'numberposts' => 1,
				'fields'      => 'ids',
				'tax_query'   => [
					[
						'taxonomy' => 'collection',
						'field'    => 'term_id',
						'terms'    => $descendant_ids,
					],
				],
			]);

			if ( empty( $has_products ) ) {
				continue;
			}

			$image_url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $selection->term_id );
			$term_link = get_term_link( $selection );
			if ( is_wp_error( $term_link ) ) {
				$term_link = '#';
			}

			$top_categories = bigtree_get_collection_top_categories( $selection->term_id );
			$category_slugs = [];
			foreach ( $top_categories as $cat_id => $cat_name ) {
				$slug = sanitize_title( $cat_name );
			if ( 'outdoor' === $slug ) {
				continue; // Outdoor is a product-based switch now, not a category pill.
			}
				$category_slugs[ $slug ]    = $slug;
				$available_filters[ $slug ] = $cat_name;
			}

			$cards_data[] = [
				'term'           => $selection,
				'image_url'      => $image_url,
				'term_link'      => $term_link,
				'category_names' => array_values( $top_categories ),
				'category_slugs' => array_values( $category_slugs ),
				'outdoor'        => ( null !== $outdoor_map && ! empty( $outdoor_map['terms'][ (int) $selection->term_id ] ) ),
			];
		}

		if ( empty( $cards_data ) ) {
			return '';
		}

		asort( $available_filters );

		$outdoor_n = 0;
		foreach ( $cards_data as $od_card ) {
			if ( ! empty( $od_card['outdoor'] ) ) {
				$outdoor_n++;
			}
		}
		// Show the switch on every page that lists collections, even when none (or all) of them have outdoor products.
		$show_outdoor = ( null !== $outdoor_map );

		ob_start();
		?>
		<div class="bigtree-collection-wrapper" data-filter-scope="all-selections">

			<?php if ( count( $available_filters ) > 1 || $show_outdoor ) : ?>
				<div class="bigtree-filter-bar">
					<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn active" data-filter="all">ALL</button>
					<?php foreach ( $available_filters as $slug => $name ) : 
						$label = mb_strtoupper( html_entity_decode( $name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) );
					?>
						<button type="button" class="bigtree-filter-btn" data-filter="<?php echo esc_attr( $slug ); ?>">
							<?php echo esc_html( $label ); ?>
						</button>
					<?php endforeach; ?>
     <?php if ( $show_outdoor ) : ?>
      <button type="button" class="bigtree-out-switch" aria-pressed="false"><span class="bigtree-out-knob" aria-hidden="true"></span>Outdoor <span class="bigtree-out-n"><?php echo (int) $outdoor_n; ?></span></button>
     <?php endif; ?>
    </div>
   <?php endif; ?>

			<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
				<?php foreach ( $cards_data as $card ) :
					$card_classes = array_map( function( $s ) { return 'cat-' . $s; }, $card['category_slugs'] );
					$data_cats    = implode( ' ', $card['category_slugs'] );
				?>
					<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $card['term_link'] ); ?>"
					   class="bigtree-collection-card <?php echo esc_attr( implode( ' ', $card_classes ) ); ?>"
					   data-categories="<?php echo esc_attr( $data_cats ); ?>"
        data-outdoor="<?php echo ! empty( $card['outdoor'] ) ? '1' : '0'; ?>">

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
							<?php if ( $card['image_url'] ) : ?>
								<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $card['image_url'] ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $card['term']->name ); ?>" loading="lazy">
							<?php endif; ?>
						</div>

						<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( html_entity_decode( $card['term']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ); ?></div>

						<?php if ( ! empty( $card['category_names'] ) ) : ?>
							<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><?php echo esc_html( html_entity_decode( implode( ', ', $card['category_names'] ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ); ?></div>
						<?php endif; ?>
					</a>
				<?php endforeach; ?>
			</div>
		</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_all_selections_grid', 'bigtree_all_selections_grid_shortcode' );
}

	<script>
	// 1. FILTERING SCRIPT (Collections & Products)
	document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
		const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-wrapper');
		const noMatchMessages = {
			'all-selections': 'No Selections match these filters.',
			'grid': 'No Collections match these filters.',
			'products': 'No products match these filters.'
		};

		wrappers.forEach(wrapper => {
			const scope = wrapper.getAttribute('data-filter-scope');
			const filterBtns = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-filter-btn');
			const items = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.bigtree-collection-card, .bigtree-collection-product-card');

			if ((!filterBtns.length && !wrapper.querySelector('.bigtree-out-switch')) || !items.length) return;

			if (scope === 'all-selections') {
				initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchMessages[scope]);
				return;
			}

   // Grid pages (a Selection's collections): category pill + Outdoor switch together.
   if (scope === 'grid' && wrapper.querySelector('.bigtree-out-switch')) {
    initGridFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchMessages[scope]);
    return;
   }

			// Single-select filtering for grid & leaf products (supports comma-separated multi-slugs)
			filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
				btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
					filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
					this.classList.add('active');

					const selectedFilter = this.getAttribute('data-filter');

					items.forEach(item => {
						if (selectedFilter === 'all') {
							item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
						} else {
							const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
							const targetFilters = selectedFilter.split(',');
							const matches = targetFilters.some(f => itemCats.includes(f));
							if (matches) {
								item.classList.remove('is-hidden');
							} else {
								item.classList.add('is-hidden');
							}
						}
					});
				});
			});
		});

		// Keeps the Outdoor switch on when a visitor clicks into a card (f_out=1 travels with the link).
  function syncOutdoorLinks(items, on) {
   items.forEach(a => {
    if (a.tagName !== 'A') return;
    if (!a.dataset.btBaseHref) { a.dataset.btBaseHref = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; }
    const base = a.dataset.btBaseHref;
    if (!base || base === '#') return;
    if (!on) { a.setAttribute('href', base); return; }
    try {
     const u = new URL(base, window.location.href);
     u.searchParams.set('f_out', '1');
     a.setAttribute('href', u.toString());
    } catch (e) { /* leave the link as it is */ }
   });
  }

  function initGridFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchText) {
   let pill = 'all';
   let outdoorOn = false;
   const outSwitch = wrapper.querySelector('.bigtree-out-switch');
   const noMatchEl = document.createElement('div');
   noMatchEl.className = 'bigtree-no-match-message';
   noMatchEl.textContent = noMatchText;
   noMatchEl.style.display = 'none';
   wrapper.appendChild(noMatchEl);

   if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('f_out')) { outdoorOn = true; }

   function updateUrl() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (outdoorOn) {
     params.set('f_out', '1');
    } else {
     params.delete('f_out');
    }
    const query = params.toString();
    history.replaceState(null, '', window.location.pathname + (query ? '?' + query : '') + window.location.hash);
   }

   function applyFilters() {
    filterBtns.forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-filter') === pill));
    outSwitch.classList.toggle('is-on', outdoorOn);
    outSwitch.setAttribute('aria-pressed', outdoorOn ? 'true' : 'false');

    const targets = pill === 'all' ? null : pill.split(',');
    let visibleCount = 0;
    items.forEach(item => {
     const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
     const catMatch = !targets || targets.some(f => itemCats.includes(f));
     const outMatch = !outdoorOn || item.getAttribute('data-outdoor') === '1';
     const matches = catMatch && outMatch;
     item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !matches);
     if (matches) visibleCount++;
    });
    noMatchEl.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
    syncOutdoorLinks(items, outdoorOn);
   }

   filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
     pill = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
     applyFilters();
    });
   });

   outSwitch.addEventListener('click', function() {
    outdoorOn = !outdoorOn;
    applyFilters();
    updateUrl();
   });

   applyFilters();
  }

  function initMultiSelectFilter(wrapper, filterBtns, items, noMatchText) {
   let active = new Set();
   let outdoorOn = false;
   const outSwitch = wrapper.querySelector('.bigtree-out-switch');
   const noMatchEl = document.createElement('div');
   noMatchEl.className = 'bigtree-no-match-message';
   noMatchEl.textContent = noMatchText;
   noMatchEl.style.display = 'none';
   wrapper.appendChild(noMatchEl);

   const initialParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
   const urlFilters = initialParams.get('filters');
   if (urlFilters) {
    urlFilters.split(',').map(f => f.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(f => {
     // Old links used filters=outdoor for the Outdoor category pill: they now turn the switch on.
     if (f === 'outdoor') { outdoorOn = true; } else { active.add(f); }
    });
   }
   if (initialParams.get('f_out')) { outdoorOn = true; }
   if (!outSwitch) { outdoorOn = false; }

   function updateUrl() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (active.size) {
     params.set('filters', Array.from(active).join(','));
    } else {
     params.delete('filters');
    }
    if (outdoorOn) {
     params.set('f_out', '1');
    } else {
     params.delete('f_out');
    }
    const query = params.toString();
    const newUrl = window.location.pathname + (query ? '?' + query : '') + window.location.hash;
    history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
   }

   function applyFilters() {
    filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
     const f = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
     if (f === 'all') {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', active.size === 0);
     } else {
      btn.classList.toggle('active', active.has(f));
     }
    });
    if (outSwitch) {
     outSwitch.classList.toggle('is-on', outdoorOn);
     outSwitch.setAttribute('aria-pressed', outdoorOn ? 'true' : 'false');
    }

    let visibleCount = 0;
    items.forEach(item => {
     const itemCats = (item.getAttribute('data-categories') || '').split(' ');
     const catMatch = active.size === 0 || Array.from(active).every(f => itemCats.includes(f));
     const outMatch = !outdoorOn || item.getAttribute('data-outdoor') === '1';
     const matches = catMatch && outMatch;
     item.classList.toggle('is-hidden', !matches);
     if (matches) visibleCount++;
    });

    noMatchEl.style.display = visibleCount === 0 ? '' : 'none';
    syncOutdoorLinks(items, outdoorOn);
   }

   filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
     const f = this.getAttribute('data-filter');
     if (f === 'all') {
      active.clear();
     } else if (active.has(f)) {
      active.delete(f);
     } else {
      active.add(f);
     }
     applyFilters();
     updateUrl();
    });
   });

   if (outSwitch) {
    outSwitch.addEventListener('click', function() {
     outdoorOn = !outdoorOn;
     applyFilters();
     updateUrl();
    });
   }

   applyFilters();
  }
 });

 // 2. CARD ACTIONS SCRIPT (Handles Simple & Variable Products)
	window.bigtreeCardActions = <?php echo wp_json_encode( $actions_config ); ?>;
	(function ($) {
		if (!$) return;
		const cfg = window.bigtreeCardActions;

		const Toast = (window.Swal && typeof Swal.mixin === 'function')
			? Swal.mixin({ toast: true, position: 'top-end', showConfirmButton: false, timer: 3000, timerProgressBar: true })
			: null;

		function notify(opts) {
			return Toast ? Toast.fire(opts) : Promise.resolve();
		}

		function openMiniCart() {
			$('.added_to_cart.wc-forward').remove();
			const toggle = document.getElementById('elementor-menu-cart__toggle_button');
			if (toggle && toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') {
				toggle.click();
			}
		}

		function updateBadge(count) {
			const $badge = $('.elementor-button-icon-qty');
			if (!$badge.length) return;
			let value = parseInt(count, 10);
			if (isNaN(value)) {
				value = (parseInt($badge.attr('data-counter'), 10) || 0) + 1;
			}
			$badge.attr('data-counter', value).text(value);
		}

		// ---- ADD TO LIST ACTION (Simple + Variable) ----
		$(document).on('click', '.bigtree-card-add', function (e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();

			const $btn = $(this);
			if ($btn.hasClass('is-loading') || $btn.hasClass('is-added')) return;

			const productId = $btn.attr('data-product-id');
			if (!productId) return;

			const variationId = $btn.attr('data-variation-id');
			let variationAttrs = {};
			try {
				const rawAttrs = $btn.attr('data-variation-attributes');
				if (rawAttrs) {
					variationAttrs = JSON.parse(rawAttrs);
				}
			} catch (err) {}

			$btn.addClass('is-loading').attr('aria-busy', 'true');

			const postData = {
				action: 'bigtree_add_to_cart',
				product_id: productId
			};

			if (variationId) {
				postData.variation_id = variationId;
				postData.attributes = variationAttrs;
			}

			$.ajax({
				url: cfg.ajaxUrl,
				method: 'POST',
				dataType: 'json',
				data: postData
			}).done(function (response) {
				if (response && response.success) {
					$btn.find('.bigtree-card-icon').html(cfg.addedIcon);
					$btn.addClass('is-added').attr('aria-label', 'Added to list');
					updateBadge(response.data && response.data.cart_count);
					$(document.body).trigger('wc_fragment_refresh');
					notify({ title: 'Added to List!', icon: 'success' }).then(openMiniCart);
				} else {
					notify({ title: 'Error', text: (response && response.data) || 'Could not add to list.', icon: 'error' });
				}
			}).fail(function () {
				notify({ title: 'Error', text: 'Server error.', icon: 'error' });
			}).always(function () {
				$btn.removeClass('is-loading').removeAttr('aria-busy');
			});
		});

		// ---- DOWNLOAD IMAGE ACTION ----
		function buildFilename(name, id, url) {
			let base = ('BigTree_' + (name || '') + '_' + (id || '')).trim();
			base = base.replace(/\s+/g, '_').replace(/[^\w-]/g, '');

			let ext = '.jpg';
			try {
				const path = new URL(url, window.location.href).pathname;
				const dot = path.lastIndexOf('.');
				if (dot > -1) {
					const candidate = path.substring(dot).toLowerCase();
					if (/^\.[a-z0-9]{2,4}$/.test(candidate)) ext = candidate;
				}
			} catch (err) {}
			return base + ext;
		}

		function triggerDownload(href, filename) {
			const link = document.createElement('a');
			link.href = href;
			link.download = filename;
			link.rel = 'noopener';
			document.body.appendChild(link);
			link.click();
			document.body.removeChild(link);
		}

		$(document).on('click', '.bigtree-card-download', function (e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.stopPropagation();

			const $btn = $(this);
			if ($btn.hasClass('is-loading')) return;

			const url = $btn.attr('data-download-url');
			if (!url) {
				notify({ title: 'Error', text: 'Image not available.', icon: 'error' });
				return;
			}
			const filename = buildFilename($btn.attr('data-product-name'), $btn.attr('data-product-id'), url);

			$btn.addClass('is-loading');

			fetch(url, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
				.then(function (r) {
					if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
					return r.blob();
				})
				.then(function (blob) {
					const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
					triggerDownload(objectUrl, filename);
					setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl); }, 1000);
				})
				.catch(function () {
					window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener');
				})
				.finally(function () {
					$btn.removeClass('is-loading');
				});
		});
	})(window.jQuery);
	</script>
	<?php
}, 100 );
```
