### Snippet #189: BigTree Category Pages: Tile Index v7
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-11-12 15:25:07`
- **Shortcodes:** `bigtree_category_tiles`
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event`, `set_object_terms`, `acf/save_post`, `template_redirect`
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** `slug`, `dry`, `private`, `color`, `rep`, `bt_cat_idx`
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_cat_index_tops()`, `bigtree_cat_index_option()`, `bigtree_cat_index_admin_view()`, `bigtree_cat_index_ready()`, `bigtree_cat_index_rollup()`, `bigtree_cat_index_mat_bits()`, `bigtree_cat_index_tile_rows()`, `bigtree_cat_index_match()`, `bigtree_cat_index_cards()`, `bigtree_cat_shape_tops()`, `bigtree_cat_shape_categories()`, `bigtree_cat_variation_shape_images()`, `bigtree_cat_index_resolve_cover()`, `bigtree_cat_swatch_reason()`, `bigtree_cat_index_build()`, `bigtree_cat_index_hidden_terms()`, `bigtree_cat_index_get()`, `bigtree_cat_index_children()`, `bigtree_cat_index_mode()`, `bigtree_cat_index_image_url()`, `bigtree_category_tiles_shortcode()`, `bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty()`, `bigtree_cat_index_cron_run()`, `bigtree_cat_index_families_report()`, `bigtree_cat_index_examples_report()`, `bigtree_cat_index_report()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Tile Index (Step 2 of 5), v3: adds the bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops filter (Lighting finishes)
 *
 * Needs the snippet "BigTree Category Pages: Data Layer" to be active.
 *
 * What it does:
 * 1. Builds a cached index per top-level category (Furniture first): every product visible
 *    in the catalog, its categories, and its filter values. Counts come ONLY from this index,
 *    because the Archive Scaling snippet disables WooCommerce's adjusted term counts on category pages.
 * 2. Rebuilds itself once after a burst of changes (imports included), using WP-Cron.
 * 3. Provides the shortcode [bigtree_category_tiles] that draws category tiles.
 * 4. Adds an admin-only report: while logged in as an administrator, add ?bt_cat_idx=help to any front-end URL.
 *
 * Existing snippets (PHP Product Archive Engine, Sort Products by Collection,
 * Archive Scaling & Redis Count Cache, the Collection shortcodes) are not touched.
 * The wrapper class is bt-cat-wrapper on purpose: the collection footer script attaches to
 * "bigtree-collection-wrapper" and would hijack our filters.
  *
 * v6 (2026-11-12): adds the bigtree_cat_index_virtual_terms filter in bigtree_cat_index_build,
 * so a top category (Fabrics) can place products in use tiles by rule instead of by assigned category.
 * The filter returns nothing by default, so every other category behaves exactly as in v5.
  *
 * v7 (2026-11-12): the chunked cache priming (500 products at a time, released after use) now also runs for public
 * builds of categories with more than 3,000 products. Smaller categories build exactly as in v6.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

if ( ! defined( 'BIGTREE_CAT_INDEX_VERSION' ) ) {
	define( 'BIGTREE_CAT_INDEX_VERSION', '1.2.0' );
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 1. SETTINGS AND PURE HELPERS
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_tops' ) ) {
	/** Top-level category slugs that get an index. Add 'fabrics' etc. later. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_tops() {
		return apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_index_tops', array( 'furniture', 'floor-coverings' ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_option' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_option( $slug, $admin = false ) {
		return 'bt_cat_index_' . ( $admin ? 'admin_' : '' ) . preg_replace( '/[^a-z0-9_\-]/', '', strtolower( (string) $slug ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_admin_view' ) ) {
	/** True only for viewers allowed to see Private products (Administrators and Shop Managers), same rule as the Collection grid. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_admin_view() {
		return function_exists( 'is_user_logged_in' ) && is_user_logged_in() && current_user_can( 'manage_woocommerce' );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_ready' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_ready() {
		return function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_product_facets' ) && function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_top_slug' ) && function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_material_rules' );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_rollup' ) ) {
	/** Distinct product count per category, counting every ancestor ('a' list) of each product. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_rollup( $cats, $products ) {
		$n = array();
		foreach ( $cats as $id => $c ) {
			$n[ $id ] = 0;
		}
		foreach ( $products as $p ) {
			foreach ( $p['a'] as $tid ) {
				if ( isset( $n[ $tid ] ) ) {
					$n[ $tid ]++;
				}
			}
		}
		return $n;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_mat_bits' ) ) {
	/** Material family keys to a bitmask, using the family order as bit positions. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_mat_bits( $families, $order ) {
		$bits = 0;
		foreach ( (array) $families as $f ) {
			$i = array_search( $f, $order, true );
			if ( false !== $i ) {
				$bits |= ( 1 << $i );
			}
		}
		return $bits;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_tile_rows' ) ) {
	/**
	 * For each tile: one compact row per product inside it: [outdoor 0/1, material bitmask, selection position].
	 * The browser recomputes exact tile counts from these rows when filters change (Step 3).
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_index_tile_rows( $products, $sel_ids, $tile_ids, $order ) {
		$selpos = array_flip( array_values( $sel_ids ) );
		$rows   = array();
		foreach ( $tile_ids as $t ) {
			$rows[ $t ] = array();
		}
		foreach ( $products as $p ) {
			$row = array(
				(int) $p['o'],
				bigtree_cat_index_mat_bits( $p['m'], $order ),
				isset( $selpos[ $p['s'] ] ) ? (int) $selpos[ $p['s'] ] : -1,
			);
			foreach ( $tile_ids as $t ) {
				if ( in_array( $t, $p['a'], true ) ) {
					$rows[ $t ][] = $row;
				}
			}
		}
		return $rows;
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 2. INDEX BUILDER
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_match' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Does one record (a visible product or a color version) pass the active filters?
	 * Filters: o and fr (bool), m, c, p, y (lists of values), s (list of selection ids).
	 * AND across filters, OR within one filter.
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_index_match( $rec, $flt ) {
		if ( ! empty( $flt['o'] ) && empty( $rec['o'] ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $flt['fr'] ) && empty( $rec['fr'] ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		foreach ( array( 'm', 'c', 'p' ) as $k ) {
			if ( ! empty( $flt[ $k ] ) && ! array_intersect( $flt[ $k ], (array) $rec[ $k ] ) ) {
				return false;
			}
		}
		if ( ! empty( $flt['s'] ) && ! in_array( (int) $rec['s'], array_map( 'intval', $flt['s'] ), true ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $flt['y'] ) && ! array_intersect( $flt['y'], array_keys( (array) $rec['y'] ) ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $flt['st'] ) && ! array_intersect( $flt['st'], array_keys( (array) ( $rec['st'] ?? array() ) ) ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		if ( ! empty( $flt['ap'] ) && ! array_intersect( $flt['ap'], array_keys( (array) ( $rec['ap'] ?? array() ) ) ) ) {
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_cards' ) ) {
	/**
	 * The cards shown for a list of visible product ids under the active filters.
	 * No color filter: only visible products. Color filter on: each matching color version
	 * also becomes a card, listed right after its visible product, in the order of the finish list.
	 * A product never appears twice in the same view.
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_index_cards( $index, $ids, $flt ) {
		$seen     = array();
		$out      = array();
		$color_on = ! empty( $flt['c'] );
		foreach ( $ids as $pid ) {
			if ( ! isset( $index['products'][ $pid ] ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$p = $index['products'][ $pid ];
			if ( ! isset( $seen[ $pid ] ) && bigtree_cat_index_match( $p, $flt ) ) {
				$seen[ $pid ] = true;
				$out[]        = array( 'id' => $pid, 'of' => $pid );
			}
			if ( $color_on && ! empty( $p['f'] ) ) {
				foreach ( $p['f'] as $fid ) {
					if ( isset( $seen[ $fid ] ) || ! isset( $index['fin'][ $fid ] ) ) {
						continue;
					}
					if ( bigtree_cat_index_match( $index['fin'][ $fid ], $flt ) ) {
						$seen[ $fid ] = true;
						$out[]        = array( 'id' => $fid, 'of' => $pid );
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_shape_tops' ) ) {
	/** Top-level categories where the card image follows the page's shape (round rugs show the round photo). Opt-in. */
	function bigtree_cat_shape_tops() {
		return (array) apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_shape_tops', array( 'floor-coverings' ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_shape_categories' ) ) {
	/** Leaf categories that mean a product shape, keyed by category slug. */
	function bigtree_cat_shape_categories() {
		return (array) apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_shape_categories', array( 'round-rugs' => 'round' ) );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_variation_shape_images' ) ) {
	/**
	 * For a variable product: the attachment id of the first variation of each shape that has its own photo.
	 * A size whose name starts with "Dia." (or a diameter or round word) is round.
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_variation_shape_images( $product_id ) {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'wc_get_product' ) ) {
			return array();
		}
		$product = wc_get_product( $product_id );
		if ( ! $product || ! $product->is_type( 'variable' ) ) {
			return array();
		}
		$out = array();
		foreach ( $product->get_children() as $vid ) {
			$slug = (string) get_post_meta( $vid, 'attribute_pa_size', true );
			if ( '' === $slug ) {
				continue;
			}
			$term = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'pa_size' );
			$name = html_entity_decode( $term ? $term->name : $slug, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
			if ( ! preg_match( '/^\s*(dia\b|ø|⌀|round)/iu', $name ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$img = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $vid );
			if ( $img && empty( $out['round'] ) ) {
				$out['round'] = $img;
			}
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_resolve_cover' ) ) {
	/** Tile image chain: ACF cover override, then category thumbnail, then a product image inside the category. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_resolve_cover( $tid, $products, $thumbs ) {
		if ( function_exists( 'get_field' ) ) {
			$v = get_field( 'cover_image_override', 'product_cat_' . $tid );
			if ( is_array( $v ) && ! empty( $v['ID'] ) ) {
				$v = $v['ID'];
			}
			if ( is_numeric( $v ) && (int) $v > 0 ) {
				return array( (int) $v, 'acf' );
			}
		}
		$th = (int) get_term_meta( $tid, 'thumbnail_id', true );
		if ( $th > 0 ) {
			return array( $th, 'thumbnail' );
		}
		$shape_map   = bigtree_cat_shape_categories();
		$cover_term  = get_term( (int) $tid, 'product_cat' );
		$shape       = ( $cover_term && ! is_wp_error( $cover_term ) && isset( $shape_map[ $cover_term->slug ] ) ) ? $shape_map[ $cover_term->slug ] : '';
		if ( $shape ) {
			foreach ( $products as $spid => $sp ) {
				if ( ! empty( $sp['vi'][ $shape ] ) && in_array( $tid, $sp['a'], true ) ) {
					return array( (int) $sp['vi'][ $shape ], 'product' );
				}
			}
		}
		foreach ( $products as $pid => $p ) {
			if ( ! empty( $thumbs[ $pid ] ) && in_array( $tid, $p['a'], true ) ) {
				return array( (int) $thumbs[ $pid ], 'product' );
			}
		}
		return array( 0, 'none' );
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_swatch_reason' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Why a finish counts as a material swatch, or '' when it does not.
	 * 'other-top': it lives in a different top-level branch (Fabrics, Leathers...).
	 * 'finishes' : it sits anywhere under a category named Finishes (Furniture > Finishes, Objects > Finishes).
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_swatch_reason( $finish_id, $top_slug ) {
		static $cache = array();
		$ck = $finish_id . '|' . $top_slug;
		if ( isset( $cache[ $ck ] ) ) {
			return $cache[ $ck ];
		}
		$why = '';
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $finish_id, 'product_cat' ) as $ft ) {
			if ( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $ft ) !== $top_slug ) {
				$why = 'other-top';
				break;
			}
			$chain = array_merge( array( (int) $ft->term_id ), get_ancestors( (int) $ft->term_id, 'product_cat', 'taxonomy' ) );
			foreach ( $chain as $cid ) {
				$ct = get_term( (int) $cid, 'product_cat' );
				if ( $ct && ! is_wp_error( $ct ) && 'finishes' === strtolower( trim( html_entity_decode( $ct->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ) ) ) {
					$why = 'finishes';
					break 2;
				}
			}
		}
		$cache[ $ck ] = $why;
		return $why;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_build' ) ) {
	/** Builds and stores the index for one top-level category. Returns stats or WP_Error. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_build( $top_slug, $dry = false, $with_private = false ) {
		if ( ! bigtree_cat_index_ready() ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'bt_not_ready', 'The Data Layer snippet is not active.' );
		}
		$top = get_term_by( 'slug', $top_slug, 'product_cat' );
		if ( ! $top ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'bt_no_top', 'No product category with slug ' . $top_slug );
		}
		if ( function_exists( 'set_time_limit' ) ) {
			@set_time_limit( 180 ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
		}
		$t0    = microtime( true );
		$terms = get_terms(
			array(
				'taxonomy'   => 'product_cat',
				'child_of'   => (int) $top->term_id,
				'hide_empty' => false,
			)
		);
		if ( is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
			return $terms;
		}
		$cats = array(
			(int) $top->term_id => array(
				'p'    => 0,
				'name' => html_entity_decode( $top->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'slug' => $top->slug,
			),
		);
		foreach ( $terms as $t ) {
			$cats[ (int) $t->term_id ] = array(
				'p'    => (int) $t->parent,
				'name' => html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'slug' => $t->slug,
			);
		}
		$term_ids = array_keys( $cats );

		// Published products visible in the catalog (same rule WooCommerce archives use).
		$ids = get_posts(
			array(
				'post_type'        => 'product',
				'post_status'      => $with_private ? array( 'publish', 'private' ) : 'publish',
				'fields'           => 'ids',
				'posts_per_page'   => -1,
				'no_found_rows'    => true,
				'orderby'          => 'ID',
				'order'            => 'ASC',
				'suppress_filters' => true,
				'tax_query'        => array(
					'relation' => 'AND',
					array(
						'taxonomy'         => 'product_cat',
						'field'            => 'term_id',
						'terms'            => $term_ids,
						'include_children' => false,
					),
					array(
						'taxonomy' => 'product_visibility',
						'field'    => 'name',
						'terms'    => bigtree_cat_index_hidden_terms(),
						'operator' => 'NOT IN',
					),
				),
			)
		);

		// v7: very large categories (Fabrics, about 17,000 products) use the chunked mode in public builds too,
		// because priming every product at once exhausted the 768 MB PHP memory limit.
		$bt_chunked = $with_private || count( $ids ) > 3000;
		
		// Admin (with-private) build: prime and release caches per 500-product batch so memory stays flat on very large categories.
		if ( ! $bt_chunked ) {
			foreach ( array_chunk( $ids, 500 ) as $chunk ) {
				update_object_term_cache( $chunk, 'product' );
				update_meta_cache( 'post', $chunk );
			}
		}

		$products = array();
		$thumbs   = array();
		$sel      = array();
		$bt_chunks = $bt_chunked ? array_chunk( $ids, 500 ) : array();
		$bt_seen   = 0;
		foreach ( $ids as $pid ) {
			if ( $bt_chunked ) {
				if ( 0 === $bt_seen % 500 ) {
					$bt_ci = (int) ( $bt_seen / 500 );
					if ( $bt_ci > 0 ) {
						foreach ( $bt_chunks[ $bt_ci - 1 ] as $bt_old ) {
							wp_cache_delete( $bt_old, 'post_meta' );
						}
						clean_object_term_cache( $bt_chunks[ $bt_ci - 1 ], 'product' );
					}
					update_object_term_cache( $bt_chunks[ $bt_ci ], 'product' );
					update_meta_cache( 'post', $bt_chunks[ $bt_ci ] );
				}
				++$bt_seen;
			}
			$direct = array();
			$all    = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' ) as $t ) {
				$tid = (int) $t->term_id;
				if ( ! isset( $cats[ $tid ] ) ) {
					continue;
				}
				$direct[ $tid ] = true;
				$cur            = $tid;
				$guard          = 0;
				while ( $cur && isset( $cats[ $cur ] ) && $guard++ < 15 ) {
					$all[ $cur ] = true;
					$cur         = $cats[ $cur ]['p'];
				}
			}
			$f     = bigtree_cat_product_facets( $pid );
			// v6: lets a top category place a product in extra (virtual) tile categories by rule.
			$bt_virtual = apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_index_virtual_terms', array(), $pid, $f, $cats );
			foreach ( (array) $bt_virtual as $bt_vtid ) {
				$bt_vtid = (int) $bt_vtid;
				if ( ! isset( $cats[ $bt_vtid ] ) ) {
					continue;
				}
				$direct[ $bt_vtid ] = true;
				$cur                = $bt_vtid;
				$guard              = 0;
				while ( $cur && isset( $cats[ $cur ] ) && $guard++ < 15 ) {
					$all[ $cur ] = true;
					$cur         = $cats[ $cur ]['p'];
				}
			}
			$types = array();
			foreach ( $f['type'] as $ty ) {
				$types[ $ty['slug'] ] = $ty['name'];
			}
			$styles = array();
			foreach ( (array) ( $f['style'] ?? array() ) as $st ) {
				$styles[ $st['slug'] ] = $st['name'];
			}
			$apps = array();
			foreach ( (array) ( $f['application'] ?? array() ) as $ap ) {
				$apps[ $ap['slug'] ] = $ap['name'];
			}
			if ( ! empty( $f['selection']['id'] ) ) {
				$sel[ (int) $f['selection']['id'] ] = $f['selection']['name'];
			}
			$products[ $pid ] = array(
				'd'  => array_keys( $direct ),
				'a'  => array_keys( $all ),
				'o'  => $f['outdoor'] ? 1 : 0,
				'fr' => $f['flame'] ? 1 : 0,
				'm'  => $f['material'],
				'c'  => $f['color'],
				'p'  => $f['project'],
				'y'  => $types, 'st' => $styles, 'ap' => $apps,
				'l'  => $f['collection'],
				's'  => (int) $f['selection']['id'],
			);
			$thumbs[ $pid ]   = (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $pid );
			if ( in_array( $top_slug, bigtree_cat_shape_tops(), true ) ) {
				$vi = bigtree_cat_variation_shape_images( $pid );
				if ( $vi ) {
					$products[ $pid ]['vi'] = $vi;
				}
			}
		}

		// Finishes: the color versions each visible product lists in related_series_products.
		// A finish is kept only if it is published, hidden, and in the same category and collection as its product.
		$fin    = array();
		$fstats = array(
			'links' => 0,
			'kept' => 0,
			'skip_not_published' => 0,
			'skip_already_visible' => 0,
			'skip_different_category' => 0,
			'skip_different_collection' => 0,
			'blocked_examples' => array(),
		);
		if ( function_exists( 'get_field' ) ) {
			$lists = array();
			$need  = array();
			foreach ( array_keys( $products ) as $pid ) {
				$raw = get_field( 'related_series_products', $pid, false );
				$fl  = array_values( array_diff( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'intval', (array) $raw ) ) ), array( (int) $pid ) ) );
				if ( $fl ) {
					$lists[ $pid ] = $fl;
					foreach ( $fl as $x ) {
						$need[ $x ] = true;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach ( array_chunk( array_keys( $need ), 500 ) as $chunk ) {
				update_object_term_cache( $chunk, 'product' );
				update_meta_cache( 'post', $chunk );
			}
			$cat_set = function ( $id ) {
				$s = array();
				foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $id, 'product_cat' ) as $t ) {
					$s[ bigtree_cat_norm( $t->name ) ] = true;
				}
				return $s;
			};
			$col_key = function ( $leaf, $sel ) {
				return bigtree_cat_norm( $leaf ) . '|' . (int) $sel;
			};
			$fkeys = array();
			$swatch_seen = array();
			$swatch_dry   = array( 'links' => 0, 'by_reason' => array(), 'finishes' => array(), 'products' => array(), 'gain' => array() );
			$color_before = array();
			if ( $dry ) {
				foreach ( $products as $p0 ) {
					foreach ( (array) $p0['c'] as $fam0 ) {
						$color_before[ $fam0 ] = isset( $color_before[ $fam0 ] ) ? $color_before[ $fam0 ] + 1 : 1;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach ( $lists as $pid => $fl ) {
				$pcats = $cat_set( $pid );
				$pcol  = $col_key( $products[ $pid ]['l'], $products[ $pid ]['s'] );
				$kept  = array();
				foreach ( $fl as $fid ) {
					$fstats['links']++;
					if ( 'publish' !== get_post_status( $fid ) ) {
						$fstats['skip_not_published']++;
						continue;
					}
					if ( isset( $products[ $fid ] ) ) {
						$fstats['skip_already_visible']++;
						continue;
					}
					if ( ! isset( $fkeys[ $fid ] ) ) {
						$f     = bigtree_cat_product_facets( $fid );
						$types = array();
						foreach ( $f['type'] as $ty ) {
							$types[ $ty['slug'] ] = $ty['name'];
						}
						$styles = array();
						foreach ( (array) ( $f['style'] ?? array() ) as $st ) {
							$styles[ $st['slug'] ] = $st['name'];
						}
			$apps = array();
			foreach ( (array) ( $f['application'] ?? array() ) as $ap ) {
				$apps[ $ap['slug'] ] = $ap['name'];
			}
						$fkeys[ $fid ] = array(
							'cats' => $cat_set( $fid ),
							'col' => $col_key( $f['collection'], $f['selection']['id'] ),
							'rec' => array(
								'o' => $f['outdoor'] ? 1 : 0,
								'fr' => $f['flame'] ? 1 : 0,
								'm' => $f['material'],
								'c' => $f['color'],
								'p' => $f['project'],
								'y' => $types, 'st' => $styles, 'ap' => $apps,
								'l' => $f['collection'],
								's' => (int) $f['selection']['id'],
								'i' => (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $fid ),
							),
						);
					}
					$fk     = $fkeys[ $fid ];
					$reason = '';
					// Lighting v3: a finish under a category named Finishes is always a material swatch for the tops listed in
			// the bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops filter, even when its category carries the same NAME as the product's
			// (Rechargeable Lights) or its collection differs.
			$force_swatch = in_array( $top_slug, (array) apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops', array() ), true ) && 'finishes' === bigtree_cat_swatch_reason( $fid, $top_slug );
			if ( $force_swatch ) {
				$reason = 'skip_different_category';
			} elseif ( ! array_intersect_key( $pcats, $fk['cats'] ) ) {
						$reason = 'skip_different_category';
					} elseif ( $pcol !== $fk['col'] ) {
						$reason = 'skip_different_collection';
					}
					if ( $reason ) {
						$fstats[ $reason ]++;
						if ( 'skip_different_category' === $reason && ( $dry || in_array( $top_slug, (array) apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_swatch_tops', array( 'floor-coverings', 'furniture' ) ), true ) ) ) {
							// Material swatch: a finish that lives in another top-level branch (Fabrics, Leathers...). It never becomes a card,
							// but the colors it shows count toward its product, so the color filter can find the product.
							$swatch_why = bigtree_cat_swatch_reason( $fid, $top_slug );
							if ( $swatch_why && ! empty( $fk['rec']['c'] ) ) {
								$swatch_dry['links']++;
								$swatch_dry['by_reason'][ $swatch_why ] = isset( $swatch_dry['by_reason'][ $swatch_why ] ) ? $swatch_dry['by_reason'][ $swatch_why ] + 1 : 1;
								$swatch_dry['finishes'][ $fid ] = true;
								$swatch_dry['products'][ $pid ] = true;
								$fstats['swatch_colors_merged'] = isset( $fstats['swatch_colors_merged'] ) ? $fstats['swatch_colors_merged'] + 1 : 1;
								if ( empty( $swatch_seen[ $pid ] ) ) {
									// First swatch for this product: drop the placeholder family that came from a non-color label (a finish collection name).
									$products[ $pid ]['c'] = array_values( array_diff( (array) $products[ $pid ]['c'], array( 'other' ) ) );
									$swatch_seen[ $pid ] = true;
								}
								foreach ( (array) $fk['rec']['c'] as $fam ) {
									if ( 'other' !== $fam && ! in_array( $fam, (array) $products[ $pid ]['c'], true ) ) {
										$products[ $pid ]['c'][] = $fam;
										$swatch_dry['gain'][ $fam ][ $pid ] = true;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if ( count( $fstats['blocked_examples'] ) < 10 ) {
							$fstats['blocked_examples'][] = $pid . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $pid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) . ' lists ' . $fid . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $fid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) . ' (' . $reason . ')';
						}
						continue;
					}
					$kept[]      = $fid;
					$fin[ $fid ] = $fk['rec'];
					$fstats['kept']++;
				}
				if ( $kept ) {
					$products[ $pid ]['f'] = $kept;
				}
			}
		}

		$n = bigtree_cat_index_rollup( $cats, $products );
		foreach ( $cats as $tid => $c ) {
			if ( 0 === $n[ $tid ] && (int) $top->term_id !== $tid ) {
				unset( $cats[ $tid ] );
				continue;
			}
			$cats[ $tid ]['n'] = $n[ $tid ];
			list( $aid, $src ) = bigtree_cat_index_resolve_cover( $tid, $products, $thumbs );
			$cats[ $tid ]['img'] = $aid;
			$cats[ $tid ]['src'] = $src;
		}
		asort( $sel );

		$index = array(
			'v'        => BIGTREE_CAT_INDEX_VERSION,
			'built'    => time(),
			'secs'     => round( microtime( true ) - $t0, 2 ),
			'top'      => (int) $top->term_id,
			'top_slug' => $top->slug,
			'cats'     => $cats,
			'sel'      => $sel,
			'products' => $products,
			'fin' => $fin,
			'fin_stats' => $fstats,
		);
		if ( $dry ) {
			$color_after = array();
			foreach ( $products as $p1 ) {
				foreach ( (array) $p1['c'] as $fam1 ) {
					$color_after[ $fam1 ] = isset( $color_after[ $fam1 ] ) ? $color_after[ $fam1 ] + 1 : 1;
				}
			}
			$gain_counts = array();
			$gainers     = array();
			foreach ( $swatch_dry['gain'] as $gf => $gids ) {
				$gain_counts[ $gf ] = count( $gids );
				$gainers += $gids;
			}
			ksort( $gain_counts );
			ksort( $color_before );
			ksort( $color_after );
			return array(
				'dry_run'                 => 'nothing was saved',
				'slug'                    => $top_slug,
				'products'                => count( $products ),
				'swatch_links_used'       => $swatch_dry['links'],
				'swatch_links_by_reason'  => $swatch_dry['by_reason'],
				'distinct_swatch_finishes' => count( $swatch_dry['finishes'] ),
				'products_with_swatches'  => count( $swatch_dry['products'] ),
				'products_gaining_a_new_color' => count( $gainers ),
				'new_color_matches_by_family' => $gain_counts,
				'color_family_counts_before' => $color_before,
				'color_family_counts_after'  => $color_after,
				'finish_rules'            => $fstats,
			);
		}
		update_option( bigtree_cat_index_option( $top_slug, $with_private ), $index, false );
		bigtree_cat_index_get( $top_slug, true );
		return array(
			'slug'     => $top_slug,
			'products' => count( $products ),
			'cats'     => count( $cats ),
			'secs'     => $index['secs'],
			'peak_mb'  => round( memory_get_peak_usage( true ) / 1048576, 1 ),
		);
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_hidden_terms' ) ) {
	/** product_visibility terms that keep a product out of catalog listings. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_hidden_terms() {
		$t = array( 'exclude-from-catalog' );
		if ( 'yes' === get_option( 'woocommerce_hide_out_of_stock_items' ) ) {
			$t[] = 'outofstock';
		}
		return $t;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_get' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_get( $top_slug, $fresh = false ) {
		static $mem = array();
		$admin = function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_admin_view' ) && bigtree_cat_index_admin_view();
		$key   = $top_slug . ( $admin ? '|admin' : '' );
		if ( $fresh ) {
			unset( $mem[ $top_slug ], $mem[ $top_slug . '|admin' ] );
		}
		if ( ! array_key_exists( $key, $mem ) ) {
			$i = null;
			if ( $admin ) {
				$i = get_option( bigtree_cat_index_option( $top_slug, true ), null );
			}
			if ( ! ( is_array( $i ) && ! empty( $i['cats'] ) ) ) {
				$i = get_option( bigtree_cat_index_option( $top_slug ), null );
			}
			$mem[ $key ] = ( is_array( $i ) && ! empty( $i['cats'] ) ) ? $i : null;
		}
		return $mem[ $key ];
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 3. READING THE INDEX
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_children' ) ) {
	/** Direct child categories that hold at least one visible product, sorted by name. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_children( $index, $term_id ) {
		$hidden = function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_hidden_branches' ) ? bigtree_cat_hidden_branches() : array();
		$out    = array();
		foreach ( $index['cats'] as $id => $c ) {
			if ( (int) $c['p'] === (int) $term_id && $c['n'] > 0 && ! in_array( $c['slug'], $hidden, true ) ) {
				$out[ $id ] = $c;
			}
		}
		uasort(
			$out,
			function ( $a, $b ) {
				return strnatcasecmp( $a['name'], $b['name'] );
			}
		);
		// Pass-through (opt-in per top category): when the only child holding products is itself a parent,
		// step into it, so tiles lead straight to the first level that branches (or to the leaves).
		if ( 1 === count( $out ) && ! empty( $index['top_slug'] )
			&& in_array( $index['top_slug'], (array) apply_filters( 'bigtree_cat_passthrough_tops', array( 'floor-coverings' ) ), true ) ) {
			$only_ids = array_keys( $out );
			$deeper   = bigtree_cat_index_children( $index, (int) $only_ids[0] );
			if ( $deeper ) {
				return $deeper;
			}
		}
		return $out;
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_mode' ) ) {
	/** 'tiles' or 'products', decided from the index (never from WooCommerce term counts). */
	function bigtree_cat_index_mode( $index, $term_id ) {
		if ( function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_is_collapsed' ) && bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( (int) $term_id ) ) {
			return 'products';
		}
		return bigtree_cat_index_children( $index, $term_id ) ? 'tiles' : 'products';
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_image_url' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_image_url( $attachment_id ) {
		$attachment_id = (int) $attachment_id;
		if ( $attachment_id < 1 ) {
			return '';
		}
		if ( function_exists( 'bigtree_get_card_image_url' ) ) {
			return bigtree_get_card_image_url( $attachment_id, 'medium_large' );
		}
		$u = wp_get_attachment_image_url( $attachment_id, 'medium_large' );
		return $u ? $u : '';
	}
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 4. SHORTCODE [bigtree_category_tiles]
 * Use on a category archive, or pass term="slug" on a test page.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_category_tiles_shortcode' ) ) {
	function bigtree_category_tiles_shortcode( $atts = array() ) {
		$atts = shortcode_atts( array( 'term' => '' ), $atts, 'bigtree_category_tiles' );
		$term = $atts['term'] ? get_term_by( 'slug', sanitize_title( $atts['term'] ), 'product_cat' ) : get_queried_object();
		if ( ! $term || empty( $term->taxonomy ) || 'product_cat' !== $term->taxonomy || ! bigtree_cat_index_ready() ) {
			return '';
		}
		$top   = bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term );
		$index = bigtree_cat_index_get( $top );
		if ( ! $index ) {
			return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ? '<p class="bt-cat-notice">[BigTree] The category index for "' . esc_html( $top ) . '" is not built yet.</p>' : '';
		}
		$tid = (int) $term->term_id;
		if ( ! isset( $index['cats'][ $tid ] ) || 'tiles' !== bigtree_cat_index_mode( $index, $tid ) ) {
			return '';
		}
		$kids  = bigtree_cat_index_children( $index, $tid );
		$rules = bigtree_cat_material_rules();
		$order = array_keys( $rules );
		$labels = array();
		foreach ( $rules as $key => $r ) {
			$labels[] = $r['label'];
		}
		$sel_ids = array_keys( $index['sel'] );
		$rows    = bigtree_cat_index_tile_rows( $index['products'], $sel_ids, array_keys( $kids ), $order );
		$data    = array(
			'mat'  => $labels,
			'sel'  => array_values( $index['sel'] ),
			'rows' => $rows,
		);

		ob_start();
		?>
<div class="bt-cat-wrapper" data-bt-scope="tiles" data-bt-term="<?php echo esc_attr( $tid ); ?>" data-bt="<?php echo esc_attr( wp_json_encode( $data ) ); ?>">
	<div class="bigtree-collection-grid">
		<?php
		foreach ( $kids as $id => $c ) :
			$link = get_term_link( (int) $id, 'product_cat' );
			$link = is_wp_error( $link ) ? '#' : $link;
			$img  = bigtree_cat_index_image_url( $c['img'] );
			?>
		<a href="<?php echo esc_url( $link ); ?>" class="bigtree-collection-card bt-cat-tile" data-cat-id="<?php echo esc_attr( $id ); ?>" data-count="<?php echo esc_attr( $c['n'] ); ?>">
			<div class="bigtree-collection-card-image">
				<?php if ( $img ) : ?>
				<img src="<?php echo esc_url( $img ); ?>" alt="<?php echo esc_attr( $c['name'] ); ?>" loading="lazy">
				<?php endif; ?>
			</div>
			<div class="bigtree-collection-card-name"><?php echo esc_html( $c['name'] ); ?></div>
			<div class="bigtree-collection-card-categories"><span class="bt-cat-count"><?php echo esc_html( $c['n'] ); ?></span> <?php echo ( 1 === (int) $c['n'] ) ? 'product' : 'products'; ?></div>
		</a>
		<?php endforeach; ?>
	</div>
</div>
		<?php
		return ob_get_clean();
	}
	add_shortcode( 'bigtree_category_tiles', 'bigtree_category_tiles_shortcode' );
}

/* ========================================================================
 * 5. KEEPING THE INDEX FRESH
 * Any relevant change marks the index dirty and schedules ONE rebuild.
 * The rebuild waits until changes have stopped for 90 seconds, so a long import
 * triggers a single rebuild after it finishes.
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty() {
		static $done = false;
		if ( $done ) {
			return;
		}
		$done = true;
		$now  = time();
		if ( $now - (int) get_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty', 0 ) > 15 ) {
			update_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty', $now, false );
		}
		if ( ! wp_next_scheduled( 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event' ) ) {
			wp_schedule_single_event( $now + 120, 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event' );
		}
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_cron_run' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_cron_run() {
		$dirty = (int) get_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty', 0 );
		if ( $dirty && ( time() - $dirty ) < 90 ) {
			wp_schedule_single_event( time() + 90, 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event' );
			return;
		}
		if ( get_transient( 'bt_cat_index_lock' ) ) {
			wp_schedule_single_event( time() + 120, 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event' );
			return;
		}
		set_transient( 'bt_cat_index_lock', 1, 600 );
		foreach ( bigtree_cat_index_tops() as $slug ) {
			bigtree_cat_index_build( $slug );
			$bt_counts = wp_count_posts( 'product' );
			if ( $bt_counts && ! empty( $bt_counts->private ) ) {
				bigtree_cat_index_build( $slug, false, true );
			} else {
				delete_option( bigtree_cat_index_option( $slug, true ) );
			}
		}
		delete_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty' );
		delete_transient( 'bt_cat_index_lock' );
	}
}
add_action( 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event', 'bigtree_cat_index_cron_run' );

foreach ( array( 'save_post_product', 'woocommerce_update_product', 'woocommerce_new_product' ) as $bt_hook ) {
	add_action(
		$bt_hook,
		function () {
			bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty();
		}
	);
}
foreach ( array( 'deleted_post', 'trashed_post', 'untrashed_post' ) as $bt_hook ) {
	add_action(
		$bt_hook,
		function ( $post_id ) {
			if ( 'product' === get_post_type( $post_id ) ) {
				bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty();
			}
		}
	);
}
add_action(
	'set_object_terms',
	function ( $object_id, $terms, $tt_ids, $taxonomy ) {
		if ( 'product_cat' === $taxonomy || 'product_visibility' === $taxonomy || 'collection' === $taxonomy || 0 === strpos( (string) $taxonomy, 'pa_' ) ) {
			bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty();
		}
	},
	10,
	4
);
foreach ( array( 'created_term', 'edited_term', 'delete_term' ) as $bt_hook ) {
	add_action(
		$bt_hook,
		function ( $term_id, $tt_id = 0, $taxonomy = '' ) {
			if ( 'product_cat' === $taxonomy || 'collection' === $taxonomy ) {
				bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty();
			}
		},
		10,
		3
	);
}
add_action(
	'acf/save_post',
	function ( $post_id ) {
		if ( is_string( $post_id ) && 0 === strpos( $post_id, 'product_cat_' ) ) {
			bigtree_cat_index_mark_dirty();
		}
	}
);

/* ========================================================================
 * 6. ADMIN-ONLY REPORT
 * ?bt_cat_idx=help | status | build&slug=furniture | tiles&slug=furniture | types
 * Administrators only. "build" rebuilds the cache index (safe to repeat).
 * ===================================================================== */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_families_report' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Read-only check of finish links (ACF field related_series_products) for one indexed top category.
	 * Answers: how complete are the links, are there orphans or duplicates, do links run both ways.
	 */
	function bigtree_cat_index_families_report( $slug ) {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'get_field' ) ) {
			return array( 'error' => 'ACF is not active.' );
		}
		$top   = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
		$index = $top ? bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $top ), true ) : null;
		if ( ! $index ) {
			return array( 'error' => 'Build the index first.' );
		}
		$visible = array_map( 'intval', array_keys( $index['products'] ) );
		$vis_set = array_flip( $visible );
		$sub     = array_merge( array( (int) $top->term_id ), array_map( 'intval', (array) get_term_children( (int) $top->term_id, 'product_cat' ) ) );
		$pub     = get_posts(
			array(
				'post_type'        => 'product',
				'post_status'      => 'publish',
				'fields'           => 'ids',
				'posts_per_page'   => -1,
				'no_found_rows'    => true,
				'suppress_filters' => true,
				'tax_query'        => array(
					array(
						'taxonomy'         => 'product_cat',
						'field'            => 'term_id',
						'terms'            => $sub,
						'include_children' => false,
					),
				),
			)
		);
		$hidden     = array_values( array_diff( array_map( 'intval', $pub ), $visible ) );
		$hidden_set = array_flip( $hidden );

		$links = array();
		$by    = array();
		foreach ( $visible as $pid ) {
			$raw = get_field( 'related_series_products', $pid, false );
			$ids = array_values( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'intval', (array) $raw ) ) ) );
			$ids = array_values( array_diff( $ids, array( $pid ) ) );
			if ( ! $ids ) {
				continue;
			}
			$links[ $pid ] = $ids;
			foreach ( $ids as $fid ) {
				$by[ $fid ][] = $pid;
			}
		}
		$distinct = array_keys( $by );
		foreach ( array_chunk( $distinct, 500 ) as $chunk ) {
			update_object_term_cache( $chunk, 'product' );
		}

		$status        = array();
		$visible_fin   = array();
		$fin_hidden    = 0;
		foreach ( $distinct as $fid ) {
			$st            = get_post_status( $fid );
			$st            = $st ? $st : 'missing';
			$status[ $st ] = isset( $status[ $st ] ) ? $status[ $st ] + 1 : 1;
			if ( isset( $vis_set[ $fid ] ) ) {
				$visible_fin[] = $fid;
			}
			if ( isset( $hidden_set[ $fid ] ) ) {
				$fin_hidden++;
			}
		}
		$orphans = array_values( array_diff( $hidden, $distinct ) );

		$have   = 0;
		$none   = 0;
		$newcol = 0;
		$recip  = 0;
		$total  = 0;
		foreach ( $links as $rep => $fins ) {
			$rep_fams = $index['products'][ $rep ]['c'];
			foreach ( $fins as $fid ) {
				$total++;
				$fams = array();
				foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $fid, 'pa_color' ) as $t ) {
					$f = bigtree_cat_color_family( $t->name );
					if ( 'ignore' !== $f ) {
						$fams[ $f ] = true;
					}
				}
				if ( ! $fams ) {
					$none++;
				} else {
					$have++;
					if ( array_diff( array_keys( $fams ), $rep_fams ) ) {
						$newcol++;
					}
				}
				$back = array_map( 'intval', (array) get_field( 'related_series_products', $fid, false ) );
				if ( in_array( (int) $rep, $back, true ) ) {
					$recip++;
				}
			}
		}

		$sizes = array();
		foreach ( $links as $fins ) {
			$sizes[] = count( $fins ) + 1;
		}
		sort( $sizes );
		$multi = array();
		foreach ( $by as $fid => $reps ) {
			if ( count( $reps ) > 1 ) {
				$multi[] = $fid . ' is linked from ' . implode( ', ', $reps );
			}
		}

		$samples = array();
		foreach ( array_slice( array_keys( $links ), 0, 6, true ) as $rep ) {
			$fl = array();
			foreach ( array_slice( $links[ $rep ], 0, 6 ) as $fid ) {
				$cn = array();
				foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $fid, 'pa_color' ) as $t ) {
					$cn[] = html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
				}
				$fl[] = array(
					'id'              => $fid,
					'title'           => html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $fid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
					'status'          => get_post_status( $fid ),
					'in_catalog'      => isset( $vis_set[ $fid ] ),
					'color_terms'     => $cn,
				);
			}
			$samples[] = array(
				'product'       => $rep . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $rep ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'color_families' => $index['products'][ $rep ]['c'],
				'finish_count'  => count( $links[ $rep ] ),
				'finishes'      => $fl,
			);
		}
		$orph = array();
		foreach ( array_slice( $orphans, 0, 8 ) as $oid ) {
			$orph[] = $oid . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $oid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
		}

		return array(
			'category'                            => $top->name,
			'visible_products'                    => count( $visible ),
			'published_hidden_products'           => count( $hidden ),
			'visible_with_at_least_one_finish'    => count( $links ),
			'finish_links_total'                  => $total,
			'distinct_finishes_linked'            => count( $distinct ),
			'finish_status'                       => $status,
			'linked_finishes_that_are_hidden'     => $fin_hidden,
			'linked_finishes_that_are_also_visible' => count( $visible_fin ),
			'hidden_products_not_linked_by_any_visible_product' => count( $orphans ),
			'orphan_samples'                      => $orph,
			'finishes_linked_from_more_than_one_product' => count( $multi ),
			'multi_link_samples'                  => array_slice( $multi, 0, 5 ),
			'links_with_own_color_value'          => $have,
			'links_without_color_value'           => $none,
			'links_that_add_a_new_color_family'   => $newcol,
			'links_that_run_both_ways'            => $recip,
			'family_size_min_median_max'          => $sizes ? array( $sizes[0], $sizes[ (int) floor( count( $sizes ) / 2 ) ], $sizes[ count( $sizes ) - 1 ] ) : array(),
			'samples'                             => $samples,
		);
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_examples_report' ) ) {
	/** Read-only, human-readable examples for review: unlinked hidden products, shared finish lists, and what would be indexed. */
	function bigtree_cat_index_examples_report( $slug ) {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'get_field' ) ) {
			return array( 'error' => 'ACF is not active.' );
		}
		$top = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
		$index = $top ? bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $top ), true ) : null;
		if ( ! $index ) {
			return array( 'error' => 'Build the index first.' );
		}
		$visible = array_map( 'intval', array_keys( $index['products'] ) );
		$vis_set = array_flip( $visible );
		$sub = array_merge( array( (int) $top->term_id ), array_map( 'intval', (array) get_term_children( (int) $top->term_id, 'product_cat' ) ) );
		$pub = get_posts(
			array(
				'post_type' => 'product',
				'post_status' => 'publish',
				'fields' => 'ids',
				'posts_per_page' => -1,
				'no_found_rows' => true,
				'suppress_filters' => true,
				'tax_query' => array(
					array(
						'taxonomy' => 'product_cat',
						'field' => 'term_id',
						'terms' => $sub,
						'include_children' => false,
					),
				),
			)
		);
		$hidden = array_values( array_diff( array_map( 'intval', $pub ), $visible ) );

		$ids_of = function ( $pid, $field ) {
			$raw = get_field( $field, $pid, false );
			return array_values( array_diff( array_unique( array_filter( array_map( 'intval', (array) $raw ) ) ), array( (int) $pid ) ) );
		};

		$fin = array();
		$by = array();
		$col = array();
		foreach ( $visible as $pid ) {
			$f = $ids_of( $pid, 'related_series_products' );
			if ( $f ) {
				$fin[ $pid ] = $f;
				foreach ( $f as $x ) {
					$by[ $x ][] = $pid;
				}
			}
			foreach ( $ids_of( $pid, 'related_series_products_collection' ) as $x ) {
				$col[ $x ][] = $pid;
			}
		}
		$orphans = array_values( array_diff( $hidden, array_keys( $by ) ) );
		foreach ( array_chunk( array_merge( $orphans, array_keys( $by ) ), 500 ) as $chunk ) {
			update_object_term_cache( $chunk, 'product' );
		}

		$label = function ( $pid ) use ( $vis_set ) {
			$cats = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $pid, 'product_cat' ) as $t ) {
				$cats[] = html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
			}
			$colors = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_terms( $pid, 'pa_color' ) as $t ) {
				$colors[] = html_entity_decode( $t->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
			}
			$c = bigtree_cat_product_collection( $pid );
			return array(
				'id' => $pid,
				'title' => html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $pid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'status' => get_post_status( $pid ),
				'in_catalog' => isset( $vis_set[ $pid ] ),
				'sku' => (string) get_post_meta( $pid, '_sku', true ),
				'category' => implode( ' / ', $cats ),
				'collection' => $c['leaf'] ? html_entity_decode( $c['leaf']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : '',
				'selection' => $c['selection'] ? html_entity_decode( $c['selection']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : '',
				'colors' => $colors,
			);
		};
		$spread = function ( $list, $n ) {
			$list = array_values( $list );
			$step = max( 1, (int) floor( count( $list ) / max( 1, $n ) ) );
			$out = array();
			for ( $i = 0; $i < count( $list ) && count( $out ) < $n; $i += $step ) {
				$out[] = $list[ $i ];
			}
			return $out;
		};

		// A. Hidden products that no visible product lists as a finish.
		$class = array( 'listed_in_collection_field_of_a_visible_product' => array(), 'lists_a_visible_product_in_its_own_finish_field' => array(), 'neither' => array() );
		$by_sel = array();
		$by_cat = array();
		foreach ( $orphans as $oid ) {
			$own = $ids_of( $oid, 'related_series_products' );
			$points = (bool) array_intersect( $own, $visible );
			if ( isset( $col[ $oid ] ) ) {
				$k = 'listed_in_collection_field_of_a_visible_product';
			} elseif ( $points ) {
				$k = 'lists_a_visible_product_in_its_own_finish_field';
			} else {
				$k = 'neither';
			}
			$class[ $k ][] = $oid;
			$c = bigtree_cat_product_collection( $oid );
			$sel = $c['selection'] ? html_entity_decode( $c['selection']->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : '(no collection)';
			$by_sel[ $sel ] = isset( $by_sel[ $sel ] ) ? $by_sel[ $sel ] + 1 : 1;
			$ct = bigtree_cat_terms( $oid, 'product_cat' );
			$cn = $ct ? html_entity_decode( $ct[0]->name, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) : '(none)';
			$by_cat[ $cn ] = isset( $by_cat[ $cn ] ) ? $by_cat[ $cn ] + 1 : 1;
		}
		arsort( $by_sel );
		arsort( $by_cat );
		$orph_out = array();
		foreach ( $class as $k => $list ) {
			$rows = array();
			foreach ( $spread( $list, 6 ) as $oid ) {
				$rows[] = $label( $oid );
			}
			$orph_out[ $k ] = array( 'count' => count( $list ), 'examples' => $rows );
		}

		// B. Visible products that share the same finish list.
		$groups = array();
		foreach ( $by as $fid => $reps ) {
			if ( count( $reps ) > 1 ) {
				sort( $reps );
				$groups[ implode( ',', $reps ) ][] = $fid;
			}
		}
		$same_col = 0;
		$diff_col = 0;
		foreach ( $groups as $k => $fids ) {
			$set = array();
			foreach ( explode( ',', $k ) as $p ) {
				$c = bigtree_cat_product_collection( (int) $p );
				$set[ $c['leaf'] ? $c['leaf']->term_id : 0 ] = true;
			}
			if ( count( $set ) > 1 ) {
				$diff_col++;
			} else {
				$same_col++;
			}
		}
		$shared_out = array();
		foreach ( $spread( array_keys( $groups ), 6 ) as $k ) {
			$parents = array();
			foreach ( explode( ',', $k ) as $p ) {
				$parents[] = $label( (int) $p );
			}
			$titles = array();
			foreach ( array_slice( $groups[ $k ], 0, 6 ) as $fid ) {
				$titles[] = $fid . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $fid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' );
			}
			$shared_out[] = array( 'visible_products_sharing_the_list' => $parents, 'shared_finishes' => count( $groups[ $k ] ), 'finish_examples' => $titles );
		}

		// C. Visible products with an identical title.
		$titles_map = array();
		foreach ( $visible as $pid ) {
			$titles_map[ strtolower( html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $pid ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ) ][] = $pid;
		}
		$t_same = 0;
		$t_diff = 0;
		$t_ex = array();
		foreach ( $titles_map as $t => $ps ) {
			if ( count( $ps ) < 2 ) {
				continue;
			}
			$set = array();
			foreach ( $ps as $p ) {
				$c = bigtree_cat_product_collection( $p );
				$set[ $c['leaf'] ? $c['leaf']->term_id : 0 ] = true;
			}
			if ( count( $set ) > 1 ) {
				$t_diff++;
			} else {
				$t_same++;
			}
			if ( count( $t_ex ) < 5 ) {
				$t_ex[] = $t . ' => ' . count( $ps ) . ' visible products, ' . count( $set ) . ' collection(s)';
			}
		}

		// D. What would be indexed: the decision for every finish link.
		$decide = function ( $fid ) use ( $vis_set ) {
			$st = get_post_status( $fid );
			if ( 'publish' !== $st ) {
				return 'skip (' . ( $st ? $st : 'missing' ) . ')';
			}
			if ( isset( $vis_set[ $fid ] ) ) {
				return 'skip (already a visible card)';
			}
			return 'include';
		};
		$tally = array();
		foreach ( array_keys( $by ) as $fid ) {
			$d = $decide( $fid );
			$tally[ $d ] = isset( $tally[ $d ] ) ? $tally[ $d ] + 1 : 1;
		}
		$picked = array();
		foreach ( $fin as $rep => $fl ) {
			$has_private = false;
			$has_visible = false;
			foreach ( $fl as $fid ) {
				$d = $decide( $fid );
				if ( 0 === strpos( $d, 'skip (private' ) ) {
					$has_private = true;
				}
				if ( 'skip (already a visible card)' === $d ) {
					$has_visible = true;
				}
			}
			if ( ! isset( $picked['plain'] ) ) {
				$picked['plain'] = $rep;
			}
			if ( $has_private && ! isset( $picked['with_private_finish'] ) ) {
				$picked['with_private_finish'] = $rep;
			}
			if ( $has_visible && ! isset( $picked['with_finish_that_is_also_visible'] ) ) {
				$picked['with_finish_that_is_also_visible'] = $rep;
			}
			if ( count( $picked ) >= 3 ) {
				break;
			}
		}
		$worked = array();
		foreach ( $picked as $name => $rep ) {
			$rows = array();
			foreach ( $fin[ $rep ] as $fid ) {
				$l = $label( $fid );
				$rows[] = $fid . ' ' . $l['title'] . ' | colors: ' . implode( ', ', $l['colors'] ) . ' | ' . $decide( $fid );
			}
			$worked[ $name ] = array( 'visible_product' => $label( $rep ), 'finishes_listed' => count( $fin[ $rep ] ), 'decisions' => $rows );
		}

		return array(
			'A_hidden_products_no_visible_product_lists_as_a_finish' => array(
				'total' => count( $orphans ),
				'by_collection_selection' => array_slice( $by_sel, 0, 10, true ),
				'by_first_category' => array_slice( $by_cat, 0, 10, true ),
				'groups' => $orph_out,
			),
			'B_visible_products_sharing_finish_lists' => array(
				'groups_of_visible_products_sharing_finishes' => count( $groups ),
				'groups_all_in_the_same_collection' => $same_col,
				'groups_spanning_different_collections' => $diff_col,
				'examples' => $shared_out,
			),
			'C_visible_products_with_identical_titles' => array(
				'titles_used_by_several_visible_products' => $t_same + $t_diff,
				'of_which_in_one_collection' => $t_same,
				'of_which_in_different_collections' => $t_diff,
				'examples' => $t_ex,
			),
			'D_what_would_be_indexed' => array(
				'distinct_finishes_by_decision' => $tally,
				'worked_examples' => $worked,
			),
		);
	}
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_cat_index_report' ) ) {
	function bigtree_cat_index_report( $section ) {
		$slug = isset( $_GET['slug'] ) ? sanitize_title( wp_unslash( $_GET['slug'] ) ) : 'furniture'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended

		if ( 'build' === $section ) {
			$r = bigtree_cat_index_build( $slug, ! empty( $_GET['dry'] ), ! empty( $_GET['private'] ) ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
			return is_wp_error( $r ) ? array( 'error' => $r->get_error_message() ) : $r;
		}

		if ( 'families' === $section ) {
			return bigtree_cat_index_families_report( $slug );
		}

		if ( 'examples' === $section ) {
			return bigtree_cat_index_examples_report( $slug );
		}

		if ( 'finishes' === $section ) {
			$ft = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
			$fi = $ft ? bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $ft ), true ) : null;
			if ( ! $fi || ! isset( $fi['fin_stats'] ) ) {
				return array( 'error' => 'Rebuild the index first (build).' );
			}
			$color = isset( $_GET['color'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['color'] ) ) : 'red'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
			$rep   = isset( $_GET['rep'] ) ? absint( $_GET['rep'] ) : 29939; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
			$ids   = array_keys( $fi['products'] );
			$flt   = array( 'c' => array( $color ) );
			$cards = bigtree_cat_index_cards( $fi, $ids, $flt );
			$reps  = 0;
			foreach ( $cards as $c ) {
				if ( $c['id'] === $c['of'] ) {
					$reps++;
				}
			}
			$withf = 0;
			foreach ( $fi['products'] as $p ) {
				if ( ! empty( $p['f'] ) ) {
					$withf++;
				}
			}
			$ex = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_index_cards( $fi, array( $rep ), $flt ) as $c ) {
				$ex[] = $c['id'] . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $c['id'] ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) . ( $c['id'] === $c['of'] ? ' (the visible product)' : ' (color version)' );
			}
			return array(
				'finish_rules_result' => $fi['fin_stats'],
				'visible_products_with_color_versions' => $withf,
				'color_version_records_stored' => count( $fi['fin'] ),
				'stored_kb' => round( strlen( maybe_serialize( $fi ) ) / 1024, 1 ),
				'cards_with_no_filter' => count( bigtree_cat_index_cards( $fi, $ids, array() ) ),
				'color_filter_tested' => $color,
				'cards_with_that_color_filter' => count( $cards ),
				'of_which_visible_products' => $reps,
				'of_which_color_versions' => count( $cards ) - $reps,
				'example_product' => $rep . ' ' . html_entity_decode( get_the_title( $rep ), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ),
				'example_cards' => $ex,
			);
		}

		if ( 'status' === $section ) {
			$out = array();
			foreach ( bigtree_cat_index_tops() as $s ) {
				$i       = bigtree_cat_index_get( $s, true );
				$out[ $s ] = $i ? array(
					'built'          => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $i['built'] ) . ' UTC',
					'age_minutes'    => round( ( time() - $i['built'] ) / 60, 1 ),
					'build_seconds'  => $i['secs'],
					'products'       => count( $i['products'] ),
					'categories'     => count( $i['cats'] ),
					'selections'     => count( $i['sel'] ),
					'stored_kb'      => round( strlen( maybe_serialize( $i ) ) / 1024, 1 ),
				) : 'not built';
			}
			$next = wp_next_scheduled( 'bigtree_cat_index_rebuild_event' );
			return array(
				'indexes'              => $out,
				'dirty_since'          => (int) get_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty', 0 ) ? gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', (int) get_option( 'bt_cat_index_dirty' ) ) . ' UTC' : 'clean',
				'rebuild_scheduled_at' => $next ? gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $next ) . ' UTC' : 'none',
				'wp_cron_disabled'     => ( defined( 'DISABLE_WP_CRON' ) && DISABLE_WP_CRON ) ? 'yes (a server cron must call wp-cron.php)' : 'no',
				'hidden_from_catalog_terms' => bigtree_cat_index_hidden_terms(),
			);
		}

		$term  = get_term_by( 'slug', $slug, 'product_cat' );
		$index = $term ? bigtree_cat_index_get( bigtree_cat_top_slug( $term ), true ) : null;

		if ( 'tiles' === $section ) {
			if ( ! $term || ! $index ) {
				return array( 'error' => 'Term or index missing. Build the index first.' );
			}
			$mode = bigtree_cat_index_mode( $index, (int) $term->term_id );
			$kids = bigtree_cat_index_children( $index, (int) $term->term_id );
			$rules = bigtree_cat_material_rules();
			$rows  = bigtree_cat_index_tile_rows( $index['products'], array_keys( $index['sel'] ), array_keys( $kids ), array_keys( $rules ) );
			$list  = array();
			$ok    = true;
			foreach ( $kids as $id => $c ) {
				$sub       = array_merge( array( (int) $id ), array_map( 'intval', (array) get_term_children( (int) $id, 'product_cat' ) ) );
				$published = count( bigtree_cat_published_ids( array_unique( (array) get_objects_in_term( $sub, 'product_cat' ) ) ) );
				$tobj      = get_term( (int) $id, 'product_cat' );
				$row_ok    = ( count( $rows[ $id ] ) === (int) $c['n'] );
				$ok        = $ok && $row_ok;
				$list[]    = array(
					'tile'              => $c['name'],
					'slug'              => $c['slug'],
					'index_count'       => (int) $c['n'],
					'published'         => $published,
					'hidden_from_catalog' => $published - (int) $c['n'],
					'wc_term_count'     => $tobj && ! is_wp_error( $tobj ) ? (int) $tobj->count : null,
					'rows_match_count'  => $row_ok,
					'image_source'      => $c['src'],
					'image_url'         => bigtree_cat_index_image_url( $c['img'] ),
				);
			}
			return array(
				'page'            => $term->name,
				'page_mode'       => $mode,
				'tiles'           => count( $list ),
				'all_rows_match'  => $ok,
				'tile_list'       => $list,
			);
		}

		if ( 'types' === $section ) {
			if ( ! $index ) {
				return array( 'error' => 'Build the index first.' );
			}
			$out = array();
			foreach ( $index['cats'] as $id => $c ) {
				if ( $c['n'] < 1 || ! bigtree_cat_is_collapsed( (int) $id ) ) {
					continue;
				}
				$with = 0;
				$dist = array();
				foreach ( $index['products'] as $p ) {
					if ( in_array( (int) $id, $p['a'], true ) && ! empty( $p['y'] ) ) {
						$with++;
						foreach ( $p['y'] as $name ) {
							$dist[ $name ] = isset( $dist[ $name ] ) ? $dist[ $name ] + 1 : 1;
						}
					}
				}
				arsort( $dist );
				$out[] = array(
					'collapsed_category'  => $c['name'] . ' (' . $c['slug'] . ')',
					'products'            => (int) $c['n'],
					'with_types_value'    => $with,
					'types_distribution'  => $dist,
				);
			}
			return array( 'note' => 'Type filter reads the Types attribute. Coverage below shows how complete it is on collapsed categories.', 'collapsed' => $out );
		}

		return array(
			'tile_index' => BIGTREE_CAT_INDEX_VERSION,
			'sections'   => array( 'status', 'build&slug=furniture', 'tiles&slug=furniture', 'types', 'families&slug=furniture', 'examples&slug=furniture', 'finishes&slug=furniture&color=red' ),
		);
	}
}

add_action(
	'template_redirect',
	function () {
		if ( defined( 'BIGTREE_CAT_DEBUG_OFF' ) && BIGTREE_CAT_DEBUG_OFF ) {
			return;
		}
		if ( ! isset( $_GET['bt_cat_idx'] ) || ! is_user_logged_in() || ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
			return;
		}
		$section = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['bt_cat_idx'] ) ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
		nocache_headers();
		header( 'X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow' );
		header( 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' );
		if ( ! bigtree_cat_index_ready() ) {
			echo wp_json_encode( array( 'error' => 'The Data Layer snippet is not active.' ) ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.OutputNotEscaped
			exit;
		}
		echo wp_json_encode( bigtree_cat_index_report( $section ), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.OutputNotEscaped
		exit;
	},
	1
);
```
