```php
// Within those leads, keep only links to hidden finishes (the pass skips visible and unpublished links anyway).
add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_color_version_ids',
	function ( $ids, $pid, $products, $top_slug ) {
		if ( 'fabrics' !== $top_slug ) {
			return $ids;
		}
		$hidden = bigtree_fabrics_hidden_ids();
		return array_values(
			array_filter(
				(array) $ids,
				function ( $id ) use ( $hidden ) {
					return isset( $hidden[ $id ] );
				}
			)
		);
	},
	10,
	4
);

// Fabrics opts in to the Martindale, lightfastness and fire standard filters (Leaf Grid v12, Data Layer v4, Tile Index v11 or later).
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_perf_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'fabrics', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'fabrics';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// Fabrics shows the Application filter as "Use" (Curtain, Transparent, Dimout, Blackout, Upholstery and so on).
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_facet_labels',
	function ( $labels, $top_slug ) {
		if ( 'fabrics' === $top_slug ) {
			$labels['ap'] = 'Use';
		}
		return $labels;
	},
	10,
	2
);

// Drapery and Upholstery hold about 9,000 and 10,000 cards, too many to send at once: they load 60 cards at a time.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_page_size',
	function ( $n, $term_slug, $top_slug ) {
		if ( 'fabrics' === $top_slug && in_array( $term_slug, array( 'drapery-fabrics', 'upholstery-fabrics' ), true ) ) {
			return 60;
		}
		return $n;
	},
	10,
	3
);

/* v10 (2026-11-17, PVC family shown as Polyvinyl Chloride); v9 (2026-11-17): Fabrics Material shows real fibers (blends count under every fiber); Type hides n/a. */
add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_material_rules',
	function ( $rules ) {
		$fibers = array(
			'cotton'        => 'Cotton',
			'linen'         => 'Linen',
			'acrylic'       => 'Acrylic',
			'polyamide'     => 'Polyamide',
			'silk'          => 'Silk',
			'polyvinyl-chloride' => 'Polyvinyl Chloride',
			'polypropylene' => 'Polypropylene',
			'polyurethane'  => 'Polyurethane',
		);
		foreach ( $fibers as $k => $label ) {
			if ( ! isset( $rules[ $k ] ) ) {
				$rules[ $k ] = array(
					'label' => $label,
					'kw'    => array(),
				);
			}
		}
		return $rules;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_material_top_families',
	function ( $fam, $term_name, $top_slug ) {
		if ( 'fabrics' !== $top_slug ) {
			return $fam;
		}
		static $cache = array();
		$key = (string) $term_name;
		if ( isset( $cache[ $key ] ) ) {
			return $cache[ $key ];
		}
		$name   = strtolower( trim( html_entity_decode( $key, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8' ) ) );
		$tokens = array_values( array_filter( preg_split( '/[^a-z0-9]+/', $name ) ) );
		if ( ! $tokens || in_array( $name, array( 'n/a', 'none', '0', '-' ), true ) ) {
			$cache[ $key ] = array();
			return $cache[ $key ];
		}
		$words = array(
			'polyester'     => array( 'polyester', 'pes', 'pl', 'trevira', 'rpet' ),
			'cotton'        => array( 'cotton', 'co', 'cot' ),
			'viscose'       => array( 'viscose', 'cv', 'rayon', 'fibranne' ),
			'acrylic'       => array( 'acrylic', 'pac' ),
			'polyamide'     => array( 'polyamide', 'pa', 'nylon' ),
			'linen'         => array( 'linen', 'li', 'lin', 'flax' ),
			'polyvinyl-chloride' => array( 'pvc', 'polyvinyl' ),
			'polypropylene' => array( 'polypropylene', 'pp', 'olefin', 'polyolefin' ),
			'polyurethane'  => array( 'polyurethane', 'pu' ),
			'wool'          => array( 'wool', 'wo' ),
			'silk'          => array( 'silk' ),
		);
		$out = array();
		foreach ( $words as $family => $list ) {
			if ( ! array_intersect( $list, $tokens ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			// Artificial or bamboo silk is not silk.
			if ( 'silk' === $family && array_intersect( array( 'artificial', 'faux', 'bamboo' ), $tokens ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$out[] = $family;
		}
		$cache[ $key ] = $out ? $out : array( 'other' );
		return $cache[ $key ];
	},
	10,
	3
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_type_ignore_slugs',
	function ( $slugs, $top_slug ) {
		if ( 'fabrics' === $top_slug ) {
			$slugs[] = 'n-a';
		}
		return $slugs;
	},
	10,
	2
);

/* v12 (2026-11-17): Trimmings and Decorative Accessories products leave the Drapery, Upholstery and Linens tiles. v11 (2026-11-17): the new category template draws Fabrics pages (Elementor condition bigtree_tc_tops).
 * Rollback of the template switch only: delete this block (or comment it out). */
add_filter(
	'bigtree_tc_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'fabrics', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'fabrics';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);
```

### Snippet #212: BigTree Collection Helpers and Dynamic Tags
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-11-25 13:09:50`
- **Shortcodes:** _None_
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `elementor/dynamic_tags/register`
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** `bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids()`, `bigtree_get_collection_child_categories()`, `bigtree_get_card_image_url()`, `bigtree_get_collection_cover_image()`, `bigtree_term_has_children()`, `get_name()`, `get_title()`, `get_group()`, `get_categories()`, `get_value()`, `render()`

```php
/**
 * BigTree Collection Helpers and Dynamic Tags
 * Merged from two snippets (2026-11-25): "Collection Flow for Selection to Collection Pages" (helper functions)
 * and "Dynamic Tags for Collection Cards" (Elementor dynamic tags). Code is unchanged, only joined.
 */

/* ===== PART 1: COLLECTION HELPERS (from Collection Flow for Selection to Collection Pages) ===== */

/**
 * BigTree Collection Helpers
 * Core helper functions for the Collection taxonomy (hierarchical Selections/Collections).
 * Computes descendant term IDs, cover image (with manual override), distinct child
 * product categories, and whether a term has children (parent vs. leaf).
 * Used by: Elementor Dynamic Tags, BigTree Collection Shortcodes
 */

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids' ) ) {
    function bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
        $descendants = [ $term_id ];

        $children = get_terms([
            'taxonomy'   => $taxonomy,
            'parent'     => $term_id,
            'hide_empty' => false,
            'fields'     => 'ids',
        ]);

        if ( ! empty( $children ) && ! is_wp_error( $children ) ) {
            foreach ( $children as $child_id ) {
                $descendants = array_merge( $descendants, bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $child_id, $taxonomy ) );
            }
        }

        return $descendants;
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_collection_child_categories' ) ) {
    function bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
        $all_term_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy );

        $products = get_posts([
            'post_type'   => 'product',
            'numberposts' => -1,
            'fields'      => 'ids',
            'tax_query'   => [
                [
                    'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
                    'field'    => 'term_id',
                    'terms'    => $all_term_ids,
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        if ( empty( $products ) ) {
            return [];
        }

        $child_terms = [];

        foreach ( $products as $product_id ) {
            $terms = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
            if ( ! $terms || is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
                continue;
            }
            foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
                if ( $term->parent !== 0 ) {
                    $child_terms[ $term->term_id ] = $term->name;
                }
            }
        }

        return array_unique( $child_terms );
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_card_image_url' ) ) {
    /**
     * Returns the URL of a small card-sized image for an attachment.
     * If the requested size was never generated (e.g. imports done while
     * thumbnail generation was suppressed), it is generated on demand so
     * WordPress does not fall back to the full-size original.
     * Limited to 5 generations per request and 3 attempts per attachment.
     */
    function bigtree_get_card_image_url( $attachment_id, $size = 'medium_large' ) {
        $attachment_id = (int) $attachment_id;
        if ( ! $attachment_id ) {
            return '';
        }

        $meta = wp_get_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id );
        $has_size = is_array( $meta ) && ! empty( $meta['sizes'][ $size ] );

        if ( ! $has_size ) {
            static $generated_this_request = 0;
            $tries = (int) get_post_meta( $attachment_id, '_bigtree_card_size_tries', true );
            $file  = get_attached_file( $attachment_id );

            if ( $generated_this_request < 5 && $tries < 3 && $file && file_exists( $file ) ) {
                $generated_this_request++;
                update_post_meta( $attachment_id, '_bigtree_card_size_tries', $tries + 1 );

                require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

                if ( is_array( $meta ) && ! empty( $meta['file'] ) ) {
                    wp_update_image_subsizes( $attachment_id );
                } else {
                    $new_meta = wp_generate_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, $file );
                    if ( ! is_wp_error( $new_meta ) && ! empty( $new_meta ) ) {
                        wp_update_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id, $new_meta );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        $final_size = $size;
        if ( 'medium_large' === $size ) {
            $chk = wp_get_attachment_metadata( $attachment_id );
            if ( is_array( $chk ) && empty( $chk['sizes']['medium_large'] ) && ! empty( $chk['sizes']['large'] ) ) {
                $final_size = 'large';
            }
        }
        $src = wp_get_attachment_image_src( $attachment_id, $final_size );
        return ( $src && ! empty( $src[0] ) ) ? $src[0] : '';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_get_collection_cover_image' ) ) {
    function bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
        $override_image_id = get_field( 'cover_image_override', $taxonomy . '_' . $term_id );

        if ( $override_image_id ) {
            $override_url = bigtree_get_card_image_url( $override_image_id, 'medium_large' );
            if ( $override_url ) {
                return $override_url;
            }
        }

        $all_term_ids = bigtree_get_all_descendant_term_ids( $term_id, $taxonomy );

        $products = get_posts([
            'post_type'   => 'product',
			'post_status'  => current_user_can( 'manage_woocommerce' ) ? array( 'publish', 'private' ) : array( 'publish' ),
            'numberposts' => 20,
            'orderby'     => 'menu_order',
            'order'       => 'ASC',
            'fields'      => 'ids',
            'tax_query'   => [
                [
                    'taxonomy' => $taxonomy,
                    'field'    => 'term_id',
                    'terms'    => $all_term_ids,
                ],
            ],
        ]);

        foreach ( $products as $product_id ) {
            $image_url = bigtree_get_card_image_url( get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id ), 'medium_large' );
            if ( $image_url ) {
                return $image_url;
            }
        }

        return '';
    }
}

if ( ! function_exists( 'bigtree_term_has_children' ) ) {
    function bigtree_term_has_children( $term_id, $taxonomy = 'collection' ) {
        $children = get_terms([
            'taxonomy'   => $taxonomy,
            'parent'     => $term_id,
            'hide_empty' => false,
            'fields'     => 'ids',
        ]);

        return ! empty( $children ) && ! is_wp_error( $children );
    }
}

/* ===== PART 2: ELEMENTOR DYNAMIC TAGS (from Dynamic Tags for Collection Cards) ===== */

/**
 * BigTree Collection Dynamic Tags
 * Registers two Elementor Dynamic Tags: Collection Cover Image, Collection Child Categories
 */

add_action( 'elementor/dynamic_tags/register', function( $dynamic_tags ) {

    // Register a custom tag group
    \Elementor\Plugin::$instance->dynamic_tags->register_group( 'bigtree-collection', [
        'title' => 'BigTree Collection'
    ] );

    // Image tag: must extend Data_Tag, not Tag, since Elementor's image controls
    // expect structured data (id/url) via get_value(), not a plain echoed string.
    class BigTree_Collection_Cover_Image_Tag extends \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Data_Tag {
        public function get_name() {
            return 'bigtree-collection-cover-image';
        }
        public function get_title() {
            return 'Collection Cover Image';
        }
        public function get_group() {
            return 'bigtree-collection';
        }
        public function get_categories() {
            return [ \Elementor\Modules\DynamicTags\Module::IMAGE_CATEGORY ];
        }
        public function get_value( array $options = [] ) {
            $term = get_queried_object();
            if ( ! $term || ! isset( $term->term_id ) ) {
                return [ 'id' => '', 'url' => '' ];
            }

            $url = bigtree_get_collection_cover_image( $term->term_id );

            return [
                'id'  => '',
                'url' => $url,
            ];
        }
    }

    // Text tag: renders fine as a standard Tag with render()/echo
    class BigTree_Collection_Child_Categories_Tag extends \Elementor\Core\DynamicTags\Tag {
        public function get_name() {
            return 'bigtree-collection-child-categories';
        }
        public function get_title() {
            return 'Collection Child Categories';
        }
        public function get_group() {
            return 'bigtree-collection';
        }
        public function get_categories() {
            return [ \Elementor\Modules\DynamicTags\Module::TEXT_CATEGORY ];
        }
        public function render() {
            $term = get_queried_object();
            if ( ! $term || ! isset( $term->term_id ) ) {
                return;
            }
            $categories = bigtree_get_collection_child_categories( $term->term_id );
            echo esc_html( implode( ', ', $categories ) );
        }
    }

    $dynamic_tags->register( new BigTree_Collection_Cover_Image_Tag() );
    $dynamic_tags->register( new BigTree_Collection_Child_Categories_Tag() );

} );
```

### Snippet #213: BigTree Category Pages: Add-on Categories (Wallcoverings, Leathers, Lighting)
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-11-25 13:11:03`
- **Shortcodes:** _None_
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** _None_
- **WP Filters:** `bigtree_cat_index_tops`, `bigtree_tc_tops`, `bigtree_cat_features_map`, `bigtree_cat_flat_tops`, `bigtree_lg_project_tops`, `bigtree_lg_hidden_facets`, `bigtree_cat_swatch_tops`, `bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops`
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** _None_
- **Defined Functions:** _Closures / Inline_

```php
/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Add-on Categories (Wallcoverings, Leathers, Lighting)
 * Merged from three snippets (2026-11-25): "BigTree Category Pages: Wallcoverings", "BigTree Category Pages: Leathers"
 * and "BigTree Category Pages: Lighting v1". Code is unchanged, only joined, in the original load order.
 * Furniture and Floor Coverings are NOT here: they are built into Tile Index, Template Condition and Data Layer.
 * Fabrics stays in its own snippet (large and changed often).
 */

/* ===== PART 1: WALLCOVERINGS ===== */

/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Wallcoverings (onboarding)
 *
 * Adds the Wallcoverings top-level category (slug "wallcoverings") to the two lists the
 * category-page engine reads, through its existing filters:
 *  1. bigtree_cat_index_tops - gets a cached index (Step 2).
 *  2. bigtree_tc_tops        - the Elementor condition "BigTree: Category pages (indexed only)"
 *                              applies to it, so the new template draws Wallcoverings pages (Step 4).
 *
 * Needs: Data Layer, Tile Index and Template Condition snippets.
 * Rollback of the live switch only: delete the bigtree_tc_tops block below (or comment it out).
 * Full rollback: deactivate this snippet.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_index_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'wallcoverings', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'wallcoverings';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_tc_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'wallcoverings', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'wallcoverings';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

/* ===== PART 2: LEATHERS ===== */

/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Leathers (onboarding: index, flat page, filters, template)
 *
 * Adds the Leathers top-level category (slug "leathers") to the list the
 * category-page engine indexes, and teaches the Data Layer that the Features
 * term "Commercial" is a Project value (Residential, Commercial, Hospitality,
 * Contract, Marine (interior), Aviation, Mobility).
 *
 * The flat-tops filter makes the Leathers page list all its products directly
 * (Type becomes a filter), instead of showing the eight type tiles first.
 * Needs Data Layer v2.
 *
 * The bigtree_tc_tops block below applies the new category template to Leathers.
 * Rollback of the template switch only: delete that block (or comment it out).
 * Full rollback: deactivate this snippet.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_index_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'leathers', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'leathers';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_features_map',
	function ( $map ) {
		$map = (array) $map;
		if ( ! isset( $map['project'] ) || ! is_array( $map['project'] ) ) {
			$map['project'] = array();
		}
		if ( ! in_array( 'commercial', $map['project'], true ) ) {
			$map['project'][] = 'commercial';
		}
		return $map;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_flat_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'leathers', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'leathers';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// The Project filter is hidden on every category by default (Leaf Grid v4).
// Leathers turns it on.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_project_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'leathers', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'leathers';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// The five Leathers filters are Selection, Type, Project, Application, Color.
// Material (Leather / Other) and the Flame Retardant and Outdoor switches add
// nothing here, so they are hidden on this page.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_hidden_facets',
	function ( $hidden, $top ) {
		$hidden = (array) $hidden;
		if ( 'leathers' === $top ) {
			$hidden[] = 'm';
			$hidden[] = 'fr';
			$hidden[] = 'o';
		}
		return $hidden;
	},
	10,
	2
);

// Step 4: the new category template draws Leathers pages.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_tc_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'leathers', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'leathers';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

/* ===== PART 3: LIGHTING ===== */

/**
 * BigTree Category Pages: Lighting (onboarding: index, flat page, filters, finish swatches)
 *
 * Adds the Lighting top-level category (slug "lighting") to the list the category-page
 * engine indexes, and makes the Lighting page list all its products directly
 * (Type becomes a filter) instead of showing one tile per lamp type.
 *
 * Finishes: the VCHalux Rechargeable lamps list their finishes in
 * related_series_products. Those finishes sit in Lighting > Finishes and are hidden.
 * They never become cards. Their colors count toward the lamp in the Color filter
 * (for example 05 Matt Black makes the lamp match Black, 48 Rich Gold makes it match Metallic).
 * Needs Tile Index v3 (adds the bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops filter) and Data Layer v3.
 *
 * v1: the bigtree_tc_tops block at the end applies the new category template to Lighting.
 * Rollback of the template switch only: delete that block (or comment it out).
 * Full rollback: deactivate this snippet.
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_index_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'lighting', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'lighting';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_flat_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'lighting', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'lighting';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// Finishes under Lighting > Finishes are material swatches: they feed the Color filter, never a card.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_swatch_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'lighting', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'lighting';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// The finish category (Rechargeable Lights) has the same name as the lamp category,
// so the name match must not treat the finish as a color version card.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_cat_swatch_force_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'lighting', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'lighting';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);

// Lighting filters: Type, Material, Color and the Outdoor switch.
// Project is hidden by default (every sampled lamp carries the same Project values).
// Style, Application and Selection hide themselves when they have fewer than two options.
// The Flame Retardant switch adds nothing on Lighting, so it is hidden.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_lg_hidden_facets',
	function ( $hidden, $top ) {
		$hidden = (array) $hidden;
		if ( 'lighting' === $top ) {
			$hidden[] = 'fr';
		}
		return $hidden;
	},
	10,
	2
);

// Step 4: the new category template draws Lighting pages.
add_filter(
	'bigtree_tc_tops',
	function ( $tops ) {
		$tops = (array) $tops;
		if ( ! in_array( 'lighting', $tops, true ) ) {
			$tops[] = 'lighting';
		}
		return $tops;
	}
);
```

### Snippet #214: BigTree Filter &amp; Archive Architecture MD Generator
- **Status:** `ACTIVE` | **Scope:** `global` | **Last Modified:** `2026-11-25 14:30:30`
- **Shortcodes:** _None_
- **AJAX Actions:** _None_
- **WP Actions:** `admin_menu`, `admin_notices`, `admin_post_bigtree_download_filters_md`
- **WP Filters:** _None_
- **URL Query Params (`$_GET`):** ` . $gp . `

/**
 * 3. Handle the Markdown File Generation & Download via admin-post.php
 */
add_action( 'admin_post_bigtree_download_filters_md', 'bigtree_handle_filters_md_download' );
function bigtree_handle_filters_md_download() {
	if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
		wp_die( 'Unauthorized access.' );
	}

	check_admin_referer( 'bigtree_filters_md_download' );

	$include_full_code = ! empty( $_REQUEST['full_code'] );
	$markdown_content  = bigtree_build_filters_markdown_doc( $include_full_code );

	while ( ob_get_level() ) {
		ob_end_clean();
	}

	$filename = 'BigTree_Filters_Architecture_And_Snippets_' . gmdate( 'Y-m-d_His' ) . '.md';

	nocache_headers();
	header( 'Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8' );
	header( 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="' . $filename . '"' );
	header( 'Content-Length: ' . strlen( $markdown_content ) );
	header( 'Pragma: no-cache' );
	header( 'Expires: 0' );

	echo $markdown_content;
	exit;
}

/**
 * 4. Query the Code Snippets Database Table (`wp_snippets`)
 */
function bigtree_get_filter_snippets_from_db() {
	global $wpdb;
	$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'snippets';

	if ( $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SHOW TABLES LIKE %s', $table_name ) ) !== $table_name ) {
		return array();
	}

	// Core Filter, Category Page, Collection & Redis Count Cache Snippet IDs
	$target_ids = array( 5, 7, 12, 19, 41, 51, 68, 98, 105, 106, 110, 115, 137, 140, 145, 147, 181, 200, 206, 207, 211, 212, 213 );
	$ids_sql    = implode( ',', array_map( 'intval', $target_ids ) );

	$sql = "
		SELECT id, name, description, code, tags, scope, active, modified
		FROM {$table_name}
		WHERE id IN ({$ids_sql})
		   OR name LIKE '%Filter%'
		   OR name LIKE '%Category Pages%'
		   OR name LIKE '%Collection%'
		   OR name LIKE '%Archive%'
		ORDER BY id ASC
	";

	$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $sql, ARRAY_A );
	return is_array( $rows ) ? $rows : array();
}

/**
 * 5. Parse a Snippet's PHP Code for Shortcodes, Hooks, AJAX & $_GET Params
 */
function bigtree_analyze_snippet_php( $code ) {
	$analysis = array(
		'shortcodes' => array(),
		'actions'    => array(),
		'filters'    => array(),
		'ajax'       => array(),
		'functions'  => array(),
		'url_params' => array(),
	);

	if ( preg_match_all( '/add_shortcode\s*\(\s*[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['shortcodes'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}
	if ( preg_match_all( '/add_action\s*\(\s*[\'"]wp_ajax_(?:nopriv_)?([^\'"]+)[\'"]/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['ajax'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}
	if ( preg_match_all( '/add_action\s*\(\s*[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['actions'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}
	if ( preg_match_all( '/add_filter\s*\(\s*[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['filters'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}
	if ( preg_match_all( '/function\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\(/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['functions'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}
	if ( preg_match_all( '/\$_GET\[\s*[\'"]([^\'"]+)[\'"]\s*\]/i', $code, $m ) ) {
		$analysis['url_params'] = array_unique( $m[1] );
	}

	return $analysis;
}

## 1. Dual-Path Filtering Architecture Overview

BigTree's filtering system is engineered specifically for a high-volume B2B specification library (~22,400+ published SKUs across 7,390+ combined taxonomy terms). Rather than relying on slow native WooCommerce meta/taxonomy joins, the store splits product discovery and filtering into two specialized PHP Code Snippet pipelines:

1. **Path A — Curated Selection & Collection Filters (`collection` custom taxonomy intersected with `product_cat`):**
   - **Snippet #181:** `Shortcode for Collection Query - 14 (Private products for admins and Shop Managers)`
   - **Snippet #147:** `BigTree Selection Outdoor Map (Step 1)`
   - **Snippet #212:** `BigTree Collection Helpers and Dynamic Tags`
   - **Snippet #98:** `Sort Products by Collection`
2. **Path B — Departmental Category Page Filters (`product_cat` native hierarchy + Modular Data Layer):**
   - **Snippet #145:** `BigTree Category Pages: Template Condition (Furniture + Floor Coverings built in)`
   - **Snippet #207:** `BigTree Category Pages: Data Layer v5 (Furniture + Floor Coverings built in)`
   - **Snippet #200:** `BigTree Category Pages: Tile Index v12 (Furniture + Floor Coverings built in)`
   - **Snippet #206:** `BigTree Category Pages: Leaf Grid and Filters v14`
   - **Snippet #211:** `BigTree Category Pages: Fabrics v12`
   - **Snippet #213:** `BigTree Category Pages: Add-on Categories (Wallcoverings, Leathers, Lighting)`
   - **Snippet #140:** `Product Archive Engine (Shortcode)`
3. **Path C — Performance Caching, Search & Filter Hygiene:**
   - **Snippet #115:** `Archive Scaling & Redis Count Cache`
   - **Snippet #68:** `persistent product query cache`
   - **Snippet #105, #106, #110:** Annasta Filter overrides (`Zero Count Removal`, `Scroll Restoration`, `AJAX Reload & Clear`)
   - **Snippet #137:** `Fix &amp Issue` (HTML entity decoding on dynamic filter buttons)

---

## 2. How Path A Works: Curated `collection` Filters

### 2.1. `[bigtree_all_selections_grid]` (`/all-selections/`)
- **Live Department Tag Resolution:** Iterates over all top-level Root Selections (`parent = 0`, ~50 Root Brands). For each selection, it inspects the Level-1 `product_cat` departments (`Furniture`, `Fabrics`, `Leathers`, `Lighting`, `Wallcoverings`, `Floor Coverings`, `Objects`) of all published products inside that selection tree.
- **Zero-Product Suppression:** Root selections with `0` published products across their entire child hierarchy are excluded automatically.
- **Multi-Select Conjunctive (`AND`) URL Filtering:** Reads `?filters=furniture,lighting`. When a specifier toggles multiple department buttons, the grid requires a root selection to contain products in **every** active department (`AND` intersection) to remain visible.

### 2.2. `[bigtree_collection_grid]` (Parent Selections with Children)
- **Trigger Condition:** Runs when `bigtree_term_has_children( $term_id ) === true`.
- **Intermediate Folder Auto-Unpack Rule:**
  - In multi-tier selections like `DD Selection` -> (`DD. Premium`, `DD. Pulse`) -> Sub-collections, intermediate brand folders create unnecessary clicks.
  - **Algorithm:** If a parent collection has **`<= 3` direct child terms** AND those children have sub-children of their own, the shortcode automatically **bypasses the intermediate folders** and merges all underlying grandchild collection cards directly into the grid.
- **Adaptive Category Depth Algorithm (Auto-Zooming Filter Bar):**
  - Analyzes the category spread of products inside the current parent selection to choose the most meaningful filter pill depth:
    1. **Level 1 Filter Pills:** Used when the selection spans **3+ root departments** (`[ALL] [FURNITURE] [LIGHTING] [OBJECTS]`).
    2. **Level 2 Auto-Zoom:** Used when the selection is concentrated in a single department (e.g. `DK Selection` is ~95% `Fabrics`), zooming the pills to Level 2 (`[ALL] [BOUCLÉ] [WOVEN] [VELVETS]`).
    3. **Level 3 Auto-Zoom:** Used when all products belong to a single Level-2 subcategory (e.g. 100% `Seating`), zooming the pills to Level 3 (`[ALL] [SOFA CHAIRS] [STOOLS]`).

### 2.3. `[bigtree_collection_products]` (Leaf Collections)
- **Trigger Condition:** Runs when `bigtree_term_has_children( $term_id ) === false`.
- **Admin / Shop Manager Private Preview (Snippet #181 v14):** Automatically includes `private` products alongside `publish` products when the logged-in user has `manage_options` or `manage_woocommerce` capabilities.
- **Dynamic Child Category Filter Bar:** Renders filter pills only if the leaf collection's products belong to **`> 1` distinct child category**. Deduplicates identical category labels and runs `html_entity_decode()` so `&amp;` never renders as `&AMP;`.

---

## 3. How Path B Works: Departmental Category Pages (`v5 / v12 / v14` Engine)

1. **Template Routing (`Snippet #145`):** Evaluates the current `product_cat` request and decides whether to render the visual **Tile Index (`Snippet #200`)** for parent/intermediate categories or the filterable **Leaf Grid (`Snippet #206`)** for leaf categories.
2. **Central Data Layer (`Snippet #207` + `#211` + `#213`):**
   - Pre-calculates taxonomy trees, active facet counts, and outdoor capabilities (`Snippet #147`) for **Furniture**, **Floor Coverings**, **Fabrics**, **Wallcoverings**, **Leathers**, and **Lighting**.
3. **Leaf Grid & Interactive Filters (`Snippet #206` & `#211`):**
   - Renders fast facet bars without full page reloads, sorting results cleanly by Collection (`Snippet #98`).
   - Embeds BigTree's B2B card actions directly into every filtered product card:
     - **Add to List (`+` top-right button via `Snippet #7` `bigtree_add_to_cart`):** Supports both `simple` products and `variable` products (automatically pre-selecting the first in-stock `variation_id` and its `pa_*` attributes).
     - **High-Res Image Download (`↓` bottom-right hover button):** Fetches original full-res media as a Blob named `BigTree_<Product_Name>_<ID>.<ext>`.
